jobs.title: Hausdame / Gouvernante (m/w/d) f. Liechtenstein gesucht A26/9821 Li (Hausdame/Housekeeper)
jobs.description:
Liechtenstein

Gesucht wird für einen gehobenen 2-Personen-Privathaushalt in einem stilvollen kleinen Familienschloss in Liechtenstein eine erfahrene und engagierte **Hausdame / Gouvernante (m/w/d).** Die private Residenz umfasst rund 15 Zimmer sowie ein parkähnliches Grundstück. Sie arbeiten in einem gepflegten, repräsentativen Umfeld gemeinsam mit weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses und übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit hoher Eigenständigkeit.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Verantwortungsvolle Führung und Organisation des gehobenen Privathaushalts
- Sicherstellung einer tadellosen Sauberkeit, Ordnung und gepflegten Atmosphäre im gesamten Haus
- Reinigung und Pflege hochwertiger Oberflächen, Materialien und Einrichtungen
- Fachgerechte Wäschepflege, einschließlich Waschen, Bügeln, Falten und Versorgen anspruchsvoller Textilien
- Sicherer und sorgfältiger Umgang mit hochwertigen Stoffen, Antiquitäten, Kunstgegenständen und wertvollem Inventar
- Vorbereitung und Zubereitung kleiner Mahlzeiten, insbesondere des Frühstücks
- Aufmerksame Betreuung der Hausherren sowie professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Gästen
- Unterstützung bei Empfängen, Einladungen und besonderen Anlässen
- Koordination und Abstimmung mit den weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses
- Konsequente Einhaltung und Kontrolle der geltenden Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards

Ihr Profil

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Hausdame, Gouvernante oder in einer vergleichbaren Position in einem gehobenen Privathaushalt
- Fundierte Vorkenntnisse aus der 4- oder 5-Sterne-Hotellerie
- Ausgeprägte Gastgeberqualität, Serviceorientierung und ein sicheres, kultiviertes Auftreten
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Pflege hochwertiger Wäsche und Textilien
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit Antiquitäten, Kunstobjekten und anspruchsvoller Einrichtung
- Selbstständige, strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
- Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Diskretion und Loyalität
- Flexibilität und Freude an der Arbeit in einem privaten, exklusiven Umfeld
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Gepflegte Erscheinung und ausgezeichnete Umgangsformen
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Arbeitszeiten am Wochenende
- Ausgezeichneter Leumund

Geboten wird

- Eine verantwortungsvolle und langfristig ausgerichtete Position in einem außergewöhnlichen privaten Umfeld
- Ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima in einem professionell geführten Haushalt
- Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden in Haus und Garten
- Eine vielseitige, anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
- Ein überdurchschnittliches Gehalt, welches sich an Erfahrung und Qualifikation orientiert

Bei der Wohnungssuche ist die Familie gerne behilflich, es handelt sich hier um eine Vollzeit-Anstellung. Gebeten wird um vollständige Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Lebenslauf, Referenzen und Angaben zu Ihrer Verfügbarkeit. Die Position ist nach Absprache zu besetzen und wird ausnehmend gut vergütet.

Gesucht wird für eine Unternehmerfamilie mit Sitz in Liechtenstein (Vaduz) ein versiertes, zuverlässiges Wirtschafter - Paar (m/w/d). Februar 2027 und wird überdurchschnittlich hoch vergütet.

- Du denkst strategisch, handelst vorausschauend und setzt dich mit Leidenschaft für die Mission von Tesla ein
- Du kannst effektiv Prioritäten setzen, mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig steuern und Deadlines zuverlässig einhalten
- Du liebst es, den Status quo zu verändern und kannst auch in Situationen mit hohem Druck gut arbeiten
- Du bist verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse
- Dein Wohnsitz sollte idealerweise in Wien liegen, da die Position eine Reisetätigkeit von etwa 2–3 Tagen pro Woche umfasst – dabei handelt es sich um Tagesbesuche bei Kunden
- Du bist seit mindestens zwei Jahren im Besitz eines gültigen EU-Führerscheins (Klasse B)Für diese Position bieten wir ein jährliches Bruttomindestgehalt von € 62.000 auf Basis des oben angeführten Anforderungsprofils bei Vollzeitbeschäftigung an. jobs.description:
🌟 Stellenangebot: Medizinisch-technische/r Radiologieassistent/in (MTR / MTRA) - Basel, Schweiz

Ihre Perspektive in Basel
Möchten Sie Ihre Fachkompetenz in einem hochmodernen medizinischen Umfeld einbringen und von den attraktiven Rahmenbedingungen des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens profitieren?
Im Auftrag einer renommierten Radiologie-Praxis bzw. Klinik im Raum Basel suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Expertise im Bereich der Mammographie sowie Vielseitigkeit in der allgemeinen Bildgebung.

Schwerpunkt Mammographie: Eigenverantwortliche und empathische Durchführung von Mammographien auf höchstem technischem Niveau sowie Betreuung der Patientinnen während des gesamten Untersuchungsablaufs.
Allgemeine Radiologische Diagnostik: Kompetente Durchführung von Routine- und Spezialuntersuchungen in den Bereichen Röntgen, Computertomographie (CT) und Magnetresonanztomographie (MRT).
Prozess- & Qualitätsmanagement: Einhaltung und Sicherstellung höchster Qualitäts-, Strahlenschutz- und Hygienestandards.
Patientenorientierung: Professionelle, einfühlsame Vorbereitung und Betreuung der Patienten in einer vertrauensvollen Atmosphäre.

Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als MTR / MTRA (Medizinisch-technische/r Radiologieassistent/in) oder eine vergleichbare, in der Schweiz anerkannte Qualifikation.
Fachkompetenz: Nachweisbare, vertiefte Erfahrung und hohe Routine in der Mammographie.
Vielseitigkeit: Gute Praxiskenntnisse und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Geräten der Sparten Röntgen, CT und MRT.
Persönlichkeit: Hohe Sozialkompetenz, Empathie im Umgang mit Patienten sowie eine zuverlässige, selbstständige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Das erwartet Sie
Attraktive Vergütung: Schweizer Gehaltsstandard inklusive hervorragender Sozialleistungen und Vorsorgekonzepte.
Modernste Technologie: Arbeiten mit Geräten der neuesten Generation in einem dynamischen und professionellen Team.
Umfassender Relocation-Support: Als Deutsch-Schweizer Vermittlungsverbund begleiten wir Sie persönlich beim Übergang nach Basel (Anerkennung der Diplome, Behördengänge, Wohnungssuche, steuerliche Orientierung).

Senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Diplome) einfach per E-Mail an uns. Wir begleiten Sie diskret, kostenfrei und Schritt für Schritt auf Ihrem Weg zu Ihrer neuen Herausforderung in der Schweiz!

jobs.title: Senior Accountant Manager  (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
jobs.description:
Senior Accountant Manager

Opis firmy

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

Opis oferty pracy

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;
- Uzgadnianie rejestru VAT zakupu i sprzedaży;
- Raportowanie wyników finansowych dla hoteli w Gdańsku i Warszawie do Centrali, w tym analiza odchyleń oraz rekomendowanie działań korygujących.
- Ścisła współpraca z działem Controllingu, audytorami i pozostałymi działami hotelowymi w zakresie zagadnień finansowych, w tym obsługi procesów KSeF.
- Przygotowywanie przelewów do płatności, księgowanie wyciągów, rozliczanie kart kredytowych
- Przygotowywanie tygodniowych, miesięcznych i rocznych raportów finansowych zgodnie z wymaganiami działu kontroli finansowej.
- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.

jobs.title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
jobs.description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

Have we piqued your interest?

Then apply with your CV and a few clicks via our online form! No cover letter is necessary.

Do you have any questions? Then feel free to send us an email at malte.ruetten@softwareone.com.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer L2 / L3 (Third-Level-Supporter/in)
jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRING: Senior Network Hand & Feet Engineer (L2/L3 Physical & Logical Support) – Austria

Excis is a global leader in IT support that is characterized by innovation and collaboration. We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Hand & Feet Engineerwho will be responsible for the end-to-end physical deployment and logical validation of network infrastructures. This position requires in-depth knowledge of OSI layers 1-3to ensure that physical connectivity seamlessly matches logical configurations. Become part of a supportive and growth-oriented company where your technical expertise makes a real difference.

190+ countries | 6,000+ Engineers | 200+ Enterprise Customers

We promote an open, collaborative and growth-oriented corporate culture in which individual achievements contribute to mutual success. From solving complex technical challenges to supporting global enterprise customers, our people are at the heart of it.

Your tasks

- Perform challenging rack and device installations using Rack Elevation Diagrams (REDs) for Cisco Nexus 9k, Catalyst 9500, and other networking components.
- Ensuring mechanical safety, correct power supply and rack integrity.
- Perform structured copper and fiber cabling including SMF/MMF fibers, SFP/SFP+/QSFP+ modules, and ANSI/TIA 606-B cabling.
- Manage patch panels, cross-connect, and coordinate line extensions with telecom providers.
- Configure and troubleshoot out-of-band (OOB) management and console accesses.
- Support for BIOS-based error analysis and on-site boot monitoring.
- Apply in-depth routing and switching knowledge to OSI layers 1-3, including VLANs, STP, EtherChannel/LACP, and protocol validation (BGP, OSPF).
- Collaborate with NOC and infrastructure teams to resolve business-critical network disruptions.

Requirements

- 6-8 years of work experience in a data center or large enterprise campus environment
- Experience installing Ethernet and fiber cabling on Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto and F5 load balancers
- Hands-on experience with routing and switching as well as Cisco IOS, NX-OS, PAN OS or Arista EOS
- Experience in working with Visual Fault Locators (VFL), Light Meters and Fiber Inspection Scopes
- CCNA-Zertifizierung erforderlich; CCNP Enterprise (ENCORE) von Vorteil
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit geschäftskritischen Incidents in Enterprise-Netzwerken und Rechenzentren
- Bereitschaft zur Vor-Ort-Arbeit von Montag bis Freitag (kein Hybrid- oder Remote-Modell)
- Lokale Sprachkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Wichtige Kompetenzen

- Erweiterte Fehleranalyse auf den OSI-Schichten 1–3
- Präzision bei physischer Installation und Verkabelungsstandards
- Ausgeprägte Dokumentations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
- Selbstständiges Arbeiten vor Ort
- Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden IT-Teams

Warum Excis?

Bei Excis zählt Ihre Arbeit. Sie werden Teil eines dynamischen, praxisorientierten Teams, in dem Ihr technisches Fachwissen direkt zur Kundenzufriedenheit und zum Unternehmenserfolg beiträgt.

Wir bieten Ihnen ein unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kontinuierlichem Lernen und der Zusammenarbeit mit modernsten Technologien. Freuen Sie sich auf eine attraktive Vergütung und die Chance, bei einem globalen IT-Dienstleister mitzuwirken, der Innovation und Exzellenz lebt.

Bereit für den nächsten Karriereschritt? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und werden Sie Teil von Excis – gemeinsam liefern wir erstklassigen IT-Support für Enterprise-Kunden weltweit!

jobs.title: AI Manager (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Willst du KI in echten geschäftlichen Mehrwert für die DLG verwandeln? Als **AI Manager (m/w/d)** spielst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Group IT. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, die KI‑Strategie der DLG weiterzuentwickeln und umzusetzen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen. In dieser Rolle treibst du nicht nur die Richtung und Umsetzung von KI‑Initiativen voran, sondern baust auch ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf und führst es. Du schaffst die Grundlage dafür, wie wir KI‑Lösungen entwickeln, skalieren und im gesamten Unternehmen betreiben.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du prägst die KI‑Ausrichtung der DLG und leitest ein Team, das wirkungsvolle, geschäftsorientierte Lösungen liefert. Konkret bedeutet das:

- Du definierst und verantwortest die KI‑Roadmap sowie das Use‑Case‑Portfolio über alle Geschäftsbereiche hinweg.
- Du baust ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf, führst und entwickelst es weiter.
- Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare und wirkungsvolle KI‑Lösungen.
- Du steuerst das Solution Design – von der Idee über Architekturentscheidungen bis zur Implementierung.
- Du etablierst Standards für Daten, Integrationen, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und Responsible AI.
- Du arbeitest eng mit technischen Teams, externen Partnern und Dienstleistern zusammen, um Fortschritt und Qualität sicherzustellen.
- Du unterstützt Build-or-Buy‑Entscheidungen und sorgst für die Abstimmung mit den Enterprise‑Plattformen.

Profil

Du bist eine erfahrene **Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit einer starken technischen Basis und einer Leidenschaft dafür, sowohl Menschen als auch Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest strukturiert und pragmatisch und erzielst Ergebnisse sowohl durch dein Team als auch durch deine eigene Expertise. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Business und IT und weißt, wie man Richtung, Alignment und Momentum in einem komplexen Stakeholder‑Umfeld schafft.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du:

- nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams im Bereich KI, Daten oder Advanced Analytics mitbringen
- ein tiefes Verständnis für Solution Architecture und komplexe IT‑Landschaften haben
- Erfahrung darin haben, KI‑ oder Dateninitiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung zu treiben
- in der Lage sein, geschäftliche Prioritäten mit technologischen Möglichkeiten zu verbinden
- Erfahrung mit Governance, Priorisierung und funktionsübergreifenden Entscheidungen haben
- eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit sein, die motiviert, coacht und Engagement schafft
- strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert arbeiten
- klar kommunizieren und komplexe Themen verständlich machen
- sicher in Deutsch und Englisch kommunizieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG erwartet dich eine spannende und wirkungsvolle Rolle in einem Unternehmen, in dem KI und Digitalisierung ganz oben auf der Agenda stehen.

Du kannst dich freuen auf:

- eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der KI‑Ausrichtung eines internationalen Unternehmens
- die Möglichkeit, eine neue KI‑Funktion innerhalb der DLG aufzubauen und zu führen
- ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Einfluss
- ein starkes professionelles Umfeld in IT, Daten und Digitalisierung
- persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und eine gesunde Work‑Life‑Balance

Kontakt

Wir freuen uns über deine Bewerbung im PDF-Format über unser Bewerbungsportal unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins.

jobs.title: German speaking Google Ads Sales Executive (m/w/d), Barcelona Spain (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description:

We’re seeking a resilient individual to focus on providing exceptional service-oriented Google Ads solutions to emerging businesses and established local enterprises. If you have a proven sales track record, excel at building relationships quickly, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

- Engage with regional clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored service solutions.
- Manage a high volume of accounts, focusing on delivering exceptional service and sales support.
- Drive revenue growth by effectively selling and convincing clients, using strong sales techniques.
- Work with performance targets and KPIs to consistently meet or exceed objectives.

Requirements

- C2 level of German and C1 level of English (both written and spoken).
- 2 years of proven sales experience, with the ability to win people over and convince clients rapidly.

Must possess deep expertise in persuasive negotiation and a demonstrated capacity for driving significant individual revenue and market share gains in high-velocity sectors of different verticals. Proficient resilience and ability to handle a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

Specialized Skills for the German Market:

- Deep German market and cultural understanding.
- Strategic thinking to target high-growth companies.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to unlock substantial expansion opportunities.
- German cultural awareness for building client trust.
- Stakeholder management, including skeptical clients and multiple agencies.
- Deep understanding of the German digital marketing ecosystem to position Google Ads effectively.
- Proficiency in managing sophisticated ROI and integration queries.
- Knowledge of local regulations, especially GDPR, to ensure compliance and tailor data-privacy-focused outreach strategies.

Desirable Skills

- Process Excellence: Systematically improving organizational processes to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and quality
- Collaboration: Working effectively with others, sharing ideas and resources to achieve common goals
- Communication: Exchanging information, ideas, and messages between individuals or groups through various channels and mediums.

- Open Mindedness: Considering and appreciating diverse perspectives and ideas, fostering collaboration
- Critical Thinking: Evaluating information and arguments, leading to informed and effective decisions based on data insights
- Solution Orientation: Approaching problems and challenges with a focus on finding practical and effective solutions
- Entrepreneurship: Having a mindset characterized by innovation, creativity, risk-taking, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and opportunity identification

Benefits

- Full-time (39 hours/week) hybrid position in Barcelona with a salary of 24.310,00 € gross/year + up to 4.290,00 € gross/year in bonus.
- Relocation Support
- Private Health Insurance.
- Continuous skill development and certifications.
- Clear career growth opportunities
- Engaging workplace with bi-weekly, monthly, or quarterly contests and dynamic business casual culture.
- Prime office location at the World Trade Center, Barcelona, surrounded by the sea.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

jobs.title: (Associate) Vice President  (f/m/d) - Siemens Advanta (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:

- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.
- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.
- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.

What you bring:

- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.
- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.
- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.
- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.
- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.

What we offer you

- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .

That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

jobs.description:
1 Property Manager (m/f/d)

A Snapshot of Your Day


This role, Property Manager (f/m/d) for Linz location, will focus on three core areas: on-site property, project and facility management, vendor and contract administration, and financial and operational oversight. These responsibilities ensure that all real estate activities are managed efficiently, align with project timelines, and meet compliance standards.


How You'll Make an Impact
* Oversee all day-to-day real estate activities to ensure smooth and efficient operations.
* Conduct regular property inspections to ensure facilities are maintained to company standards and comply with regulations.
* Ensure all site activities adhere to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) policies and legal requirements.
* Manage relationships with external vendors, suppliers, and contractors, ensuring service level agreements are met.
* Negotiate, administer, and maintain lease agreements and service contracts for the property.
* Support the budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis processes for all property-related expenses.
* Manage and process invoicing for real estate services and vendor payments.
* Prepare and deliver regular reports on property status, project progress, and financial performance to management.


What You Bring
* 2-5 years of professional experience in corporate real estate or property management.
* Proven experience working independently on difficult, but not overly complex, real estate management tasks.
* Experience in managing vendor relationships and negotiating contracts is required.
* Skills in real estate management, including property management and property inspection to support the effective operation, maintenance, compliance, and optimization of real estate assets.
* Financial acumen, including financial analysis, budgeting, and due diligence to support informed investment decisions, effective financial planning, and the successful management of real estate assets and business opportunities.
* Effective stakeholder and vendor relationship management, including vendor management capabilities to build productive partnerships, ensure service quality, and support the successful delivery of business objectives.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, including analytical thinking and report writing to support data-driven decision-making, performance monitoring, and the effective communication of business insights and recommendations.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben (Key Responsibilities)

* HR / PX Business Partnering (Österreich): Eigenständige Betreuung und Beratung von Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden in Österreich in allen HR- und PX-Belangen entlang des gesamten Employee Lifecycles.

* Gesprächsführung & Coaching: Souveräne Durchführung anspruchsvoller Gespräche mit Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden sowie Coaching von Führungskräften zu PX-Prozessen, Initiativen und arbeitsrechtlichen Themen.

* Employee Relations & Compliance: Betreuung von Employee-Relations-Themen inklusive Erstellung der erforderlichen Dokumentation unter strikter Einhaltung des österreichischen Arbeitsrechts.

* Betriebsratsarbeit: Unterstützung bei der konstruktiven Zusammenarbeit mit den Betriebsräten in Österreich.

* Schnittstellenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung und Kooperation mit dem Global Shared Service Centre sowie den Centers of Expertise (u. a. Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards).

* Virtuelle Unterstützung Schweiz: Remote-Unterstützung bei ausgewählten HR-Ops- und Koordinationsaufgaben sowie im PX Business Partnering in enger Abstimmung mit dem Schweizer PX-Team.

* Projektmitarbeit: Aktive Mitwirkung an und Führung von lokalen sowie globalen PX-Projekten in Kooperation mit dem bestehenden Team.

Ihr Profil (Candidate Profile)

Muss-Kriterien & Qualifikationen:

* Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich HR, Betriebswirtschaft / Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

* Berufserfahrung: fundierte Praxiserfahrung im HR-Bereich, idealerweise als HR Business Partner oder in einer vergleichbaren generalistischen HR-Funktion.

* Arbeitsrecht: Gute / fundierte Kenntnisse des österreichischen Arbeitsrechts.

* Sprachkenntnisse: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Persönlichkeit & Kompetenzen:

* Hands-on-Mentalität: Ausgeprägte "Packen-wir-es-an"-Einstellung und eine pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

* Gesprächsführung: Souveränität, Durchsetzungsvermögen und Empathie in der Führung schwieriger und sensibler Gespräche.

* Stakeholder Management: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Beziehungsaufbau und hoher Teamgeist.

* Flexibilität: Bereitschaft, neben dem Hauptfokus Österreich virtuell Agenden für die Schweiz mitzubetreuen.

* Umfeld: Erfahrung in einem internationalen Konzern- oder Unternehmensumfeld ist von Vorteil.

Rahmenbedingungen & Sonstiges (Other Information)

* Dauer: Befristeter Einsatz für 4-6 Monate (voraussichtlich bis Jahresende) im Rahmen einer Krankenstandsvertretung, Option auf Verlängerung bzw. Übernahme gegeben

* Arbeitsort & Ausmaß: Primärer Standort in Österreich. Das genaue Beschäftigungsausmaß sowie Details zum Arbeitsort werden im Prozess individuell abgestimmt.

* Onboarding: Zu Beginn der Befristung erfolgt eine intensive und strukturierte Einarbeitung durch das bestehende PX-Team Österreich/Schweiz

jobs.title: Fitnesstrainer_in
jobs.description:
Sport- und Gesundheitszentrum Zerlach

Als präventiv-medizinisches Konzept ist das SGZ Zerlach eine Antwort auf die steigende gesundheitliche Eigenverantwortung. Das Training des gesamten Körpers steht im Vordergrund unserer Dienstleistung und ist die ideale Möglichkeit, den Gesundheitsbeschwerden aktiv entgegen zu wirken bzw. ihnen vorzubeugen. Mit qualifiziertem Personal, und die auf das Präventivtraining abgestimmte Geräteausstattung, bringt der Fitnessbereich des SGZ die besten Voraussetzungen für erfolgreiches Training auf höchstem Niveau mit sich.

Wir suchen zum sofortigen Eintritt: 1 Fitnesstrainer_in Gesundheitstraining bedeutet, alle wichtigen motorischen und damit lebensnotwendigen Eigenschaften unseres Körpers zu trainieren. Ein maßgeschneidertes Gesundheitstraining muss daher in jedem Fall die Komponenten Kraft (Spannung der Muskulatur), Flexibilität (Dehnfähigkeit), Koordination (Zusammenspiel der Muskulatur) und Ausdauer (Herz-Kreislauf) beinhalten. Nach der Untersuchung aller wichtigen Faktoren müssen die Ergebnisse in das umfassende Regelwerk der Trainingslehre eingebracht werden. Nur wenn diese konsequent befolgt wird, entsteht ein Trainingskonzept, mit dem der Trainierende garantiert sein Ziel erreicht. Der Faktor Zufall wird ausgeschaltet.

Um die oben erwähnten Dinge zu erreichen bzw. umzusetzen ist unser sich über 2 Etagen erstreckender Fitnessbereich mit neuesten Geräten ausgestattet worden! Nach einer gründlichen Befundung und einer von uns empfohlenen ärztlichen Untersuchung wird eine Einschulung durch unsere Fitnesstrainer_innen vorgenommen und ein Trainingskonzept erstellt. Danach steht Ihrem Training nichts mehr entgegen!

Unsere Erwartungen an dich:

jobs.title: Designer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
What if eyewear could be lighter, smarter, more expressive - and simply better designed? At Silhouette Group, we believe great eyewear starts with a strong idea. Our three brands - Silhouette, evil eye and neubau - explore different ways of shaping the future of eyewear.

We are looking for a curious, creative and ambitious Eyewear Designer to join our international design team in our Headquarter in Linz. 1 Designer (m/w/d)

AUFGABEN UND VERANTWORTUNG

* Explore. Track emerging trends in fashion, design, materials, technology and culture - and turn insights into relevant design directions.

* Create. Develop concepts, moodboards, sketches and 2D/3D designs from the first idea to a tangible product.

* Shape. Work closely with Color Design, R&D, prototyping and construction to transform creative ideas into feasible, high-quality eyewear.

* Communicate. Tell the story behind your designs and inspire colleagues, marketing, sales and opticians.

* Contribute. Become part of the development of future collections across our three distinctive brands.

ANFORDERUNGEN

* A degree in Industrial Design, Product Design or a related field

* A strong portfolio demonstrating original thinking, conceptual strength, sensitivity to form and attention to detail

* The ability to develop ideas from concept and sketch through 2D/3D design to the physical product

* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite and 3D design tools such as Rhino, SolidWorks or equivalent

* A strong understanding of form, proportion, materials and manufacturing processes

* Genuine curiosity for new materials, technologies and production methods

* The confidence to question conventional approaches, explore new ideas and develop your own design point of view

* An independent, hands-on and solution-oriented way of working

* A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with design, engineering and manufacturing teams

* Experience in eyewear, product or industrial design is an advantage - but exceptional potential and a strong portfolio matter just as much

For this full-time position, we offer a minimum gross yearly salary of EUR 60,962.30 in accordance with the Austrian Collective Agreement for the Metal Industry. Depending on your qualifications and professional experience, we are happy to offer a higher salary.

At Silhouette, your ideas have the opportunity to become reality - from the first sketch to prototype and, ultimately, to a finished collection. With three brands and distinct design worlds, you will find a broad playground for creativity, ranging from precision and lightness to performance and contemporary expression. Design and technology go hand in hand. You will work closely with experts from R&D, prototyping and production, gaining first-hand insight into how exceptional eyewear is developed and manufactured. We offer an international and dynamic working environment with room to take ownership, contribute your ideas and grow both professionally and personally. Depending on your preferred location, the position can be based in Linz or Vienna, with flexible hybrid and home-office options. Beyond the role itself, you can look forward to a range of benefits, including team events, fitness offers, professional and personal development opportunities, a subsidized healthy company restaurant, modern office spaces and a unique global company culture. Ready to shape the future of eyewear with us? Upload your application and portfolio via our online career portal at silhouette-international.com/karriere. For any questions, please feel free to contact Katrin Kappelmüller at +43 732 3848-843.

jobs.title: Endear - Product Designer
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Senior Controller
jobs.description:
Senior Controller

Work tasks: As part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in the areas of packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, as well as one of the world’s largest privately owned forest owners. We believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future.
Our company employs approximately 19,000 people. Our global Finance Operations unit handles accounting activities and provides financial services across a range of areas. In the world of finance, we value accuracy, collaboration and innovation. Career for a better climate. Every day. Your Responsibilities as a Senior Controller Act as a Finance Business Partner for a business area/business unit, legal entity or group function. Lead or support controlling and financial reporting processes for the entity/function within your area of responsibility. Be responsible for the effective and accurate period-end closing, analysis and reporting activities of the entity/function. Contribute to and support the implementation and management of an efficient and accurate forecasting and budgeting process within the entity/function. Represent the entity/function in queries related to other Finance Operations processes, including Record to Report (RtR), Purchase to Pay (PtP) and Order to Cash (OtC). Ensure the implementation and compliance with Stora Enso’s financial processes and policies within the entity/function. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement, make recommendations and lead changes to continuously improve and harmonise end-to-end controlling processes. Lead and support process automation and other development projects. Ensure close collaboration and effective information flow between the entity/function, the Finance department and key stakeholders across other functions. Support and train stakeholders on controlling-related topics. What We Expect from You A Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in controlling, management reporting or accounting. A good understanding of controlling processes, including period-end closing, operational financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting. jobs.title: Security Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
About the role

Our Security team protects Swile's products, data and engineering platform. We work with a simple principle: when something is recurring, we automate it, and when a security requirement can become code, we write the code.

As a Security Engineer Intern, you will not shadow the team, you will be part of it. You will handle real alerts, run your own audits and own projects end to end, with a dedicated mentor in the team throughout your internship.

What you will do

Detection and response

  • Handle day to day security alerts: triage, investigate, qualify, escalate when needed.
  • Improve what we detect: reduce noise, close detection gaps, propose new signals.
  • Automate the recurring: when an alert or a manual check keeps coming back, script it away. This is where we expect you to leave a mark.

Security audits

  • Run targeted audits, from a few days to a few weeks, on applications, configurations or third party providers.
  • Turn findings into a prioritised remediation plan rather than a list of tickets.

Projects you will own

  • Ad hoc security projects across the engineering platform.
  • Security review and hardening of the tools and integrations we rely on (Dust, third party providers, internal integrations).

Fraud

  • Support fraud investigations: dig, follow the trail, understand how an abuse pattern works and how we could detect it earlier.

What we are looking for

This is an internship, so how you think matters more than what you already know.

  • You learn fast and you are genuinely curious about security.
  • You are a doer: you answer quickly, you close loops, you do not let things sit.
  • You are pragmatic: you calibrate your response to the actual level of urgency and risk, and you know that not everything is a P1.
  • You are open minded and comfortable asking questions across engineering teams.
  • You are comfortable working in English, written and spoken.
  • You have some scripting ability (Python or equivalent) and a basic understanding of web applications, APIs and cloud environments.

Nice to have that would make you stand out

  • Personal projects, CTFs, homelab, bug bounty or security writeups.
  • First exposure to a SIEM, to detection rules or to log analysis at scale.
  • Curiosity for fraud and abuse patterns in a financial product.

What this internship is not

  • Not a pure GRC, compliance or policy writing internship.
  • Not a pentest internship.
  • Not a role where you watch dashboards without changing them.

Practical details

  • Location: Paris preferred.
  • Duration and start date: 3-6 months internship, ASAP or from January 2027
  • Mentor: a Security Engineer from the team.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, User Database Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

You’ll build the systems that let any knowledge worker leverage fast, scalable databases without having to become a DBA.

You’ll be a hands-on technical leader, helping set the architectural direction and roadmap as we take a new product from early alpha to general availability. You’ll work directly with early customers to shape foundational technical and product decisions. Then, together, we’ll work on scaling as adoption and workloads grow.

This is a backend-leaning role with work spanning the stack. You might build the systems that provision and manage a fleet of customer Postgres instances, design how user-defined schemas evolve safely, or make complex queries execute efficiently. You’ll also follow those systems into the product: improving how a table loads, how users understand a slow operation, or how an agent safely works with their data.

You’ll help shape the architecture and the product together. Some problems call for a better abstraction, others for a better default, and others for rethinking what we ask the user to do in the first place. You’ll work with teammates and customers to find those answers, ship practical solutions, and evolve them as usage grows.



Our stack includes Postgres, Go, TypeScript, Node.js, and React.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

The people who understand a business best aren’t always the people who can build its software. A support lead knows how tickets should be triaged. An operations manager knows how inventory should move. But turning that knowledge into a reliable system often means finding an engineer, provisioning a database, and building an application.

We’re building database infrastructure for everyone else. We want everyday knowledge workers to bring their data into Notion, connect it, and build workflows around it. And do so with the power of a real database (Postgres!) and the approachability of a tool they already know.

AI agents make that opportunity even bigger: helping people build and operate systems they couldn’t have created on their own.

For our team, this is much more than putting a friendly interface on Postgres. It means making hard database problems disappear from the user’s workflow without sacrificing correctness, performance, or flexibility. How do you let someone reshape a live database as easily as editing a document? Make the right indexes exist without asking someone to become a DBA? Let a weekend experiment grow into a company’s system of record without anyone having to rearchitect it?




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take a new product from alpha to general availability. Work with early customers to understand what matters, iterate on feedback, and help shape what we ship.

 - Make real customer workloads fast. Improve query execution, indexing, and client data loading so performance holds up as datasets grow and workflows become more demanding.

 - Build systems businesses can trust with their data. Make schema changes, concurrent writes, permissions, and recovery reliable enough for customers to build essential workflows on top.

 - Make powerful capabilities approachable. Turn database provisioning, migrations, and indexes into a reliable, easy-to-use product experience that gives people the power of a database without the burden of managing one.

 - Build for the customers who come next. Automate database provisioning and fleet operations, strengthen observability, and evolve the architecture so we can serve many, many customers.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Production relational database experience (e.g., Postgres or MySQL). You’ve made decisions about schemas and indexes, analyzed database performance, and debugged issues involving transactions, locking, or concurrency. Your experience goes beyond accessing a database through an ORM.

 - Engineering experience and technical leadership. You bring 10+ years of experience building and operating production software, with a track record of setting technical direction and leading complex, cross-team initiatives from concept through delivery. You identify the most important problems to solve, turn ambiguous goals into a technical strategy, and align engineers and partner teams around a practical plan. You stay hands-on while helping others make better decisions through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical guidance.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals. You’ve built services that need to remain correct under concurrency and failure. You can reason about retries, partial failures, consistency, and the trade-offs involved in reliable reads and writes.

 - A systematic approach to performance. You use query plans, traces, profiles, and experiments to find bottlenecks and verify improvements. You’re willing to follow a problem across storage, services, and client code rather than stopping at a team boundary.

 - Product judgment. You’re interested in who will use what you build, not just how it works. You can turn a customer’s problem into a technical approach and recognize when a better default or simpler workflow would solve it more effectively.

 - Willingness to work across the stack. You bring backend depth, but you’re comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and working in client code when that’s what delivering a good experience requires.

 - Fluency with AI-assisted engineering. You use AI to accelerate exploration, implementation, and testing while taking responsibility for understanding and validating the result.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience managing fleets of databases or building database platforms, including provisioning, upgrades, backups, and recovery.

 - Deep Postgres expertise, such as advanced query optimization, performance tuning, or workload isolation for large datasets and high-concurrency workloads.

 - Experience building query layers, sync engines, change-data-capture pipelines, permission systems, or other reusable data abstractions.

The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $299,000 – $334,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About agentmama

We build AI agents that audit and optimize e-commerce advertising. Our platform syncs live data from Google Ads, Meta, Merchant Center, and Google Analytics, runs it through a rule engine, LLM-powered audit agents, and our own prediction models, and turns the findings into concrete actions marketers can apply with one click.

We're a small team shipping fast on a modern, strictly-typed stack. You'd be one of a handful of engineers reporting directly to the CTO, which means real ownership: features you design end-to-end, from the Prisma schema to the React component, ship to customers within days.

What you'll do

    

Design and build features across our TypeScript monorepo — tRPC procedures and NestJS services on the backend, React on the frontend.

    

Extend our integration workers that sync campaign, product, and analytics data from the Google and Meta APIs via Cloud Pub/Sub pipelines.

    

Work on the AI audit agent: prompt design, rule evaluation, and the plumbing that turns LLM output into reliable, deduplicated actions — across multiple model providers, not just one.

    

Help productionize our in-house prediction models: wiring their output into the rule engine and keeping training data and evaluation pipelines healthy.

    

Evolve the data model in PostgreSQL/Prisma and keep migrations, multi-tenancy, and role-based access clean as the product grows.

    

Own quality: write Jest tests alongside your code, review PRs, and help keep our CI/CD pipeline to Cloud Run fast and boring.

Our stackBackend

TypeScript · Node.js NestJS + Fastify tRPC · Zod Prisma · PostgreSQL

Frontend

React · Vite End-to-end types via tRPC

Infrastructure

Google Cloud Run · Pub/Sub Docker · GitHub Actions pnpm workspaces · Turborepo

AI & integrations

Multiple LLM providers In-house prediction models Google Ads · Meta Merchant Center · GA4

What we're looking for

    

5+ years building production web applications, with strong TypeScript on both server and client.

    

Solid relational database instincts — schema design, migrations, and query performance in PostgreSQL (Prisma experience is a plus).

    

Experience with event-driven or queue-based architectures (Pub/Sub, SQS, Kafka, or similar) and the failure modes that come with them.

    

A habit of testing: you write tests because they let you move faster, not because someone told you to.

    

Pragmatic product sense — you ask why before how, and you'd rather ship a focused feature than a perfect abstraction.

Nice to have

    

Hands-on work with LLM APIs in production — prompting, evals, structured output, cost control, and switching between providers.

    

Applied ML experience: training, evaluating, or serving prediction models alongside product code.

    

Familiarity with the Google Ads, Meta, or Merchant Center APIs, or ad-tech / e-commerce domain experience.

    

NestJS, tRPC, or GCP (Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Workload Identity) in a previous role.

How we work

jobs.title: Video Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description:

Lorex Labs specializes in verification, validation, and value optimization for unique AI solutions. The company helps organizations build AI systems that outperform competitors by focusing on measurable impact and trustworthiness. Lorex Labs supports clients in accelerating development velocity and improving the reliability of machine learning models. By unlocking actionable insights, the company enables real-world performance gains across diverse AI applications.

About the role:

Join our Media Lab team at Lorex Labs, where you will contribute to real-life, state-of-the-art technology to improve video quality in real time communications. We are looking for a talented and driven individual to work on video signal processing and HW/SW technologies. The role focuses on evaluating, testing, and improving video quality for real time communication in videoconferencing applications, including the evaluation of machine learning models. The work involves algorithm validation and testing, video quality evaluation, bug investigation, and contributing to the development of innovative products. By joining us, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies in a collaborative and supportive team environment. We offer potential for growth and development, and the chance to contribute to a company that values diversity and innovation.

Responsibilities:

    Evaluate machine learning models for video quality.
    Conduct performance analysis and optimization of video algorithms and processing pipelines for real time communication optimization.
    Perform video quality evaluations and subjective analysis across various applications, use cases and devices.
    Measure and analyze video characteristics, performance and quality on different operating systems and devices.
    Develop and maintain evaluation pipelines and dashboards for video testing.
    Document and communicate test results and debugging processes in reports.
    Provide technical support for video systems using different lab set-ups and video tools.
    Contribute to the development of innovative products.

Required Qualifications:

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Image Analysis, Machine Learning, or a related field.
    Background in video signal processing.
    Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) technologies.
    Proficiency in coding with C++ and/or Python.
    Familiar with video systems and technologies.
    Ability to set up and conduct lab experiments and evaluations.
    Strong technical skills and a willingness to learn new technologies.
    Excellent teamwork, communication and collaboration abilities.
    Great problem-solving and analytical skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

    Knowledge of embedded systems and OS.
    Experience with various video devices used in communication systems.

Job characteristics:

    Location: Stockholm
    Job type: Hybrid
    Number of positions: 1

How to apply:

Please send an email with your CV to careers@lorexlabs.com with the subject: Video Quality Engineer. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
