jobs.title: Quality & Operations Lead
jobs.description:
About ZRO Imaging AB

ZRO Imaging is a specialized imaging Contract Research Organization (CRO) focused on neuroimaging and biomarker-driven clinical research in neurodegenerative diseases. We partner with biopharmaceutical companies, diagnostic developers, and academic research groups to support the development of new therapies and biomarkers.

Our team combines expertise in PET imaging, MRI, quantitative image analysis, biomarkers, clinical research operations, and quality management to deliver high-quality scientific and operational support for clinical studies.

The Role

As ZRO Imaging’s clinical research activities continue to expand, we are looking for a Quality & Operations Lead to join our team. The role combines quality management with clinical research operations. You will be responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality and operational processes supporting ZRO Imaging’s clinical research, imaging, and biomarker activities.

You will work closely with ZRO Imaging’s scientific and imaging teams, clinical sites, clients, research institutions, vendors, and other external partners.



Required Qualifications

    PhD or equivalent advanced academic qualification in biomedical sciences, life sciences, or a related scientific discipline
    Advanced understanding of biomedical and clinical research
    Experience with clinical research operations and complex research documentation
    Ability to understand scientific and technical requirements relevant to imaging, biomarkers, and clinical research
    Experience with clinical research quality systems, including SOPs, controlled documentation, and regulatory requirements
    Ability to work effectively across scientific, clinical, quality, and operational functions
    Strong organizational and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail
    Strong scientific and technical writing skills
    Professional proficiency in English



Meritorious Qualifications

    Experience coordinating clinical sites, vendors, or external research partners
    Experience working in multidisciplinary and international research environments

Key Responsibilities

    Continued development and maintenance of ZRO Imaging’s Quality Management System (QMS)
    Development, implementation, maintenance, and periodic review of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and associated controlled documentation
    Coordination of operational activities for clinical imaging and biomarker projects
    Development and implementation of standardized processes for project initiation, execution, documentation, and close-out
    Coordination of vendors and external research partners
    Support for regulatory and quality compliance applicable to clinical research and imaging activities
    Coordination of training and documentation required for consistent implementation of company procedures
    Contribution to data governance, information management, and data protection processes in coordination with relevant specialists
    Coordination of operational and quality activities across the organization
    Development of scalable operational processes and infrastructure as the company’s activities expand



Practical Information

    Employment type: Full-time, permanent employment
    Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
    Work arrangement: On-site
    Language: English (working language); Swedish is meritorious but not required
    Start date: By agreement
    Salary: Fixed monthly salary

How to apply:

All applications, including your CV and a brief cover letter, must be submitted via hello@zroimaging.com, with "Quality & Operations Lead" in the subject line.

Applications submitted through other channels will not be considered. If you have any questions about the role, please also use hello@zroimaging.com.

jobs.title: Project & Customer Service medewerker
jobs.description:
Ben jij een organisatorisch talent met een passie voor klantencontact en administratie? Hou je ervan om verschillende dossiers te coördineren en steeds het overzicht te bewaren? Dan is deze veelzijdige functie bij een groeiende internationale organisatie in regio Roeselare iets voor jou. Interesse? Lees snel verder en solliciteer!

Wat zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden als project & customer service medewerker?
  • Je volgt verschillende klantendossiers van A tot Z op.
  • Coördinatie van planningen, interventies en lopende projecten.
  • Klanten telefonisch en schriftelijk verder helpen met hun vragen.
  • Je maakt offertes op en zorgt voor een correcte administratieve verwerking.
  • Contracten, afspraken en projectgegevens nauwkeurig beheren.
  • Afstemming met klanten, techniekers en interne afdelingen.
  • Je bewaakt de voortgang en zorgt dat acties tijdig worden opgevolgd.
  • Verschillende dossiers tegelijk beheren en de juiste prioriteiten bepalen.
  • Een klantgerichte en collegiale aanpak staat centraal in je dagelijkse werking.

Onze klant
Als project & customer service medewerker kom je terecht in een internationaal bedrijf regio Roeselare. Hun doel? Inzetten op het creëren van een gezondere leefomgeving. Deze organisatie kent een voortdurende groei en heeft het oog steeds op de toekomst en verdere expansie. Als werkgever vinden ze het belangrijk dat er open communicatie heerst en er opleiding worden voorzien, rekening houdende met een goede work-life balance. Wie ben jij als project & customer service medewerker?
  • Je beschikt over een bacheloropleiding of hebt een gelijkwaardig niveau opgebouwd via ervaring.
  • Ervaring binnen een administratieve of klantgerichte functie is een sterke troef.

DIRECTEUR / DIRECTRICE D'HÔTEL - SAISON D'HIVER (H/F)
jobs.description:
**Entreprise**

Madame Vacances est un acteur majeur de l'hôtellerie et des résidences de tourisme en France, proposant des séjours dans des destinations variées, de la montagne à la mer. Rejoindre nos équipes, c'est partager notre passion pour l'accueil et contribuer chaque jour à offrir à nos clients des vacances inoubliables.

**Poste**

**Des clients heureux, des équipes heureuses, avant tout**

Nos Directeurs d'hôtel vivent et respirent la satisfaction client. Ils savent qu'un service exceptionnel repose sur toute une équipe partageant la même philosophie : nos clients consacrent un budget important à leurs vacances et méritent un excellent séjour.

**Contrat, rémunération et conditions**

Pour la saison d'hiver, nos Directeurs commencent généralement autour du 1er décembre et terminent environ une semaine après la fermeture de l'hôtel. Ils bénéficient d'un contrat cadre, avec l'autonomie et la flexibilité liées à leurs responsabilités. Le logement est fourni pendant toute la durée du contrat. Une prime de fin de saison peut être attribuée selon les performances.

Rémunération mensuelle indicative selon l'expérience et l'établissement :

- Plus de 65 chambres : 4 000 à 4 500 € brut, ou 6 000 à 6 500 € pour un couple assurant ensemble la direction.

- 40 à 65 chambres : 3 300 à 3 800 € brut, ou 5 000 à 6 000 € pour un couple.

- Hôtels plus petits : 2 500 à 3 300 € brut, ou 4 500 à 5 200 € pour un couple.

**Profil et responsabilités**

Nos Directeurs arrivent dans un hôtel préparé pour la saison : personnel recruté, fournisseurs référencés, produits et services définis et organisation mise en place. Leur mission est de faire fonctionner cette organisation efficacement, tout en assurant les dernières ventes localement lorsque des chambres restent disponibles.

Ils consacrent l'essentiel de leur temps aux clients et aux équipes : organisation des plannings, management des responsables de service, communication avec le siège, suivi du reporting et présence active dans l'établissement.

Dans un hôtel, les imprévus font partie du quotidien : absences, problèmes techniques, neige, arrivées tardives, clients difficiles ou services particulièrement chargés. Nos Directeurs sont donc avant tout des personnes de terrain, capables de retrousser leurs manches lorsque nécessaire.

Cela peut signifier aider au bar, faire la plonge, préparer des chambres avec l'équipe housekeeping, déneiger une terrasse, porter des bagages ou prendre personnellement en charge un client rencontrant un problème.

Ils dirigent par l'exemple, assument leurs responsabilités et trouvent des solutions sans attendre systématiquement l'intervention du siège.

Ils veillent à ce que les équipes soient ponctuelles, professionnelles, correctement présentées et pleinement tournées vers le client. Ils gèrent les problématiques RH quotidiennes, assurent la bonne organisation des plannings et veillent à une excellente communication entre les différents services.

Qu'ils excellent dans la délégation ou préfèrent être très présents sur le terrain, nos Directeurs savent intervenir personnellement lorsque la situation l'exige.

**Ce qui compte, c'est le résultat**

jobs.title: Business Operations & Strategy
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an opportunity to serve as a key partner and advisor on Notion’s Business Operations team, working primarily with our Engineering, Product, & Design teams. Business Operations is a cross-functional team that partners with senior leaders across the company, focusing on high-impact strategic projects and analysis. In this role, you’ll work hand-in-hand with leadership to identify, structure, and act on the most challenging strategic and operational questions impacting our business.



This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Build trusted relationships with cross-functional leaders to define and implement strategy across all Notion products, driving increased value to our users and our business

 - Structure complex, ambiguous strategic problems for the Notion leadership team, defining clear hypotheses and building detailed business cases and quantitative models that will inform and influence our approach

 - Work closely with cross-functional leaders to define and manage key drivers of business performance, identifying areas of opportunity and incorporating them into your work

 - Develop a comprehensive understanding of our competitive positioning by using, assessing, and developing insights about peer businesses to inform your recommendations

 - Deeply understand Notion customers and the broader market landscape to uncover insights that inform your recommendations

 - Create scalable solutions that combine a broad vision for what is possible with an understanding of the practical demands that constrain them




SKILLS YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of strategy experience, including 2+ years of experience in management consulting or a related field

 - Excellent quantitative and financial modeling skills, with the attention to detail and quality bar required for decisions that affect products and the business

 - Outstanding executive-level written and verbal communication skills; can operate independently with senior stakeholders and manage relationships, deliverables, and timelines with minimal supervision

 - Genuine enthusiasm for and proficiency with AI tools; we use AI across the board to move faster and work smarter, and you do too

 - Hands-on fluency with modern AI tools such as Notion AI, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar; you actively experiment with new models and workflows and use judgment to apply them responsibly

 - Data self-sufficiency, including working knowledge of SQL and the ability to access, assess, and synthesize relevant data without relying on outside support

 - Comfort working in a high-growth, constantly changing environment with passion and enthusiasm




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in strategy and operations in B2B SaaS businesses

 - Experience with pricing & packaging, especially for AI products



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Pistoolspuiter

<p>Als pistoolspuiter (natlak) sta je, samen met je team, in voor het voorbereiden en spuiten van de haarden en maatconcepten in staal.</p><ul><li>De voorbereiding bestaat uit deels manueel ontvetten en anderzijds het aansturen van de automatische ontvettingslijn.</li><li>Het spuitwerk gebeurt met natlak waarbij zowel hittebestendige lak als een structuur afwerkingslak wordt gebruikt, afhankelijk van de toepassing. Dit is ook direct de eindafwerking van de metalen constructies en onderdelen.</li><li>U voert een visuele controle uit van de gespoten stukken alvorens deze naar de volgende afdeling gaan.</li></ul>
<![CDATA[<ul><li>Ervaring als pistoolspuiter of natlakker is een must</li><li>Kennis van natlak wordt gezien als een extra pluspunt</li><li>Oog voor detail en precisie: je streeft naar een perfect eindresultaat</li><li>Georganiseerd, ordelijk en punctueel in je werk</li><li>Je kan zowel zelfstandig werken als goed functioneren in teamverband</li><li>Woonachtig binnen een straal van 30 km rond Evergem en vlot mobiel</li><li>In goede fysieke conditie en flexibel ingesteld qua taken</li></ul>

jobs.title: Metser
jobs.description:
<p>Ben jij een vakman met passie voor nieuwbouwprojecten? Voor onze klant , actief in de regio Maldegem, zijn wij op zoek naar gemotiveerde <strong>metsers</strong> om hun team te versterken.</p><p><strong>Wat ga je doen?</strong></p><p>Je werkt samen in een ploeg van <strong>2 tot 4 collega’s</strong>.</p><p>Je voert voornamelijk <strong>nieuwbouwwerken</strong> uit (metselwerk, ruwbouw, voorbereidingen).</p><p>Je vertrekt samen met je ploeg vanuit het atelier binnen een <strong>straal van 20 km rond Maldegem</strong>.</p>
<![CDATA[<p>Wat verwachten we van jou?</p><ul><li>Ervaring als metser of een opleiding in de bouw.</li><li>Teamspirit: je werkt graag samen en kan rekenen op je collega’s.</li><li>Je geraakt dagelijks in <strong>Maldegem</strong> (standplaats).</li></ul>

jobs.title: Technieker
jobs.description:
<p><br>Onze klant is gespecialiseerd in het ontwerpen, fabriceren en leveren van hoogwaardig inox maatwerk en professionele keukens. Voor onze klanten plaatsen wij volledige nieuwe keukens én bieden wij service en onderhoud op bestaande installaties.</p><p><strong>Jouw functie</strong><br> </p><ul><li>Als technieker bij onze klant  ben je verantwoordelijk voor:</li><li>Het installeren van toestellen en plaatsen van volledige inox keukens.</li><li>Uitvoeren van onderhoud en depannages bij klanten.</li><li>Werken met gas-, water- en elektriciteitsaansluitingen.</li><li>Oplossingsgericht werken en logisch nadenken bij technische uitdagingen.</li><li>Je werkt steeds <strong>op verplaatsing in West- en Oost-Vlaanderen</strong>, in dagdienst.</li></ul>
<![CDATA[<p><strong>Jouw profiel</strong></p><ul><li>Je bent handig en hebt feeling met techniek.</li><li>Basiskennis van elektriciteit, gas en water is een groot pluspunt.</li><li>Je kan zelfstandig werken en je plan trekken.</li><li>Je bent leergierig: een interne opleiding wordt voorzien.</li><li>Zowel ervaren techniekers als junior profielen met de juiste ingesteldheid zijn welkom.</li><li>Je spreekt vlot Nederlands.</li><li>je hebt een rijbewijs </li></ul>

jobs.title: Field technieker
jobs.description:
<p>Voor onze klant regio Evergem zijn we op zoek naar een field technieker.</p><p>Een <strong>Field technieker</strong> (ook wel service technieker genoemd) is iemand die <strong>machines installeert, onderhoudt en herstelt op locatie bij klanten</strong>.</p><p> Wat doet een Field technieker concreet?</p><ul><li>Je <strong>onderhoudt en herstelt industriële machines</strong> zoals pompen, tandwielkasten en ventilatoren.</li><li>Je werkt <strong>deels in de werkplaats</strong>, maar vooral <strong>bij klanten ter plaatse (on-site)</strong>.</li><li>Je voert <strong>revisies</strong> uit: machines demonteren, controleren, onderdelen vervangen en terug opbouwen.</li><li>Je doet <strong>installaties en uitlijning</strong> van machines bij klanten (belangrijk voor correcte werking).</li><li>Je bent vaak <strong>het gezicht van het bedrijf</strong>, omdat je rechtstreeks met klanten werkt.</li></ul>
<![CDATA[<p>Wat krijg je ervoor terug?</p><p>Je voordelen tonen dat het een typische technische buitendienstfunctie is:</p><ul><li>Goed loon + vergoeding voor reistijd</li><li>Bedrijfswagen + tankkaart</li><li>GSM/tablet</li><li>Verzekeringen en extra’s (ecocheques, ADV-dagen)</li><li>Opleidingen → je kan blijven bijleren</li><li>Informele sfeer (soep, fruit, jong team)</li></ul>

jobs.title: Chauffeur ruimdienst
jobs.description:
<p>Voor onze klant die is actief in industriële reiniging en gespecialiseerde reinigingsdiensten, onder andere voor bedrijven en installaties zijn we  op zoek naar een grondzuigmachinist.</p><p><strong>Wat ga je doen?</strong></p><ul><li>Je bestuurt onze grondzuigwagen – hoogtechnologisch materiaal in actie.</li><li>Je verwijdert zand, aarde en puin op een veilige, efficiënte en nauwkeurige manier.</li><li>Je bent het aanspreekpunt op locatie.</li><li>Je werkt ordelijk en communiceert duidelijk met collega’s en klanten.</li></ul><p> </p>
<![CDATA[<p>Wat heb je in je mars:</p><ul><li>Je beschikt minstens over een rijbewijs C. Heb je een rijbewijs CE? Dat is een pluspunt. Nog niet? Dan voorzien wij opleiding.</li><li>Je hebt technisch inzicht; ervaring met kranen is een extra troef.</li><li>Je spreekt en begrijpt vlot Nederlands (belangrijk voor communicatie en veiligheid).</li><li>Je bent fysiek in staat om mee te werken op de werf (zoals het koppelen van buizen).</li><li>Je bent een teamspeler en past in een open, collegiale werksfeer.</li></ul>

jobs.title: Meewerkende Teamleader Natuursteen & Composiet
jobs.description:
<p>Ben jij iemand die graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt en tegelijk verantwoordelijkheid neemt op de werf? Voor een sterk familiebedrijf met een rijke traditie sinds 1922 zoeken we een <strong>meewerkende teamleader</strong> voor de plaatsing van natuursteen en composiet.</p><h4><strong>Over het bedrijf</strong></h4><p>Dit bedrijf is gespecialiseerd in het verwerken, afwerken en plaatsen van natuursteen en composiet zoals marmer, graniet, kwartscomposiet, keramiek en kalksteen.<br>Ze realiseren maatwerk voor huizen en appartementen: keukenwerkbladen, badkamers, raamtabletten, vloeren, trappen en gevelbekleding.<br>De organisatie kenmerkt zich door <strong>korte communicatielijnen</strong>, een <strong>‘can do’-mentaliteit</strong> en <strong>trots op vakmanschap</strong> — elke medewerker draagt bij aan een kwalitatief eindresultaat.</p><h4><strong>Jouw functie</strong></h4><p>Als <strong>meewerkende teamleader</strong> begeleid je een klein team (2 à 3 personen) bij de plaatsing van keukenwerkbladen, spatwanden en interieuronderdelen.<br>Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een correcte uitvoering op de werf, onderhoudt contact met de klant bij oplevering en helpt actief mee met het tillen, monteren en afwerken van werkbladen.</p>
<![CDATA[<ul><li>Je bent klantgericht, nauwkeurig en zelfstandig.</li><li>Je hebt inzicht in techniek en kan goed meten, aanpassen en vooruitdenken in oplossingen.</li><li>Je beschikt over verantwoordelijkheidszin en werkt vlot samen met collega’s.</li><li>Ervaring met hout- of metaalbewerking is een plus, maar geen vereiste.</li><li>Je spreekt Nederlands en/of Engels en communiceert efficiënt (bijv. via Viber).</li><li>Je bent fysiek in staat om tilwerk uit te voeren.</li><li>Je bent flexibel en oplossingsgericht ingesteld.</li><li>Rijbewijs <strong>B</strong> is vereist; <strong>BE</strong> is een troef.</li><li>Je hebt eventueel ervaring als zelfstandige of in een leidinggevende, uitvoerende functie.</li></ul>

jobs.title: Beeldschermoperator
jobs.description:
<p>onze klant is een gevestigde naam in Eeklo, gespecialiseerd in de productie en distributie van kwalitatieve veevoeders voor runderen en varkens. Al sinds 1974 bouwt dit familiebedrijf aan duurzame relaties met landbouwers in België en Nederland. Binnen het team heerst een warme, familiale sfeer waarin iedereen meedenkt en meewerkt.</p><h3><strong>Wat ga je doen?</strong></h3><p>Als <strong>beeldschermoperator</strong> ben jij het kloppende hart van de productie. Vanuit de controlekamer volg je het volledige productieproces op via het schermsysteem</p><p>Concreet betekent dit dat jij:</p><ul><li>de productie start, opvolgt en bijstuurt via het bedieningsscherm;</li><li>storingen detecteert en kleine technische problemen zelf oplost;</li><li>grondstoffen (automatisch of manueel) toevoegt aan het proces;</li><li>inkomende vrachtwagens met grondstoffen ontvangt en correct inweegt;</li><li>bepaalt in welke silo de grondstof terechtkomt en de juiste leverancier koppelt;</li><li>staalnames uitvoert voor kwaliteitscontrole;</li><li>helpt bij het klaarzetten van vrachtwagens voor belading;</li><li>zorgt dat alles vlot en veilig verloopt in samenwerking met jouw ploeg.</li><li>Je komt terecht in een productieomgeving waar je letterlijk “tussen de actie” staat — een stoffige omgeving schrikt jou niet af, want jij weet dat dit hoort bij echt productiewerk.</li></ul>
<![CDATA[<ul><li>Je hebt een <strong>technische achtergrond</strong> of een sterke interesse in techniek.</li><li>Je bent <strong>nauwkeurig</strong>, <strong>leergierig</strong> en <strong>bereid om bij te leren</strong>.</li><li>Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar <strong>schoolverlaters zijn zeker welkom</strong>!</li><li>Je spreekt en begrijpt goed <strong>Nederlands</strong>.</li><li>Je werkt graag in <strong>ploegen (6u–14u / 14u–22u / 22u–6u)</strong> en bent bereid om af en toe op <strong>zaterdagvoormiddag</strong> te werken. ( 1 zaterdag per maand) </li><li>Je bent <strong>flexibel, betrouwbaar</strong> en houdt van <strong>teamwerk</strong>.</li></ul>

jobs.title: Tuinaanlegger
jobs.description:
<p>Voor onze klant in Kaprijke zoeken we een <strong>ervaren arbeider verhardingen</strong> die graag buiten werkt en kwaliteit levert.</p><p><strong>Wat ga je doen?</strong></p><ul><li>Uitvoeren van diverse verhardingswerken (opritten, terassen, paden, tuinconstructies…)</li><li>Voorbereiden van ondergronden, nivelleren en plaatsen van materialen</li><li>Werken in kleine ploegen op werven verspreid over <strong>Oost-Vlaanderen</strong></li><li>Dagelijks vertrekken vanuit <strong>Kaprijke</strong></li></ul><p> </p>

jobs.title: CNC OPERATOR
jobs.description:
<p><strong>Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:</strong></p><ul><li>Nauwkeurig bedienen van CNC-machines voor het vervaardigen van maatwerkmeubilair.</li><li>Inzetten van andere houtbewerkingsmachines (zoals opdeelzaag, schaafbank, …) wanneer nodig.</li><li>Instellen en controleren van machines volgens technische tekeningen, specificaties en de productieplanning.</li><li>Kwaliteitscontrole uitvoeren tijdens en na de bewerking.</li><li>Flexibel inspringen waar nodig en polyvalent meewerken in het atelier.</li><li>Constructief samenwerken met het productieteam om een vlot en efficiënt productieproces te garanderen.</li></ul><p><strong>Wat maakt de job uniek:</strong></p><ul><li>Je werkt aan volledig maatwerk: elk meubel is uniek en wordt in eigen huis geproduceerd.</li><li>Je vakmanschap heeft een directe impact op het eindproduct en de tevredenheid van onze klanten.</li></ul>
<![CDATA[<p> </p><ul><li>Je hebt een technische opleiding of diploma houtbewerking </li><li>Je hebt bij voorkeur een rijbewijs B.</li><li>Je werkt nauwkeurig, zelfstandig en oplossingsgericht, met oog voor detail en een perfect afgewerkt eindresultaat.</li><li>Je kan vlot overweg met CNC-machines en andere houtbewerkingsmachines.</li><li>Je kent diverse materialen en meetinstrumenten en respecteert steeds de veiligheidsvoorschriften.</li><li>Je bent een teamspeler die helder communiceert en inzet op kwaliteit in elke stap van het proces</li></ul>

jobs.title: Bekister €19-€21/uur

Onze klant investeert hier volop in en verwacht dat jij dezelfde ingesteldheid hebt.</li><li>Je bent in het bezit van een <strong>VCA-attest</strong> of je bent bereid dit te behalen.</li><li>Je hebt een passie voor de bouw en werkt graag in een <strong>klein, hecht team</strong>.</li><li>Je beheerst <strong>basiskennis Nederlands</strong>.</li><li>Een <strong>rijbewijs B</strong> is een pluspunt.</li></ul>

jobs.title: CNC Machine Setter / Operator
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Position: 5-Axis CNC Machine Setter / Operator Company: N & E Precision Engineering Location: Longford, Ireland Salary: €38 to €42K / annum Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Reporting to: Production Manager About the Role N & E Precision Engineering is seeking an experienced 5-Axis CNC Machine Setter / Operator to join our precision engineering team in Longford. The successful candidate will be responsible for setting up, proving out and operating CNC milling machines to manufacture high-precision components in accordance with engineering drawings, specifications and quality requirements. The role will involve working with 3-, 4-, and 5-axis CNC machining, with previous CNC programming experience being a significant advantage. Key Responsibilities • Set up and operate CNC milling machines, including 3-, 4-, and 5-axis equipment. • Prepare tooling, workholding, offsets and machine settings. • Read and interpret engineering drawings, tolerances and GD&T requirements. • Program, edit and prove out CNC programs where required. • Manufacture precision components to the required quality standards. • Carry out first-off and in-process dimensional inspections using appropriate measuring equipment. • Make authorised program and offset adjustments where required. • Maintain accurate setup sheets, tooling lists and production documentation. • Identify and report machine, tooling or quality issues. • Maintain CNC machines and the working area in a clean, safe and organised condition. • Work closely with Production, Quality and Maintenance teams. • Follow all company health and safety and quality procedures. Requirements • Previous experience as a CNC Setter / Operator in a precision engineering or manufacturing environment. • Experience with CNC milling and 4- or 5-axis machining. • Ability to read and understand engineering drawings. • Experience with dimensional inspection and precision measuring equipment. • Good understanding of CNC tooling, offsets and machine setup. • CNC programming experience is a significant advantage. • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety. • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Working Hours The successful candidate may be required to work either: • Day Shift: 8:00 am – 4:30 pm • Evening Shift: 4:30 pm – 1:00 am Shift allocation will depend on operational requirements. Career Opportunity This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced CNC professional to join a precision engineering environment and further develop their 5-axis machining, setup and programming skills. Candidates with previous aerospace or other high-precision manufacturing experience are particularly encouraged to apply. How to apply? Please forward CV to gustavo.cainelli@guspes.com Application Process: We aim to respond to all applicants within 10 working days. If you do not hear from us within this timeframe, please consider your application unsuccessful. We may contact you regarding future opportunities.

jobs.title: Director of Sales, ITS, Europe
jobs.description:
Who is Seyond? 

 
Seyond is a leading global provider of image-grade LiDAR technology, powering a safer, smarter and more mobile world across the automotive, intelligent transportation, robotics and industrial automation sectors. Founded in Silicon Valley with strategically placed research and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Seyond is crafting LiDAR solutions that elevate autonomous driving and fuel the advancement of smart infrastructure development. Our dynamic portfolio – including ultra-long range flagship LiDAR sensor Falcon, mid-to-short range LiDAR sensor Robin and perception service software platform OmniVidi – powers automotive and ITS solutions for partners like NIO, Faraday Future, Exwayz and Hexagon. Currently, over 200,000 Falcon units are in use, and the product continues to be mass-produced today. 

 

Senior Director of Sales, Europe

SIMPL Business Unit — Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)

Seyond

Location: Germany preferred (open to strong candidates elsewhere in Europe)

Reports to: Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business (ex-US/China)

Team: SIMPL Business Unit — LiDAR-based smart intersection and highway detection

Employment type: Full-time

About Seyond SIMPL

SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales to build and lead SIMPL's sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will report directly to Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business, and will sit above SIMPL's country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.

This is a player-coach role. We need someone who has personally carried and exceeded a sales quota — not a candidate whose background is purely sales operations or account management — and who can also recruit, coach, and manage a small, distributed team of regional reps as the European organization scales.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead SIMPL's European sales organization, recruiting, onboarding, and coaching country and regional sales representatives.
  • Personally own and close strategic opportunities while the regional team is being built out, transitioning toward a team-quota model as the organization scales.
  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategy across both SIMPL verticals: urban intersection management and inter-urban highway/tunnel/tolling detection.
  • Manage and grow relationships with European distributors, system integrators, and OEM partners, alongside direct engagement with end-user agencies and pilot customers.
  • Own the European sales pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, maintaining accurate deal ownership, stage progression, and close-date discipline.
  • Represent SIMPL at European trade shows, industry events, and customer meetings.
  • Partner with SIMPL's European engineering team on technical qualification and solution scoping for major opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the Head of Global ITS Business and BU leadership on regional pricing, deal structuring, and strategic account planning.
  • Establish clear rep-level KPIs that balance new-business generation with existing-account growth, supported by weekly activity tracking.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in ITS, smart infrastructure, industrial IoT/sensors, or another technical, tender-driven market.
  • A proven personal quota-carrying track record as an individual contributor — a genuine "hunter," not primarily an account manager or sales-ops leader.
  • Experience building or leading a distributed regional sales team, ideally spanning multiple European countries.
  • Comfort managing both channel relationships (distributors, OEMs, system integrators) and direct end-user/agency sales cycles.
  • Experience navigating public-sector or government tender processes is a strong plus.
  • Fluent English required; German or another major European language is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Nice to Have

  • An existing network in European traffic management, tolling, or highway agencies.
  • Experience selling LiDAR, radar, or other sensor-based detection technologies.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.

Compensation

Competitive base and incentive package, benchmarked to Director-level sales leadership roles in the European technology/industrial sector. Final compensation band to be confirmed following market benchmarking.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Marketplace
jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

jobs.title: Kloakarbejder
jobs.description:
Kloakmedarbejder med erfaring søges - ansøger uden erfaring kommer ikke i betragtning

Vi søger dig, der bor i området omkring Roskilde, Slangerup, Hillerød eller det nordlige Sjælland - du kører ud fra din hjemadresse.

Bor du uden for området, men tænker, at stillingen passer perfekt til dig, så send endelig en ansøgning alligevel – måske er det netop dig, vi står og mangler.

Er du klar til en spændende og varieret hverdag i en virksomhed, der har gang i mange forskellige opgaver?

Vi leder efter dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere, der vil være med til at levere service og løsninger inden for skadedyrsbekæmpelse, kloakopgaver, tv-inspektion og entreprenøropgaver i hele Danmark.

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en virksomhed med 28 ansatte, der arbejder i et dynamisk og udfordrende miljø, hvor ikke to dage er ens. Vi løber stærkt, men vi værdsætter sammenhold og gode kolleger, der støtter hinanden i en travl hverdag.

Vi søger dig, der:

• Der har erfaring med kloakarbejder og gerne uddannet som minimum rørlægger, gerne kloakmester eller anlægsstruktør.

• Har kørekort B eller BE og er klar på at bruge en del tid bag rattet.

• Er kunde- og serviceminded med en høflig og præsentabel fremtoning.

• Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret da du kommer til at køre alene – men også trives i et team.

• Har en positiv indstilling, god ordenssans og er mødestabil.

• Er fleksibel og klar til at håndtere både lange og korte arbejdsdage.

Vi tilbyder:

• Et selvstændigt job med frihed under ansvar.

  • Du bliver tilknyttet fast korrdinator så du er aldrig alene, hvis du får brug for hurtig hjælp.

• Afvekslende opgaver som servicearbejde, montering af rottespær og mindre entreprenøropgaver.

• Firmabil.

• Løn efter aftale, inkl. pension og sundhedssikring.

• 6. ferieuge.

• En arbejdsplads med gode kollegaer og stærkt sammenhold.

• Fri hver anden fredag

Ansøg nu!

Er du klar til nye udfordringer og en hverdag med variation og udvikling?

Send din ansøgning til anjadahl@email.dk eller kontakt os direkte på 51337072 spørg efter Pelle.

Vi ansætter løbende, så vent ikke med at sende din ansøgning – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Iltapäivätoiminnan ohjaaja
jobs.description:
Huvikumpu ry hakee innokasta ja motivoitunutta iltapäivätoiminnan ohjaajaa täydentämään reipashenkistä ja aurinkoista työtiimiä. Huvikumpu ry järjestää perusopetuksen iltapäivätoimintaa Porvoon keskuskoululla.

Meille mieluisa työkaveri olisi reipas ja oma-aloitteinen. Odotamme, että kollegamme on motivoitunut ohjaamaan lapsia monipuolisesti mm. erilaisten kädentaitojen, retkien ja liikunnan parissa. Järjestämme lapsille mielekästä ohjattua toimintaa päivittäin, mutta toki jätämme tilaa myös leikille sekä vapaalle ulkoilulle. Työ on hyvin monipuolista ja antoisaa, varaamme laadun takaamiseksi myös aikaa suunnitteluun mm. kuukausipalavereiden ja tiimipalavereiden muodossa. Yksikön vahvana tukena toimii koordinaattori sekä kaksi palveluntuottajaa.

Ohjaajan tehtävänä on mm. koululaisten iltapäivätoiminnan suunnittelu, toteutus ja ohjaus yhdessä muun työtiimin kanssa. Tehtäviin kuuluu myös yhteydenpito sekä yhteistyö niin kouluun kuin vanhempiinkin. Noudatamme kerhoissamme teema-kuukaudet ajattelua sekä viikko-ohjelmaa, näin takaamme mielekästä ja vaihtelevaa ohjelmaa lapsille. Tärkeä osa laadukasta iltapäivätoimintaamme on ns. maksuton kerhotoiminta, jota suunnittelemme ja toteutamme perheiden ja lasten toiveiden pohjalta.

Järjestämme elokuussa perehdytyspäivät työn aloittamisen tueksi, jonka avulla uusien työntekijöiden on helppo ja mukava aloittaa työt Huvikummussa. Työntekijöistämme pitää huolta Terveystalo ja henkilökuntaamme koulutamme vähintään kaksi kertaa vuodessa pidetyissä koulutuspäivissä. Lisäksi järjestämme työyhteisön virkistyspäiviä muutaman kerran vuodessa, hyvinvoiva työyhteisö on meille sydämen asia.

Työhön sopiva koulutus/ tutkinto voisi olla esim. liikuntaneuvoja, liikunnanohjaaja AMK, aamu- ja iltapäivätoiminnan ohjaaja, artenomi, lähihoitaja, sosionomi, nuoriso- ja vapaa-ajanohjaaja. Katsomme eduksi myös erityisen tuen oppilaiden kanssa työskentelyn taidon. Tehtävään valitun tulee esittää lasten kanssa työskenteleviltä vaadittava rikosrekisteriote.

Jos olet innokas kuulemaan lisää, niin ota rohkeasti yhteyttä! Juuri sinä voit olla meidän uusi työkaverimme.

Hakemuksen ja CV:n voi jättää osoitteeseen: palveluntuottajat@huvikumpury.fi

jobs.title: Orthodontiste (H/F)
jobs.description:
Un établissement médical pluridisciplinaire à Rogliano, en Italie, cherche son nouvel orthophoniste H/F pour un CDI.

Les conditions
- CDI
- Temps plein
- Répartition sur 5 ou 6 jours
- 38 heures par semaine

La structure
Vous rejoindrez un établissement médical pluridisciplinaire implanté à Rogliano, à proximité de Cosenza, en Calabre. L'établissement est spécialisé dans le diagnostic, le traitement, la prévention et la réadaptation, avec une prise en charge personnalisée reposant sur des technologies modernes et une équipe multidisciplinaire. En outre, le service de médecine physique et de réadaptation est conventionné avec le Service national de santé italien et prend en charge les pathologies du système musculo-squelettique et du système nerveux. Les patients bénéficient d'examens d'imagerie réalisés sur place et d'un parcours de rééducation intégrant thérapies manuelles et techniques modernes.

La rémunération
- Rémunération selon la convention collective nationale italienne CCNL AIOP RSA, niveau D2

Les missions
- Prendre en charge les troubles de la communication, du langage, de la parole et de la déglutition
- Évaluer les patients et établir des bilans orthophoniques précis
- Mettre en place des programmes de rééducation personnalisés
- Collaborer avec les équipes médicales et paramédicales dans une approche multidisciplinaire
- Suivre l'évolution des patients et adapter les prises en charge
- Contribuer à la qualité et à la continuité des soins

Les avantages

jobs.title: Supersiivooja, kouluttaja ja esimies

Omenasiivous on uusi digitaalinen siivousalan start-up yritys ja etsimme SINUA mukaan tiimiimme!

Tehtävästä:
Supersiivooja on loistava itse siivoamaan ja lumoaa niin toiset työntekijät, kuin asiakkaat omalla esimerkillään. Hän taitaa kotisiivouksen todennäköisesti niin loistavasti, että jokainen asiakas antaa hänelle 5-tähden arvostelun.

Hän motivoituu mahdollisuudesta saada bonuksia onnistuessaan henkilöstön kanssa fantastisesti, ja tuodessaan kasoittain uusia asiakkaita pelkän maineensa mukana.

- Näyttää omalla esimerkillään, kuinka työ suoritetaan onnistuneesti.
- Ohjaa, opastaa, kouluttaa ja rekrytoi
- Tekee itse myös siivoustyötä ja ottaa osaamisellaan haltuun tärkeät asiakkaat
- Organisoi siivoustoimintaa
- Kommunikoi ja viesti sujuvasti niin asiakkaiden, kuin siivoojien kanssa

Etsimme:
- Olet kokenut siivouksen ammattilainen, joka osaa ottaa haltuun niin siivouskohteen, asiakkaat, kuin työntekijöiden kannustamisen ja motivoinnin
- Pystyy ottamaan haltuun niin kotisiivouskohteen (tällä hetkellä isommalla painoarvolla), kuin yrityssiivouskohteen
- Riittävää suomenkielen ja hyvää englannin kielen taitoa
- Ajokortti tai auto on plussaa, mutta ei välttämätöntä

Tarjoamme:
- Etenemismahdollisuuksia nopeasti kasvavan organisaatiomme kasvaviin rooleihin osaamisesi ja koulutuksesi pohjalta.
- Mahdollisuuden olla osa modernia, digitaalisesti edistyksellistä siivousalan yritystä - joka arvostaa niin asiakkaan-, kuin työntekijän tyytyväisyyttä.
- Palkintoja hyville ja aktiivisille työntekijöille.

Miksi Omenasiivous? Omenasiivous on nuorekas ja energinen yritys joka hakee vahvaa kasvua. Me asetamme asiakkaan ja työntekijän tyytyväisyyden etusijalle, ja uskomme positiivisen panoksen antavien työntekijöiden palkitsemiseen.

Toivomme kuulevamme sinusta pian! Laita hakemus ja cv tänään omppu@omenasiivous.fi

jobs.title: Subject Matter Expert Total Rewards Sweden
jobs.description:
Company description:

At Group People & Culture, a part of Volvo Group, we create the foundation and frameworks for people growth and organizational development, to drive the people agenda that enables the realization of the Volvo Group aspirations through people strategy and commitment. You will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead.

Job description:



Join Our Team as a Subject Matter Expert in Total Rewards at Volvo Group Sweden! Are you passionate about compensation and benefits? Do you want to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of transportation? If so, we invite you to join our dynamic Total Reward, People & Culture team at Volvo Group Sweden. This is your chance to influence the reward and recognition landscape in one of Sweden’s largest and most respected companies, all while working alongside a highly engaged and talented team.

   Who You Are  





We believe you are a forward-thinking professional motivated by the challenge of creating a total reward strategy that meets the evolving needs of our workforce. As an independent team player with ambitious ideas, you are ready to transform those ideas into inspiring and actionable outcomes. Your experience in compensation and benefits across various contexts has equipped you with the skills to drive and develop the rewards area within Volvo Group in Sweden.







Your Mission



At People & Culture Sweden, we strive to be the leading experts in our field. By understanding our business and staying at the forefront of industry trends, we empower the Volvo Group to be an admired, attractive, and safe employer. Our team collaborates across all Volvo Group organizations and brands in Sweden, impacting over 26,000 employees. In this role, you will report directly to the Head of Total Reward Sweden.

     What You Will Do  





As a Total Reward Expert you will collaborate closely with our compensation and benefits team and other functions within People & Culture Sweden. Your responsibilities will include:








    Developing reward and recognition models, policies, tools, and guidelines.
    Managing and reviewing benefits and salary structures.
    Leading projects related to employee value propositions, salary reviews, pensions, and international mobility.
    Staying ahead of research and trends to ensure our total reward strategies align with business needs.
    Coaching and advising People & Culture Partners on total reward matters.







Key Responsibilities








    Drive and oversee various total reward projects to enhance awareness and improve processes.
    Initiate and support annual activities such as salary reviews and equal pay analyses.
    Collaborate with your colleagues to lead compensation and benefits negotiations at the national level.
    Provide expert advice on compliance and interpretation of national laws and collective agreements.
    Translate business needs into impactful total reward initiatives.

    Profile description:

What We’re Looking For











A Master’s degree in Human Resources or a related field.



Proven senior experience in People & Culture and/or Compensation & Benefits.



Training or experience in leadership, communication, and project management is valuable.



A results-oriented mindset with a strong focus on business and customer needs.



Professional understanding of country laws, regulations, and collective agreements.



Excellent communication skills and the confidence to challenge the status quo.



Proficiency in Excel and/or PowerBI is a plus.



Previous experience in production or industry is advantageous.







The position is based in Gothenburg.











Language Skills: Fluency in both Swedish and English is essential.







Why Join Us?











At Volvo Group, you will be part of a forward-thinking organization that values innovation and collaboration. If you are ready to make a significant impact and grow your career in a supportive environment, we want to hear from you!







For more information, please contact:



Emma Jensen, Head of Total Reward Sweden, phone +46 765 533873



Martin Svensson, Total Reward SME Sweden +46 739 025305



Cecilia Celestian, People & Culture Partner, phone: +46 739 023615















Last application date is October 4th but please send your application as soon as possible as we will review applications continuously.















As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.







We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.















Who we are and what we believe in











Our focus on Inclusion, Diversity, and Equity allows each of us the opportunity to bring our full authentic self to work and thrive by providing a safe and supportive environment, free of harassment and discrimination. We are committed to removing the barriers to entry, which is why we ask that even if you feel you may not meet every qualification on the job description, please apply and let us decide.

jobs.title: VAT Specialist, Financial Control & Accounting, Volvo Group
jobs.description:
Company description:

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.





Job description:



Financial Control & Accounting (FCA) is a part of Group Finance with the responsibility to secure that financial performance is correctly reflected for Business Areas, Truck Divisions, Group Functions and legal entities. FCA also provides local tax administration and compliance as well as global shared services through delivery centers in Accounting Services with quality focused and process efficient service deliveries. We are approximately 1.400 employees with a global footprint in 50+ countries closely integrated with local business operations.

Are you looking to grow your career in tax and take your next professional step in a global environment? You could be our next VAT Specialist, joining our team in Gothenburg.

   What you will do in your new role  





As a VAT Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate and compliant VAT reporting for Swedish Volvo legal entities. Your main responsibilities will include preparing VAT returns and reports, supporting foreign VAT registrations, and handling excise duties. You will work closely with colleagues across the organization, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing.







In this role, you will ensure that all VAT reporting meets Swedish regulations, Swedish GAAP, and internal AB Volvo guidelines and quality standards. You will also actively contribute to the ongoing improvement and digitalization of our VAT compliance processes, helping to drive efficiency and innovation within the department.







If you are passionate about tax compliance, eager to work in a dynamic team, and ready to make a real impact, we look forward to your application!







Your future team



You will be joining the FCA Group & Sweden team of VAT Specialists reporting to the Manager of Tax and VAT Specialists. You will have a broad network of colleagues within FCA and the Volvo Group. You will have a fantastic opportunity to broaden your skills and competencies together with a team of highly skilled and dedicated colleagues. The VAT team is responsible for overall high quality and compliant VAT accounting and reporting. As of today, our team consists of six VAT specialists.

    Profile description:   Who are you?  





To thrive in this role, you bring a professional mindset and a genuine passion for VAT and accounting. You are a person of integrity who can work independently, yet you value collaboration and enjoy being part of a dedicated team. Your strong communication and interpersonal skills enable you to build effective relationships and drive positive change.







You are highly organized and approach challenges with a problem-solving attitude. With your analytical skills, you actively seek opportunities to improve processes and embrace digital solutions, leveraging tax technologies such as Alteryx and Power BI. Your commitment to excellence and team spirit makes you a valuable contributor to our ongoing success.



Qualifications required for the position








    A university degree in Business Administration or a related field.
    At least 3 years of professional experience in accounting, or relevant experience from the Swedish Tax Authorities.
    Strong grasp of financial processes and systems.
    Excellent command of both written and spoken Swedish and English.
    Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 applications.
    Experience with SAP Master Finance is beneficial, but not mandatory.
    Experience or knowledge of excise duties is an asset, though not required.

      We offer:

What’s in it for you?











You will join a team of highly skilled and professional colleagues with the opportunity to build an extensive network within Volvo Group with the possibility to learn, develop and grow. Being part of the Volvo Group will also give you multiple career opportunities. You will become a part of a company culture based on our values Customer Success, Trust, Passion, Change and Performance.















Every day, Volvo Group products and services ensure that people have food on the table, children arrive safely at school and roads and buildings can be constructed. Looking ahead, we are committed to driving the transition to sustainable and safe transport, mobility and infrastructure solutions toward a net-zero society.







Ready for the next move?











This position is based in Gothenburg, Sweden and requires occasional travel.











Last application date is 2026-10-04 but please send your application as soon as possible as we will review applications continuously.











For further information or questions, please contact:



Anna Brorsson, Manager of Tax & VAT Specialists, anna.brorsson@volvo.com



Christina Hagberg, People and Culture Partner, christina.hagberg@volvo.com















We look forward to your application!















As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.











We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Tarjolla tänään - mahtava lauma
Huomio! Olemme yhtä näppärää kollegaa vaille täydellinen lauma.
Senior Specialist, Data Engineer
Tule rakentamaan luotettavaa data-alustaa kanssamme!
Jos sinulle tärkeitä arvoja ovat rehellisyys, avoimuus, luottamus ja turvallisuus - liity laumaan, jossa ammattitaitoasi ja luonnettasi arvostetaan. Haemme nyt Data Engineeria vahvistamaan omaa teknistä kyvykkyyttämme, varmistamaan data- ja integraatioalustan jatkuvuutta sekä vähentämään henkilö- ja toimittajariippuvuutta. Roolissa pääset rakentamaan ratkaisuja, jotka tukevat raportointia, analytiikkaa ja liiketoiminnan päätöksentekoa. IT-Services -tiimimme toimii osana Supply Chain, Systems & Compliance -toimintoa.

Päävastuusi on rakentaa, kehittää ja ylläpitää liiketoiminnan tarvitsemia dataputkia, ETL/ELT-prosesseja ja järjestelmien välisiä integraatioita. Työskentelet tiiviisti Data-tiimimme, integraatioiden operatiivisen tuen, liiketoiminnan, analyytikkojen, konsernin D&T-kollegoiden sekä teknologiatoimittajien kanssa.
Yhteistyössä tiimin ja valittujen toimittajien sekä Compass konsernin D&T kollegoiden kanssa työtehtäviisi kuuluu
- Toteutat datan teknisiä laatutarkistuksia, testauksia ja monitorointia yhdessä muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa.
- Osallistut integraatioiden ja data-alustan tekniseen suunnitteluun sekä arvioit muutosten vaikutuksia, riippuvuuksia ja ylläpidettävyyttä.
- Tuotat ja ylläpidät teknistä dokumentaatiota, kuten tietovirta- ja rajapintakuvauksia, ajo- ja palautusohjeita sekä ratkaisujen elinkaaritietoja.
- Tuet raportointi- ja analytiikkaympäristön teknisten ongelmien ratkaisemista. Raporttien liiketoimintasisältö ja mittarien omistajuus kuuluvat liiketoiminnalle.
- Osallistut toimittajien tekniseen ohjaukseen ja varmistat, että toteutukset noudattavat sovittuja arkkitehtuuri-, tietoturva- ja dokumentointiperiaatteita.
- Osallistut sovelluskehitykseen, automaatioon sekä dataa hyödyntävien AI-ratkaisujen tekniseen mahdollistamiseen.
- Tarvittaessa tuuraat Integrations Coordinatoria ja monitoroit, selvität häiriöiden juurisyitä, toteutat korjauksia ja koordinoit tarvittavat eskaloinnit.
- Käytät tehtävähallintaa, versionhallintaa ja hallittuja julkaisu- sekä muutoskäytäntöjä.
Työpaikkasi on Helsingin Mannerheimintiellä, yrityksemme etätyöpolitiikkaa noudattaen.

Esihenkilönäsi toimii Pekka Hytönen, Head of IT Services.
Tehtävässä menestyminen varmistuu, kun sinulla on:
- Kokemusta SQL:stä, tietokannoista, datan teknisestä käsittelystä ja ETL/ELT -toteutuksista
- Ymmärrystä rajapinnoista, tiedonsiirtomenetelmistä ja järjestelmien välisistä riippuvuuksista.
- Kokemusta pilvipohjaisista data-alustoista, mielellään Microsoft Azure -ympäristöstä.
- Kyky selvittää tuotantohäiriöitä järjestelmällisesti ja viestiä tilanteista selkeästi.
- Analyyttinen, oma-aloitteinen ja yhteistyökykyinen työote sekä vastuu omasta työstä ja tiimin onnistumisesta.
- Suomen ja englannin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.
- Soveltuva tekninen koulutus tai käytännössä hankittu vastaava osaaminen data engineer-, sovelluskehitys- tai integraatiotehtävistä.
Eduksi katsomme:
- Microsoft Fabric-, Azure Data Factory-, Synapse-, Data Lake-, Warehouse- tai Lakehouse-osaamisen.
- Python-, PySpark-, Spark SQL- tai notebook-kehitysosaamisen.
- Power BI:n semanttisten mallien, tietolähteiden ja teknisen toiminnan tuntemuksen.
- CI/CD-, Git-, automaattisen testauksen, monitoroinnin ja DataOps-käytäntöjen osaamisen.
- Datan laadun, lineage-ratkaisujen, käyttöoikeuksien, tietoturvan tai elinkaaren hallinnan tuntemuksen.
- Kokemuksen monitoimittajaympäristöstä tai ravintola- ja monipalvelualasta.

Etsimme tiimiimme yhteistyökykyistä työkaveria, joka kantaa vastuun omasta työstä ja koko tiimin onnistumisesta. Työkielinäsi ovat sekä suomi että englanti.

Ymmärrät kyberturvallisuuden merkityksen ja tiedät turvallisuusparannuksien parissa työskentelyn parhaat puolet.

Tarjolla tänään - mahtava lauma
Koko työtiimisi varmistaa, että saat hyvän perehdytyksen ja että onnistut työssäsi. Saat tueksesi Data & Integrations -tiimin, liiketoiminnan asiantuntijat ja valitut teknologiakumppanit. Työssä pääset kehittämään Compassin data-alustaa, integraatioita ja DataOps-toimintamalleja käytännössä sekä kasvattamaan osaamistasi Microsoftin data- ja analytiikkateknologioissa.
Hae mukaan!
Tehtävä on määräaikainen sijaisuus, kestoltaan noin 1,5 vuotta. Hakuaika on 2.10.2026 saakka, hae mukaan lähettämällä ansioluettelosi ja hakemuksesi, jossa kerrot osaamisestasi tähän tehtävään.
Palkkaus tehtävässä on 4300-4600€/kk, tarkennetaan se osaamisesi ja kokemustaustasi mukaisesti.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Pekka Hytönen puh. 050 4755201. Tavoitat Pekan parhaiten torstaina 24.9. klo 10:30-13, perjantaina 25.9. klo 9-11 tai tiistaina 29.9 klo 10-12 välisenä aikana.

jobs.title: Hepatologist
jobs.description:
At Sahlgrenska University Hospital, we work together to provide the highest quality of care with the patient at the center. Our great commitment and continuous learning make us one of the country's leading university hospitals. We provide everything from county healthcare to national highly specialized care. We focus on the future of healthcare through exciting research. We care about digital skills and everyone's contribution to the digital development. Our work is about using our collected knowledge and experiences together with you – to create value for our patients.

We are transforming healthcare with the ambition of becoming Europe’s leading university hospital by 2032. In partnership with our patients, we work to ensure quality, accessibility, patient safety, research, education, and innovation within an integrated healthcare system across the Västra Götaland Region in Sweden.

Sahlgrenska University Hospital is one of Northern Europe's largest hospitals with over 17,000 colleagues who have different experience and backgrounds.

About us

The Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatology at Sahlgrenska University Hospital (SU) is one of the largest in the Nordic region. We provide emergency and scheduled outpatient care, and have close collaboration with other departments including upper and lower GI surgery, and transplantation surgery.

The department is organized into teams focusing on hepatologic outpatient care, gastroenterologic outpatient care, endoscopy, intestinal failure unit, and an inpatient ward. The department is actively involved in ongoing research across several fields and has a strong emphasis on education, continuing professional development, and the ongoing advancement of clinical services.

What can we offer?

As a Specialist Physician/Senior Consultant at the Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatolgy at Sahlgrenska university Hospital, you will have excellent opportunities for professional development and research. You will work within our subspecialty teams alongside ambitious and friendly colleagues, with close collaboration with the transplantation unit.

The department has a high patient volume, providing extensive opportunities for both clinical practice and research.

Our goal is to provide the highest possible standard of care for our patients. We place great importance on supporting each individual's professional development according to their interests, strengths, and career goals, while also enabling them to influence their working environment.

About the Role

You will work with the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of patients requiring specialized care in hepatology in both emergency and elective settings. Your duties will include working in the outpatient clinic, inpatient ward, and at the liver transplant unit, as well as participation during office hours and on-call duties.

Teaching and supervising less experienced colleagues, medical students, and healthcare professionals is an integral part of the role. You will also be expected to take an active part in the department’s quality improvement, development, and change initiatives, as well as in research activities.

About You

We are looking for a board-certified senior consultant in Gastroenterology and Hepatology with a high level of expertise in hepatology. You should be interested in both your own professional development and contributing to the advancement of care at one of the largest university hospitals in the Nordic region. You work well within a team and have a strong interest in liver disease.

We value strong communication and collaboration skills. You are able to apply newly acquired knowledge in your clinical practice, make sound clinical judgments, and thrive in a fast-paced work environment. We are seeking a motivated and independent individual with the ability and interest to take overall responsibility and place the patient's needs at the center of care.

Ongoing research activities and/or a doctoral degree (PhD) are considered meritorious.

Great emphasis will be placed on personal suitability.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis throughout the recruitment period.

We warmly welcome your application!

Together for the patient - Sahlgrenska Universitetssjukhuset

In the event of recruiting a physician or nurse with a foreign medical license and/or specialist certification, the appointment will be preceded by the necessary process to fulfill the requirements for Swedish licensure and/or specialist recognition.

About Region Västra Götaland

Region Västra Götaland is there for the people of Västra Götaland. We ensure good quality healthcare for everyone. We work towards a sustainable development and growth, a clean environment, an improved public health, a rich cultural life and good communications throughout Västra Götaland.

Region Västra Götaland is actively working to digitize more ways of working. To be part of the digital transformation, you need to have basic skills and be able to use digital tools and services. You know how to search for information, how to communicate and interact digitally, you are also risk-aware and motivated to be part of the development to learn new things.

If you want to know more about Region Västra Götaland, you can visit our introduction to new employees at www.vgregion.se/introduction.  You can also read more in the presentation on Salary, remuneration and benefits – what you will receive as an employee in VGR.

All permanent employees of Region Västra Götaland are assigned wartime postings.

Application

Region Västra Götaland would like you to register your application through the recruitment system. If you have any questions about the advertised job, or if you are unable to register your information in a public system for any reason, please contact the person who advertised the job.

For employment agencies, intermediaries, recruitment agencies and salespeople:

We kindly refrain from direct contact with employment agencies, intermediaries, recruitment agencies and other external actors and sellers of additional job advertisements. Region Västra Götaland has tendered contracts.

jobs.title: Chief of staff/GTM to Raphaël Vullierme (Hexa Partner)
jobs.description:
About Hexa

Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.

We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.

We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. We are passionate about B2B software, particularly AI-native and agentic SaaS, fintech, climate tech, etc.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.


The AI-native vertical at Hexa: WTF

WTF (“Walk The Frontier”) is leading Hexa’s effort at the frontier of AI model and led by Raphaël Vullierme, a repeat founder who built Luko France #1 online home insurer now part of Allianz, previous CEO of OpenJet an uber for private aviation, and started out launching ventures at Rocket Internet. We build companies with Europe’s best founders, global from day zero, with offices in Paris and San Francisco.

We’re building across three theses:

  1. Physical AI / Defense / Infrastructure to answer European sovereignty need.

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
jobs.description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.

Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.

KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars:

1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences.

2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth.

3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper).


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience.

• Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory.

• A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem.

• Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research.

• Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation.

• Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets.

HOW TO APPLY

Please prepare a single PDF file containing:

1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications.

2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above.

3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references.
