jobs.description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

In order to be accepted as a Doctoral Researcher at Hanken, applicants must fulfill the formal admission requirements for PhD studies#_msocom_1: https://www.hanken.fi/en/apply/application/phd-programme/attachments . A Masters

jobs.description:

Position details

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI-Mediated Communication and Collaboration Norms at Work.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

As AI becomes embedded in everyday work, employees increasingly interact with AI agents, but also encounter AI-mediated contributions from colleagues. Messages may be written, filtered or delivered with AI, while autonomous agents increasingly participate in work processes and collaboration.

This doctoral project examines how these developments shape relational aspects of work, (which may include authenticity, trust, social connection, and experiences of loneliness), as people negotiate emerging norms around AI use, disclosure, and appropriate forms of interaction. Through ethnographic research in AI-intensive settings, you will follow relational practices as they evolve over time and identify the mechanisms behind change.

The project will develop evidence-based guidance that supports transparency, social connection and responsible AI use in organisational life. Practitioner outputs include AI- aware communication norms, guidance on disclosure and authenticity in AI-assisted exchanges, and leadership practices that protect social connection and prevent relational deterioration. In addition, the doctoral project is expected to advance scientific knowledge in relation to the doctoral topic.

Your work

- Examine how interactions among people, AI agents and AI-mediated communication shape workplace relationships and collaboration.
- Conduct ethnographic research on how employees make sense of and negotiate AI use in workplace interactions, including norms of disclosure and transparency, and how these processes shape relational aspects of work.
- Identify the mechanisms through which AI-mediated contributions and autonomous agents reshape relational dynamics, and develop evidence-based guidance for responsible and socially sustainable AI use.
- Develop AI-aware communication norms and leadership guidance that protect social connection at work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Emma Nordbäck (emma.nordback@hanken.fi).

jobs.title: Flödesledare montering, Borrmaskinsaffären
jobs.description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vill du ta en nyckelroll i vår produktion och bidra till en säker, effektiv och välfungerande verksamhet? Vi söker nu en flödesledare för vår montering som tillsammans med teamet driver det dagliga arbetet framåt och skapar förutsättningar för säkerhet, kvalitet och hög produktivitet.

Välkommen till Epiroc och Borrmaskinsaffären!

Inom Borrmaskinsaffären ser vi att allt börjar med oss som jobbar här. Vi är idag ca 170 personer som jobbar tvärfunktionellt för att nå våra mål. Vi har ett strukturerat och fokuserat värderingsarbete b la inom inkludering och mångfald som är vägledande i våra beslut och hur vi agerar.

Ditt teamSom flödesledare blir du en viktig del i ett engagerat team som tillsammans strävar efter en trygg och inkluderande arbetsplats. Vi samarbetar och stöttar varandra för att nå mål och att ständigt förbättras inom alla områden såsom säkerhet, kvalitet, leverans och total kostnad. Genom att involvera, engagera och utveckla dina medarbetare, skapar du effektiva team som självständigt bidrar till målen. Du kommer leda ett team/flöde mellan 15- 25 personer och ingå i ledninggruppen för produktionen. Du är direkt underställd Produktionschefen.

Ditt uppdragI din roll som flödesledare ansvarar du för att leda och organisera vår montering och slutprovning av kompletta borrmaskiner.  Vi har en taktad montering (mix-model-line) som du kommer har helhetsansvar för, dvs verksamhetsutveckling kopplad till LEAN är centralt i din roll.

Våra flöden totalt i produktionen är bearbetning, värmebehandling och montering. Därtill har vi alla supporterande flöden som materialhantering, mätrum, underhåll osv. Rollen innebär att strukturera och fördela arbetet inom ditt område, coacha och engagera dina medarbetare och tillsammans med teamet driva ständiga förbättringar. Du är en nyckelperson inom produktionsledningen för borrmaskinsaffären och del av både den dagliga styrningen och det strategiska utvecklingsarbetet. Samarbete och helhetstänk mellan olika funktioner t ex R&D, Lab, Kvalitet och Produktion är också mycket viktigt för verksamheten. Vi ser att det finns stora möjligheter att driva utveckling av vår verksamhet som Flödesledare, dvs för att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha ett stort intresse, driv och förmåga inom förändringsledning.  

Ansvarsområden

Säkerhet och arbetsmiljö• Fånga upp, dokumentera och driva åtgärder kopplade till riskobservationer, tillbud och olyckor.• Vara ett stöd i arbetsmiljö- och TIA-relaterade frågor.• Ta ett delegerat arbetsmiljöansvar inom produktionen.

Personalansvar• Personalansvar för medarbetare vid monteringen.• Ansvara för rekrytering, introduktion, kompetensutveckling, medarbetarsamtal, lönesättning, coachning och rehabiliteringsärenden.• Bidra till att skapa engagemang, utveckling och trivsel i teamet.

Operativ ledning• Leda pulsmöten och förbättringsaktiviteter samt säkerställa effektiva skiftöverlämningar.• Driva kvalitetsarbete och hantera avvikelser tillsammans med verksamheten.• Stödja montörerna i det dagliga arbetet samtidigt som du arbetar med förbättringar och kapacitetsutveckling på längre sikt.• Följa upp produktivitet och analysera produktionsdata för att säkerställa ett faktabaserat förbättringsarbete.• Säkerställa att resurser och arbetssätt används effektivt under skiftet.

Placering och resorTjänsten är placerad i Örebro och rollen är dagtid.

Ansökan och kontaktVälkommen med din ansökan innehållande CV och ett personligt brev.  Ansökningar hanteras löpande, men senast den 2026-09-30 vill vi ha din ansökan.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef eller rekryterare:Åsa Eliasson, Produktionchef Rock Drills Product Line, tel 073-337 80 26, asa.eliasson@epiroc.comMaria Tedsjö, Recruitment Specialist, maria.tedsjo@external.epiroc.com





Profile description:

Din profilVi söker dig som är en naturlig och trygg ledare med stor engagemang för säkerhet och kvalitet. Kommunikationsförmåga och genuint intresse i dina medarbetare med en stor empatisk förmåga är avgörande i denna roll. Det är även viktigt att du är kundorienterad och är öppen, serviceinriktad och har lätt för att samarbeta med olika människor och olika roller inom organisationen.



Du har goda erfarenheter av liknande roll och är van att leda medarbetare inom en teknisk miljö. Goda kunskaper och erfarenhet inom systematiskt arbetsmiljöarbete och förbättringsarbete är centrala. Du behärskar svenska och engelska obehindrat i både tal och skift.

Experience operating asphalt pavers, rollers or other relevant construction equipment is an advantage.

Location

Assignments will be carried out at various customer projects and locations. Travel between different worksites may therefore be required.

jobs.title: Indkøbsansvarlig
jobs.description:
Er du den, der kan sikre, at de rette materialer kommer i hus, og har du mod på en rolle med indkøb og teamansvar som omdrejningspunkt?


Stillingen ved Evapco Europe byder på et bredt ansvar i en veletableret, international vækstvirksomhed, hvor du kan forme din rolle og gøre en forskel.

¤Ansvarsområder

Som supply chain team lead hos Evapco Europe bliver du en vigtig del af indkøbsafdelingen i Aabybro. Du får ansvar for operationelt indkøb, primært ordrebaseret, samt teamledelsen af en shippingmedarbejder/indkøber og to lagermedarbejdere. Strategisk indkøb fylder ca. 30 % i jobbet. Du vil opleve et bredt samarbejde med både salg, produktion, lager og leverandører, og derfor er evnen til at kommunikere bredt en vigtig succesfaktor i jobbet. Virksomheden har ved årsskiftet konverteret til Business Central fra Axapta.

¤Dine arbejdsopgaver:

• Dagligt ordrebaseret indkøb af og kontraktforhandlinger på materialer og råvarer, særligt rustfrit stål, kobber m.m.
• Forecasting
• Logistik og ordretransport
• Dialog og koordinering med leverandører i bl.a. Danmark, Italien og Kina
• Kvartalsvise budget- og prisindekseringsmøder med ledelsen
• Daglig teamledelse samt årlige løn- og medarbejdersamtaler

Du vil i jobbet referere til den europæiske indkøbsdirektør, der er lokaliseret i Italien, og du vil samarbejde med dine kolleger i Belgien og Italien. Der vil være ca. 20 årlige rejsedage, primært i forbindelse med leverandørbesøg.

¤Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du kommer med nogle års erfaring som indkøber, supply chain-ansvarlig eller lignende i en produktions- eller industrivirksomhed. Du trives med operationelt indkøb og synes, det vil være en spændende udfordring at motivere og lede et mindre team.
Som person ser vi gerne, at du er struktureret og selvstændig, og at du kan lide at skabe relationer til både dine leverandører og kolleger.
Koncernsproget er engelsk, så gode kundskaber i både skrift og tale er vigtigt.

¤Evapco tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med en flad struktur, hvor humøret er højt og samarbejdet godt blandt de 65 kolleger på tværs af afdelingerne. Udover dette vil du få løn efter kvalifikationer. Der vil være fokus på din trivsel og udvikling, og der er derfor mulighed for uddannelser og kurser.
Evapco har dansk kontor i Aabybro, nord for Aalborg. Du kan læse mere på: www.evapco.dk

¤Ansøgning


Vi søger en medarbejder, der kan starte hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette i forhold til opsigelsesperiode. Send gerne din ansøgning og dit CV. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte seniorkonsulent Jesper Høgh på tlf. 92 92 16 38.
Denne rekruttering håndteres af Randstad, og alle henvendelser bedes rettet hertil.

¤Om Evapco Europe A/S
Evapco Europe er specialiseret inden for produktion og udvikling af specialdesignede varmevekslere til en lang række brancher inden for bl.a. energi-, fødevare- og industrisektoren. Evapco Europe har fabrikker i Italien, Belgien og Danmark og er en del af en større global organisation med hovedsæde i Taneytown, Maryland, USA. Evapco Europe blev grundlagt i 1992 som Flex Coil, blev i 2009 opkøbt af amerikanske Evapco og består i dag af samlet 3.000 dygtige kolleger. Man har vækstet støt de senere år, og det forventes at fortsætte i de kommende år.

¤Om Randstad
Hos Randstad hjælper vi mennesker og virksomheder med at udnytte deres fulde potentiale. Vi kombinerer viden med moderne teknologi for at skabe forandringer, der hjælper mennesker fremad. Vi kalder det Human Forward.
Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group, som er verdens største udbyder af HR-løsninger. Med over 4.700 kontorer fordelt på 39 lande formidler vi hver dag arbejde til mere end 650.000 mennesker verden over.
I Danmark er vi blandt de førende vikar- og rekrutteringsbureauer med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding. En position, vi har opnået, fordi vi som eksperter på arbejdsmarkedet formår at matche kvalificerede kandidater med de rette jobmuligheder.

jobs.title: Technicien / Technicienne de hot line en informatique
jobs.description:
Enreach for Service Providers développe la plateforme UCaaS sur laquelle les opérateurs télécoms à travers l'Europe font fonctionner leurs communications professionnelles. Nous sommes environ 60 personnes basées à Sophia-Antipolis, membres du groupe Enreach. Notre logiciel est utilisé par des centaines de milliers d'utilisateurs de téléphonie professionnelle. Ici, le support n'est pas une simple fonction de déviation d'appels. C'est le point de contact où la plateforme rencontre la réalité du terrain.

Vos missions :
Être en première ligne : répondre à la hotline de support, qualifier les tickets Jira entrants et effectuer le premier diagnostic réel de chaque problème avant qu'il ne soit transmis ailleurs. C'est vous qui décidez de l'urgence.
Accompagner nos partenaires EUPCloud : nos partenaires SaaS ne disposent pas de leurs propres équipes opérationnelles. Ils comptent sur nous. Vous travaillerez directement avec eux - via Jira, les canaux Teams, le téléphone - pour les guider dans la configuration et les aider à comprendre leur propre plateforme. Cette partie du rôle est nouvelle, et c'est la raison pour laquelle nous recrutons.
Savoir gérer efficacement :  lorsqu'un problème dépasse le niveau L1, vous le documentez correctement et assurez le suivi jusqu'à sa résolution. Ici, on ne se contente pas de traiter des tickets à moitié diagnostiqués.
Documenter les procédures : tout problème que vous résolvez deux fois aurait dû être documenté une fois. Notre base de connaissances est le levier qui permet à l'équipe de gagner en rapidité.
Monter en expertise avec le temps : vous commencerez par le triage. En l'espace d'un an, vous connaîtrez notre plateforme mieux que la plupart de ceux qui l'ont construite, car vous aurez vu toutes les façons dont elle peut tomber en panne.

Votre profil :

Maîtrise du français et aisance en anglais : vous travaillerez en français au quotidien. Cependant, nos partenaires étant répartis dans toute l'Europe, vous devrez également répondre à des appels de la hotline et rédiger des mises à jour de tickets en anglais. Votre anglais n'a pas besoin d'être parfait ou sans accent. Il doit être suffisamment bon pour qu'un ingénieur stressé à Rotterdam se sente pris en charge.
Quelqu'un qui aime le téléphone : pas quelqu'un qui le "tolère", mais qui l'aime. Guider calmement un ingénieur stressé à travers un problème, un vendredi à 16h, est une véritable compétence et est au cœur de ce métier.
Curiosité pour le fonctionnement des systèmes : vous avez cassé quelque chose, vous avez compris pourquoi, et vous l'avez réparé. Linux et Unix, le réseau, et idéalement une première approche de SIP ou VoIP - même s'il s'agit simplement d'un serveur Asterisk maison et de beaucoup de Wireshark.
Autonome : on vous donnera un problème, pas un script. Il s'agit d'une petite équipe de personnes expérimentées qui agissent vite et n'attendent pas qu'on leur dise quoi faire.
Quelqu'un qui tire les autres vers le haut : nous déboguons ensemble, nous nous enseignons mutuellement, et personne ici ne garde ses connaissances pour soi. Si cela vous semble évident, nous nous entendrons bien.

Les petits plus (atouts) :
Maîtrise de Linux (famille Rocky / RHEL) au-delà des bases.
Connaissance de SIP, RTP, et les joies spécifiques du débogage d'un problème d'audio unidirectionnel.
Capacité à scripter dans n'importe quel langage.
Allemand, néerlandais ou espagnol : ces langues sont un plus, mais aucune n'est obligatoire.

Jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail par semaine, une fois que vous aurez été pleinement intégré et que vous travaillerez en autonomie.

jobs.title: Kontorelev i HK – mening, udvikling og stærke karrieremuligheder
jobs.description:
Bliv kontorelev i HK og få en uddannelse med elevløn, gode og hjælpsomme kollegaer og spændende opgaver – alt sammen mens du udvikler dig og gør en forskel.

Du bliver en del af både HK Privat Østjylland og HK Handel Østjylland og får derfor en elevtid med masser af variation. Her møder du medlemmer med mange forskellige job – fra kontorer og produktionsvirksomheder til butikker og lagre – og kommer til at arbejde med forskellige opgaver og fagområder. På den måde får du også mulighed for at opdage, hvad du er særligt god til – og hvad du gerne vil arbejde videre med.

Du bliver en del af et hold, hvor vi hver dag hjælper medlemmer med deres arbejdsliv. Det kan være spørgsmål om løn, problemer på jobbet eller hjælp til at finde ud af, hvilke rettigheder de har. Det er virkelig givende at være med til at hjælpe, når et medlem har brug for os.

Hvad kommer du til at lave?
Ikke det samme hver dag.

Som kontorelev hos os får du en varieret hverdag, hvor du både arbejder selvstændigt og sammen med dine kollegaer. Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • arbejde med administration og medlemsoplysninger

  • tale og skrive med medlemmer

  • hjælpe med sager sammen med dine kollegaer

  • være med til at få flere til at vælge HK

  • få indblik i regler og aftaler, der har betydning for medlemmernes arbejdsliv.


Og du kommer helt sikkert også til at lave noget, vi ikke har skrevet på listen. For på to år skal du nå at prøve en masse. Du får selvfølgelig den oplæring og støtte, du har brug for undervejs. Vi sørger for, at du får mulighed for at udvikle dig og gradvist får mere ansvar, efterhånden som du lærer mere.

Det får du hos os
Du bliver en kollega, vi regner med og lytter til, og du får gode kollegaer omkring dig, som hjælper dig undervejs. Du får en bred administrativ uddannelse og erfaring med både medlemskontakt, sagsarbejde, administration og organisering – kompetencer, du kan bruge som et springbræt til din videre karriere.

Derudover får du:

  • overenskomstmæssig løn

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge inklusive frokostpause

  • flekstid

  • pensionsordning

  • mulighed for motion i arbejdstiden

  • sociale arrangementer som lasergame, minigolf, madlavningskursus, padel osv.

  • og en virkelig god frokost fra vores kantine.


Vi bor i Brabrand. Bussen stopper lige uden for døren, og der er gratis parkering lige udenfor.

Hvem er du?
Det vigtigste for os er ikke, at du allerede kan en masse. Det er, at du har lyst til at lære. Vi håber, at du er nysgerrig, tager ansvar, kan lide at hjælpe og har lyst til at være en del af et hold.

Du behøver ikke kende fagbevægelsen på forhånd. Men du skal kunne se dig selv på en arbejdsplads, hvor vi arbejder for at gøre en forskel for mennesker i deres arbejdsliv.

Vi forventer ikke, at du kan det hele fra første dag. Det er jo derfor, du skal være elev hos os.

Du skal have gennemført eller være ved at gennemføre:

  • EUX Business

  • HHX

  • STX, HTX eller HF suppleret med et 5-ugers EUS-forløb.


Skal det være dig?
Så vil vi rigtig gerne høre fra dig. Send din ansøgning, dit CV og dine eksamensbeviser. Du behøver ikke at skrive verdens længste ansøgning. Vi vil bare gerne vide lidt om dig, hvorfor du har lyst til at blive elev hos os, og hvad du håber at få ud af dine to år i HK.

Arbejdssted: HK Østjylland, Sødalsparken 22, 8220 Brabrand
Spørgsmål: Fagchef Nefer Türkoglu, tlf. 6155 8460
Ansøgningsfrist: 25. oktober
Samtaler: 1. samtale den 12. november og 2. samtale den 18. november.
Tiltrædelse: den 4. januar 2027

Alle kvalificerede og interesserede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Søg stillingen via vores hjemmeside Kontorelev - HK

jobs.title: Project Coordinator in Product and Supply
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, kotihoito, Tampere
jobs.description:
Lielahden kotihoidossa palvelemme noin 115:tä asiakasta kolmessa tiimissä. Teemme päivittäin tiivistä yhteistyötä tiimissämme toimivan erillisen P1-etähoivan yksikön kanssa. Moniammatillisen työyhteisömme yhteinen tavoite on tarjota asiakkaillemme laadukasta hoitoa ja tukea heidän omannäköistään arkeaan kotona. Hyödynnämme työssämme aktiivisesti hyvinvointiteknologiaa ja kehitämme kotihoidon palveluja yhdessä.

Lähihoitajana työskentelet kotihoidon vaativissa ammattitehtävissä ja vastaat asiakkaiden hoidon suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta ja arvioinnista. Työ on monipuolista, vastuullista ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden kodeissa sekä itsenäisesti että työparin kanssa ja teet yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, heidän läheistensä sekä muiden hoitoon osallistuvien ammattilaisten kanssa. Tiimitilamme sijaitsevat hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella, aivan ratikkareitin tuntumassa. Asiakaskäynneillä voit liikkua yksikön autolla tai sähköpyörällämme. Jos käytettävissäsi on auto, voit hyödyntää myös sitä työssä liikkumiseen. Voimassa oleva B-luokan ajokortti ja mahdollisuus käyttää autoa helpottavat työssä liikkumista.

Tarjoamme sinulle
Laadukkaan perehdytyksen: pääset alkuun kokeneen työkaverin rinnalla.
Itsenäisen, vaihtelevan ja ratkaisukeskeisen työn sekä vahvan tiimin tuen.
Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi.
Lämminhenkisen ja avoimen työyhteisön, jossa vallitsee rento ja keskusteleva ilmapiiri ja työhyvinvoinnista huolehditaan yhdessä.

Odotamme sinulta
Olet sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilörekisteriin merkitty nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja tai perushoitaja.
Sinulla on hyvät työyhteisö- ja tiimityötaidot sekä valmius itsenäiseen työskentelyyn.
Sinulla on paineensietokykyä, kykyä toimia muuttuvissa tilanteissa ja työn edellyttämä hyvä fyysinen toimintakyky.
Suhtaudut myönteisesti teknologian hyödyntämiseen hoitotyössä ja haluat kehittää työtä yhdessä muiden kanssa.
Sinulla on hygieniapassi ja tehtävän edellyttämät LOVe-lääkehoidon verkkotestit (LOP, PKV, GER1) hyväksytysti suoritettuina ennen työsuhteen alkamista.

Katsomme eduksi aiemman työkokemuksen kotihoidosta.

Toivomme, että voit aloittaa tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian, sovimme aloituksesta kanssasi erikseen. Toinen tehtävistä päättyy 1.11.2026 ja toinen 10.1.2027. Koeaika on enintään puolet palvelussuhteen pituudesta. Työaika on kokoaikatyö, keskimäärin 38 tuntia 15 minuuttia viikossa. Työhön sisältyy aamu- ja iltavuoroja. Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 4 momentin mukainen rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkamista. Suosittelemme vahvasti tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 §:n mukaista rokotesuojaa.

Tule mukaan reiluun ja rempseään työyhteisöömme tekemään merkityksellistä työtä, jolla mahdollistamme asiakkaillemme hyvän arjen. Jätäthän hakemuksesi Kuntarekry -rekrytointijärjestelmässä.

jobs.title: Junior IT Service Manager for energy sector, Espoo
jobs.description:

You will gain hands-on experience and take ownership of daily operational processes for a critical SaaS-based Customer Information System (CIS). This position offers an ideal stepping stone for anyone looking to build a successful career in IT service management.

You are offered

- Cross-Team & Vendor Coordination: Drive daily operational activities, facilitate testing, and coordinate tasks between internal specialists and external service providers.
- Service Management & Documentation: Maintain accurate IT service documentation in Confluence, support audit and compliance checks, and assist the Senior Manager with ad-hoc coordination tasks.

We are looking for

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Finnish

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Trustful
- Social
- Orderly
- Responsible

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Vært søges til Airport Hotel i Billund
jobs.description:
Er du bedst, når andre er på vej hjem?

Bliv Host på Airport Hotel Billund og kom med på vores vækstrejse

Er du typen, der får mere energi, når dagen bliver til aften? Trives du med mennesker, tempo og god stemning og vil du være med til at skabe noget nyt?

Så skal du måske med på den rejse, vi er på lige nu.

Airport Hotel Billund er under stor forandring. Vi bygger om, udvikler og skaber en ny og endnu stærkere version af hotellet. Med ny stor bar og restaurant, vinbar og nye rammer for vores gæster bliver hotellet i endnu højere grad et sted, hvor mennesker mødes, spiser, drikker, arbejder og lander efter en lang dag. Og til det har vi brug for flere dygtige mennesker.

Vi søger en Host til vores aftenteam

Hos os er du ikke bare receptionist.

Du er Host og en vigtig del af hele gæsteoplevelsen.

Du tager imod gæsten, skaber relationen og sørger for, at tingene spiller. Det ene øjeblik hjælper du en international forretningsrejsende med check-in, det næste hjælper du i baren, besvarer spørgsmål eller sørger for, at en familie får en god start på ferien.

Vi arbejder på tværs, hjælper hinanden og har fokus på den samlede gæsteoplevelse frem for klassiske kasser og afdelingsgrænser.

Og ja – du skal være et aftenmenneske

Stillingen er primært til dig, der gerne vil arbejde, når andre holder fri.

Dine vagter vil typisk ligge fra omkring kl. 15.00 til midnat eller kl. 18.00 til ca. kl. 02.00.

Så hvis du helst vil møde ind senere på dagen, trives med energien om aftenen og ikke har noget imod, at arbejdsdagen slutter efter midnat, kan det her være et rigtig godt match.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder ikke nødvendigvis efter det perfekte CV. Vi leder efter den rigtige personlighed.

Du er serviceminded, nysgerrig og har lyst til mennesker. Du tager ansvar, ser hvad der skal gøres og giver gerne en kollega en hånd, når der er brug for det.

Du kan bevare overblikket, når der er fart på, og du forstår, at godt værtskab både ligger i de store oplevelser og de små detaljer.

Erfaring fra hotel, restaurant, bar, café, retail eller anden service er selvfølgelig en fordel, men din energi, indstilling og lyst til at lære betyder mindst lige så meget for os.

Hvorfor lige nu?

Fordi det faktisk er et ret spændende tidspunkt at blive en del af Airport Hotel Billund.

Du kommer ikke ind i et hotel, hvor alt skal fortsætte præcis, som det altid har gjort.

Du kommer ind midt i en udviklings- og vækstrejse, hvor hotellet fysisk forandrer sig, nye koncepter kommer til, og vi sammen skal skabe den næste version af Airport Hotel Billund.

Derfor er der også plads til mennesker med idéer, ambitioner og lyst til at udvikle sig.

Har du lyst til at være med fra starten?

Så ansøg via dette link senest den 31.oktober 2026

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores Host Manager på paulina@billundhotel.dk. Marker emnelinjen ”Vært søges til Airport Hotel”

Vi er den del af Bühlmann Hotels

Bühlmann Hotels har flere unikke hoteller i Danmark. Hotelporteføljen byder urbane city hoteller og ikoniske boutiquehoteller. Selvom alle hotellerne er forskellige og har hver deres unikke særpræg, leverer alle medarbejdere værtskab ud fra de samme værdier:  omhu, fleksibilitet, nærvær, passion og respekt for mennesker og miljø.

Læs mere om vores hoteller på www.buhlmann.dk

jobs.title: Payroll Accountant
jobs.description:
One of Nordic Investin’s partner companies is looking for a Payroll Accountant, with Nordic Investin leading the recruitment process. You know that payroll accounting must be both technically correct and explainable when employees, auditors or finance leaders ask what changed.

The partner needs stronger ownership of payroll accounting, reconciliations and interfaces between HR, payroll providers and the general ledger. You will ensure accurate postings, investigate differences and improve controls across the monthly cycle.

The finance environment values accuracy, traceability and practical improvement. Work should withstand review, make ownership clear and reduce the recurring manual effort or uncertainty that weakens later reporting and decisions.

How you will work

You will collaborate across entity finance, shared services and business teams while owning defined parts of the financial cycle. The partner expects issues to be investigated to root cause, conclusions to be documented and improvements to remain workable at the next close.

As a specialist, you will own a defined professional area and be trusted to move work forward independently. You are expected to recognise when a question requires wider expertise, explain recommendations clearly and improve the methods or tools used by colleagues around you.

What you will do

    

Reconcile payroll files, accounts and payment information.

    

Review payroll postings and allocate costs correctly.

    

Investigate differences across HR, payroll and finance systems.

    

Prepare accruals, provisions and reporting schedules.

    

Maintain payroll accounting controls and documentation.

**Millaista työ on?**

Kotihoidossa työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia ja työskentelet asiakkaiden kanssa heidän omissa kodeissaan. Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

- asiakkaiden päivittäisessä arjessa ja perushoidossa avustaminen

- lääkehoidon toteuttaminen

- sairaanhoidolliset toimenpiteet

- asiakkaiden voinnin seuranta ja palvelutarpeen arviointi

- kirjaaminen ja raportointi

- yhteistyö asiakkaiden, omaisten ja muiden yhteistyötahojen kanssa

- työ on kaksivuorotyötä.


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Tehtävässä tarvitset lähihoitajan tutkinnon tai loppuvaiheen lähihoitajaopinnot. Lisäksi odotamme:

- voimassa olevia LOVE-lääkelupia tai valmiutta niiden suorittamiseen

- B-ajokorttia

- riittäviä ATK-taitoja

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- itsenäistä ja vastuullista työotetta


Ensiaputaidot katsotaan eduksi.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- vakituisen työsuhteen

- TES mukaisen palkkauksen

- tarvittaessa koulutusta ATK-, LOVE- ja ensiapuosaamisen päivittämiseen

- monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työn

- mukavan työyhteisön ja tuen työhösi


Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi meille jo tänään! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja etenemme sopivien hakijoiden kanssa nopeasti.

**_Staffgate Oy_** _on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin._

jobs.title: Project Engineer, ABB Marine & Ports
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated Project Engineer to join ABB Marine & Ports and support the delivery of advanced marine electrical, propulsion, and control system projects.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or an early-career engineer who wants to develop technical expertise within a global engineering organization and gain hands-on experience in international delivery projects.

Your responsibilities

As a Project Engineer, you will:

- Support Lead Engineers in delivery project engineering and design activities
- Assist in technical problem-solving throughout the project lifecycle
- Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and related engineering activities
- Prepare and maintain technical documentation
- Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams on system integration and troubleshooting
- Contribute to the development and improvement of engineering processes and ways of working
- Support project teams in ensuring successful project execution and delivery

You will have the opportunity to work with systems such as:

- Generators
- Main switchboards and power distribution systems
- Transformers
- Converters and drives
- Propulsion Control Systems (PCS)
- Remote Control Systems (RCS)
- Dynamic Positioning (DP) systems
- Marine automation and control systems

What we are looking for

To succeed in this role, we hope you have:

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Good written and spoken English communication skills
- Ability to work effectively in an international project environment
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn
- Interest in electrical systems, automation, and engineering projects

Considered an advantage

- Familiarity with EPLAN or other electrical design tools
- Knowledge of IEC or IEEE standards
- Previous project, internship, or thesis experience related to electrical engineering or automation
- Interest in marine technology and power systems

What we offer

- Opportunity to work with world-leading marine technologies
- Exposure to challenging international delivery projects
- Great opportunities for professional growth and development

Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications and interview suitable candidates during the application period. The position will be filled once a suitable candidate has been found.

Please note that, for GDPR and data security reasons, we are unable to process applications submitted by email or through other channels. To be considered for the position, please submit your application through our recruitment system on our website.

jobs.title: Product Manager | Intch
jobs.description:
About Intch

Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part-time work. You can think of it as a professional network built for senior specialists who take on meaningful contracts alongside their main work. A typical contract lasts from three to six months. The product is used in 140 countries and is available in up to 20 languages. Intch has fewer than 40 people and four product areas, with three already live and one preparing to launch. Intch is rethinking how people and companies find each other and build trust online.

What you’ll do

  • Own the B2C product end to end, including its P&L.

  • Set the product direction and own the 3–6 month roadmap across strategy, experimentation, and delivery.

  • Drive growth through hypothesis-driven experiments and measurable improvements in acquisition, activation, and retention.

  • Own the product metrics and use data to guide decisions and prioritisation.

  • Conduct CustDev interviews and build a deep understanding of user behaviour across a global, multilingual audience.

  • Partner with the B2B product teams to make the B2C product the connective layer across Intch’s product ecosystem.

  • Report directly to the founder and take over the product vertical they currently lead.

What you need to succeed

  • 5+ years of experience in product management.

  • A strong B2C growth track record, including experiments, acquisition, and measurable results.

  • Proven experience scaling a product that already has strong product–market fit.

  • A strong record of improving key metrics such as growth, activation, and retention.

  • Strong product sense and a hypothesis-driven approach to problem-solving.

  • Comfort working with data and translating insights into action.

  • Experience working in a startup or another fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

  • High autonomy, accountability, and comfort working without micromanagement.

  • Fluent Russian.

What you get

  • Full ownership of a profitable, fast-growing product and its P&L, reporting directly to the founder.

  • A deliberately compact team (under 40 people) where everyone has a large area of ownership and streamlined collaboration.

  • Metrics-driven culture: every function, including support and payments, owns numbers. Your P&L is your scoreboard.

  • Flat, cross-pollinating structure: anyone in the company can bring a validated idea to your product. You can do the same across other verticals.

  • Paid vacation and sick leave.

jobs.title: Payment Performance Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

As our Payment Analyst Intern, you will be responsible for conducting AD HOC analysis on the payments performance and risks of Back Market globally, help the team for projects by providing rigor analysis and automate internal processes. This role also involves monitoring our payment metrics, assisting with reporting and benchmarking best practices.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Conduct ad hoc analysis on the payment performance, build dashboards regarding performance metrics.

  • Help build several processes to automate the seller payment process and operations (debt monitoring, KYB, seller’s associated risks).

  • Participate in the construction of new products & services on the platform and support the technical team in charge of payment to successfully implement them (Card payment optimization, alternative payment methods, etc).

  • Monitor and report our payment and KYB/deposit metrics: performance, adoption, costs.

  • Benchmark best practices of current and future markets regarding local payment methods, and consumer buying habits.

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • Looking for a 6-month internship from July 2026

  • English is a no-brainer (fully professional capability). If you’re extra cool and speak more languages, bonus points for you!

  • You have a first experience in e-commerce, ideally, you already know the world of payment.

  • You are familiar with (and love) numbers and have an excellent command of SQL, Excel, Tableau (or any other Data Visualization tool).

  • You are a Swiss Army knife, you are adaptable and enthusiastic about tackling a variety of tasks, embracing challenges.

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months (until June 2027)

  • Schedule: Full-time (35H/week)

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: Internship agreement from your French school required

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Video-call Skills fit interview and Live case study with another person in the team (45min)

  • Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30min)

  • Video-call Cultural fit interview with the direct manager (30min)

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Compensation: €1.2K – €1.4K per month

jobs.title: Director, Business Development
jobs.description:
About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in AI-Assisted Software and Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. 

The Software Engineering group conducts research in a wide range of topics related to design, development, verification, and operation of complex software systems, including emerging technologies and their relation to Software Engineering. You will join a diverse research environment and an exciting Doctoral Programme.

Your immediate leader will be the Leader of the Software Engineering unit.


About the project

Software is today prominent in many critical systems and infrastructures, such as power distribution systems, railway infrastructure, or flight control systems. These systems are subject to complex development and verification processes, including certification and audits, and in general different activities that span the Software Engineering and the Systems Engineering disciplines.

Generative AI and AI agents are rapidly changing how software-based systems are being designed, developed, and evaluated. While AI agents have become common in certain Software Engineering tasks, such as programming, documentation, and vulnerability detection, their adoption for other tasks such as software architecture design, or safety and hazard analysis, is still limited. 

The objective of this position is to investigate and evaluate solutions for software engineering and systems engineering tasks in critical systems and infrastructures. Within this context, the project can be tailored to the interests and background of the successful candidate.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Author academic publications and popular science dissemination material
  • Participate in the Software Engineering research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Support to education activities in courses within the Software Engineering area
  • Other career-promoting work, such as learning grant preparation fundamentals

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Doctoral Programme in Computer Science, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 30.10.2026.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Good programming skills.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English.
     

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria

The following characteristics will be considered an advantage during the selection process:

  • Good understanding of Software Engineering or Systems Engineering fundamentals
  • Experience with modeling of software and/or system architecture
  • Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework)
  • Good knowledge of AI concepts, particularly Generative AI
  • Knowledge of aspects related to critical systems and infrastructures

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Be good at anticipating problems and identifying logical solutions as well as contradictions and inconsistencies  
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
     

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
  • CV.
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing your own research proposal within the topics of this position, including a description of research questions, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages).
  • Short motivation letter (cover letter) (maximum 400 words/1 page).
  • Scientific publications if you have, or other relevant work that fits the position topics.
  • Names and contact information of three references.
     

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Leonardo Montecchi, +47 734 12 964, leonardo.montecchi@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact our HR hiring team at HR@IDI.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10.2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Medical Affairs
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Director, Medical Affairs based in France.

As Associate Director, Medical Affairs, you will serve as a scientific leader and subject-matter expert across a broad range of Medical Affairs activities. You will independently lead high-value workstreams spanning thought leader engagement, scientific congresses, medical communications, publications, literature surveillance, and insight generation. The role combines external scientific engagement with strategic ownership of programs that support the product lifecycle. You will translate clinical evidence and stakeholder insights into practical recommendations that shape Medical Affairs priorities. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and provide trained backup support for selected Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, and Product Complaint activities. This is a remote opportunity within a purpose-driven, collaborative healthcare environment, with approximately 20% travel for congresses and external engagements.


Accountabilities

  • Serve as a scientific subject-matter expert, translating clinical evidence, stakeholder insights, and emerging scientific developments into balanced, actionable recommendations for Medical Affairs strategy.

  • Develop and maintain compliant relationships with key thought leaders (KTLs), healthcare professionals, and other external scientific experts.

  • Plan and conduct scientific exchanges, advisory boards, roundtables, consensus initiatives, and other external engagements aligned with Medical Affairs objectives.

  • Develop KTL engagement plans, define interaction objectives, document scientific insights, and coordinate appropriate follow-up with Medical Affairs leadership.

  • Provide scientific coverage at national and selected regional congresses, including program assessment, session prioritization, coverage planning, KTL preparation, insight capture, and post-congress reporting.

  • Lead the scientific strategy and execution of Medical Affairs booths, including educational content, scientific exchange, medical inquiry routing, insight collection, and post-congress analysis.

  • Partner with Medical Affairs Operations on congress logistics, vendors, contracts, and budget administration.

  • Lead or support scientific communications, including medical education materials, congress resources, presentations, standard response letters, FAQs, and other non-promotional materials.

  • Support publication activities such as publication planning, literature reviews, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, and white papers in accordance with applicable governance processes.

  • Conduct literature surveillance and synthesize relevant scientific, clinical, safety, and competitive developments, identifying implications for evidence generation, education, and stakeholder engagement.

  • Aggregate and analyze insights from KTL interactions, congresses, advisory boards, Medical Information, surveys, and research activities to identify evidence gaps, educational needs, stakeholder barriers, and strategic opportunities.

  • Represent Medical Affairs on cross-functional teams and provide scientific expertise to Regulatory, Quality, Commercial, and other internal stakeholders as appropriate.

  • Serve as a trained and designated backup for defined Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, and Product Complaint activities, including medical inquiry review or escalation, safety information escalation, and selected product complaint assessments.

  • Support continuous improvement across Medical Affairs processes while maintaining high standards of scientific quality, compliance, and risk management.

    • Requirements

    • Advanced scientific or healthcare degree such as a PharmD, PhD, MD, DO, or another relevant advanced degree.

    • Four or more years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience preferred, including experience within Medical Affairs.

    • Strong scientific and clinical acumen, including knowledge of medical terminology, clinical study design, biostatistics, evidence appraisal, and interpretation of clinical and real-world evidence.

    • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and synthesize complex scientific, clinical, safety, and technical information and translate findings into clear, balanced recommendations.

    • Strong scientific writing and communication capabilities, including experience developing medical education materials, evidence summaries, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, presentations, and other scientific content.

    • Working knowledge of publication standards, copyright requirements, scientific exchange principles, and applicable Medical Affairs laws, regulations, industry guidance, and internal requirements.

    • Ability to establish credible and compliant relationships with KTLs, healthcare professionals, and external scientific experts.

    • Strong presentation skills and the ability to adapt complex scientific information for scientific, executive, and cross-functional audiences.

    • Strategic thinking, sound judgment, and the ability to connect scientific evidence and stakeholder insights with broader Medical Affairs priorities.

    • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence cross-functional stakeholders while maintaining appropriate Medical Affairs independence.

    • Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, complex workstreams, and time-sensitive deliverables.

    • Ability to aggregate and synthesize insights to identify evidence gaps, educational needs, stakeholder barriers, and strategic opportunities.

    • Strong awareness of quality, compliance, and risk, including the ability to recognize and appropriately escalate safety, product quality, and compliance information.

    • Prior experience in Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, or product complaints is preferred; the ability to complete role-based training and provide designated backup support is required.

    • Experience with KTL engagement, scientific exchange, congress planning or coverage, and scientific communications is preferred.

    • Strong organizational, stakeholder-management, communication, and presentation skills.

    • High degree of accountability, adaptability, integrity, discretion, and commitment to continuous improvement.

    • Ability to work independently within a lean, cross-functional environment and exercise sound judgment when managing competing priorities and potential risks.

    • Fluent English communication skills and willingness to travel overnight up to approximately 20%, including for scientific congresses and external stakeholder engagements.

    • Flexibility to occasionally work evenings or weekends when required by congress schedules or external engagements.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive base salary range of $150,000–$180,000, depending on experience, education, skills, and geographic location.

      • Eligibility for an annual performance bonus.

      • Comprehensive employee benefits package.

      • Remote working arrangement.

      • Approximately 20% travel, providing opportunities for scientific congress participation and external stakeholder engagement.

      • Opportunity to take visible ownership of high-impact Medical Affairs programs.

      • Exposure to scientific strategy, evidence generation, external engagement, and the full product lifecycle.

      • Opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, purpose-driven healthcare environment.

      • Meaningful opportunity to contribute to the development and support of potentially life-saving healthcare products.

      • Strong scope for scientific leadership, cross-functional influence, and professional growth.

jobs.title: Process Engineer (Surface Treatment)
jobs.description:
Type: permanent, full-time

Location: Perniö, Turku, Tampere, Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Oulu, remote

Application deadline: 28.9.2026

Want to develop surface treatment processes in an international environment and impact production quality and efficiency? Wipro is looking for a Process Engineer!

**What will you be doing?**

We are looking for a Process Engineer to join Wipro Infrastructure Engineering as a technical expert in surface treatment. You will develop and evaluate new and existing surface treatment methods at Wipros manufacturing sites and support production, R&D, and other teams in technical matters. Your work will focus especially on industrial painting and pretreatment processes, corrosion testing, and improving process quality and efficiency.

Your projects may include reducing paint and energy use, improving cycle times, and finding more environmentally friendly solutions. You will also support equipment investments by defining technical requirements and taking part in testing and commissioning. In addition, you will help investigate production issues, support the technical handling of customer complaints, and work with customers, suppliers, and Wipro teams at the manufacturing sites in Perniö, Sweden, and Romania.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have a strong practical and technical understanding of industrial surface treatment processes and experience in developing them. You understand not only individual process steps but also the whole process and how different changes can affect quality, costs, efficiency, and production. You are interested in improving processes and finding better technical solutions.

This is an independent and international role, so we value an accurate, organized, and proactive way of working as well as good communication and negotiation skills. Working with different teams, suppliers, and customers comes naturally to you, and you can adapt to changing situations. A practical and cost-conscious approach will help you succeed in this role.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant technical degree, for example in chemical, materials, process, production, or mechanical engineering

- Several years of relevant experience in industrial surface treatment and process development

- Strong knowledge of industrial painting and pretreatment processes, as well as electrolytic surface treatment methods

- Experience with AutoCAD and/or other technical design tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, or similar software

- Good English skills and willingness to travel to Wipros sites within Europe


**Additionally valued:**

- Experience with different surface treatment methods, such as nitrocarburizing or chromium processes

- Experience with equipment investments, commissioning, or technical development projects

- Knowledge of surface treatment testing, process requirements, or quality development


**Wipro offers you:**

- The freedom to develop surface treatment processes and make a real impact on quality, efficiency, and sustainability

- An international environment where you work across manufacturing sites and develop your technical skills

- The opportunity to develop new solutions and help shape the future of surface treatment at Wipro

- A varied expert role combining technical development, projects, and practical problem-solving

- The flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy. We hope you are available to start as soon as possible, depending on your notice period.

You can work either at Wipros Perniö site or remotely from anywhere in Finland. The position includes approximately 50–60 travel days per year, mainly to Wipros sites in Finland, Sweden, and Romania. Salary in this position is 4500-5500 €/month (gross), depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**How to apply?**

Please submit your CV and application in PDF format in English by Monday 28th of September via aTalents application system: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/382498/create/ .

Remember to use the application system as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure an equal recruitment process for all applicants and will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can learn more about Wipro Infrastructure Engineering here: https://hydraulics.wiproinfra.com/.

For more information about the position and recruitment process, please contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Säde Juntunen (+358 44 901 2283, sade.juntunen@atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

**Company description**

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy develops, manufactures, and markets high-quality hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic components under the Nummi trademark. The company is also a well-known OEM manufacturer of double-acting hydraulic cylinders. Wipro operates internationally, and about 70% of its turnover comes from exports. In addition to Finland, its main markets are Scandinavia, Poland, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, and Switzerland._

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy is a subsidiary of the Indian company Wipro Enterprises. Its parent company, Wipro Ltd, is an international multi-business corporation listed on the New York and Mumbai stock exchanges. The company is headquartered in Bangalore, India. Wipro Infrastructure Engineering has manufacturing facilities in Finland (Perniö), Sweden, Romania, Brazil, India, Canada, and the United States._

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description:
**Sairaanhoitaja – tule tekemään merkityksellistä työtä kanssamme kotihoitoon**

**Haluatko sairaanhoitajan työn, jossa sinulla on aikaa kohdata asiakas ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan työhösi?**

Etsimme sairaanhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Toivomme sinulta oma-aloitteista ja kehitysmyönteistä työotetta, hyviä organisointitaitoja sekä ennen kaikkea halua tehdä laadukasta hoitotyötä yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.

Tässä tehtävässä et ainoastaan suorita työlistaa, vaan pääset ottamaan vastuuta, tukemaan muuta tiimiä ja osallistumaan toiminnan kehittämiseen. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä esihenkilön kanssa ja olet tärkeä osa tiimin päivittäistä toimintaa.

**Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu?**

- hoitotyön suunnittelua ja koordinointia

- lähihoitajien tukemista arjen työssä

- asiakaskäyntejä, kuten lääkehoitoa, haavanhoitoa ja asiakkaan voinnin arviointia

- hoidon laadun ja sujuvuuden varmistamista

- yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, omaisten ja moniammatillisen työryhmän kanssa

- toiminnan ja toimintatapojen kehittämistä yhdessä tiimin kanssa

- tiivistä yhteistyötä esihenkilön työparina


**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

Tarjoamme **vakituista työtä**, jossa työvuorot sijoittuvat pääosin arkipäiviin. Käytössä on joustava ja autonominen työvuorosuunnittelu, joten pääset vaikuttamaan omiin työvuoroihisi.

Lisäksi tarjoamme:

- TES mukaisen palkan – kuulemme mielellämme myös palkkatoiveesi

- yrityksen auton asiakaskäynteihin

- työterveyshuollon

- mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa työnkuvaasi

- mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä yrityksen mukana

- työyhteisön, jossa yhteistyö ja hyvä arki ovat tärkeässä roolissa


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Tehtävä sopii sairaanhoitajalle, jolla on hyvä asenne, organisointikykyä ja valmiutta ottaa vastuuta. Aikaisempi kokemus vastaavanlaisista tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi.

Edellytämme:

- sairaanhoitajan tutkintoa

- voimassa olevia lääkehoitolupia (LOVE)

- ajokorttia

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa


Tehtävään valitulta edellytetään rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä ikäihmisten kanssa työskentelyä varten.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos etsit sairaanhoitajan työtä, jossa saat yhdistää käytännön hoitotyön, vastuun ja toiminnan kehittämisen, **haluamme kuulla sinusta!**

**Staffgate Oy** on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin.

Der tilbydes et rigtig godt arbejdsforhold med velindrettede behandlingslokaler og mulighed for at modtage sparring og faglig udvikling.

Arbejdsopgaverne vil bestå i at levere massage på briks.

Arbejdstiden tilrettelægges ift. behov og de dage der ønskes fra virksomhedens side.

Strong fault-finding and breakdown repair skills, experience working in a manufacturing/production environment preferred. Good communication skills to liaise with fitters, contractors and suppliers. Strong commitment to health and safety, ability to follow preventative maintenance schedules and to work with production teams to minimise downtime. Our school is situated in the Aviapolis area, on the premises of the Point - Pakkala Learning and Information Centre, in Kartanonkoski. It is in Helsinki Region Transport zone B, and is quickly accessible. Buses from e.g. Sörnäinen metro station take about 25 minutes.

The International School of Vantaa is looking for a class teacher (Päätoiminen tuntiopettaja, luokanopetus). The qualification requirements are higher university degree and class-teacher qualification (degree 986/1998). If the degree has been taken outside Finland, the applicant shall present an equivalent qualification approved by the Finnish National Board of Education.
