jobs.title: Hands-on Data Center Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**

Nordecon Oy is converting a former industrial bakery building in Riihimäki into a data centre designed for AI and high performance computing workloads. Repurposing an existing industrial site brings interesting engineering problems a new build never has.

We are looking for a hands-on Data Center Deployment Engineer to help us build it and then run it. You will be part of the core team in this role, which means you will not inherit someone else's procedures, you will build them.

Founded in 2006, Nordecon is an OEM and solution provider with nearly two decades of experience in mobile, server and custom-built desktop systems. The data centre is the next phase of that business.

**What you will do**

- Plan and oversee the installation of data centre infrastructure: servers, storage, networking and power systems

- Coordinate with vendors and contractors on procurement, installation, commissioning and acceptance testing

- Configure, integrate and troubleshoot systems to keep them performing

- Work with environmental and monitoring systems — cooling, power distribution, alarms

- Carry out site assessments and make sure we meet safety and industry standards

- Write and maintain the documentation: design records, installation procedures, and the operating procedures the site will run on

- Take part in our ISO/IEC 27001 certification work. Building the operational procedures and controls that certification is based on, not just following them

- As the team grows, support and guide our data centre technicians


**What helps you succeed in this role**

- Hands-on experience deploying and operating data centre infrastructure

- Solid understanding of network and data cabling, and of network and power capacity planning

- Strong Linux skills

- Working knowledge of HVAC and cooling dynamics in a data centre context

- Fluent Finnish and good English

- A degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field or equivalent experience earned on the job

- Willingness to be on site in Riihimäki, and to take part in an on-call rotation once the site is live


**Nice to have**

- Experience converting or retrofitting an existing building for data centre or other critical facility use

- Experience commissioning a new site or a major capacity expansion

- Liquid-cooled or high-density deployments

- Exposure to ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or similar management systems

- Electrical or HVAC qualifications


We offer you a permanent full-time position with interesting and versatile tasks with the opportunity to have a real influence on the development of the data center. The applicant must speak Finnish. If you got interested and would like to know more please send your questions, introductions and CV with salary request to applications@nordecon.fi

We read every application, but we are a small team and receive a high volume of them. We will only contact candidates we invite to interview. If you have not heard from us within two weeks of applying, the role has moved forward with other candidates. We know applying takes real effort, and we appreciate the time you put into it.

jobs.title: Tukiperhe

Tukiperhe voi olla lapseton pariskunta, pariskunta, jolla on kotona asuvia lapsia tai yksinasuvan aikuisen perhe, jolla on resursseja ja halua tarjota huolenpitoa sekä turvaa lapsille ja nuorille. Koska lasten ja perheiden tilanteet ja tukitarpeet ovat erilaisia, toimintaan tarvitaan eri-ikäisiä, kulttuuritaustaltaan vaihtelevia ja monenlaisia taitoja omaavia tukiperheitä, jotka voivat vastata lapsen ja perheen tarpeisiin.

Etsimme tukiperheitä erityisesti Uudenmaan alueelta sekä Mikkelin seudulta. Myös muualla asuvat olkaa yhteydessä niin pohditaan tilannettanne.

Lapsi viettää tukiperheessä yleensä yhden viikonlopun kuukaudessa ja loma-aikoina sovitulla tavalla. Tukiperheessä tehdään tavallisia, turvallisen arkisia asioita. Tukiperheen aikuisilla tulisi olla mahdollisuus kuljettaa lasta tukiviikonlopuille ja takaisin kotiin. Tukiperheen oma elämäntilanne on vakaa, perheessä ei ole akuutteja kriisejä tai muita suuria huolia.

AVA valmentaa tukiperheet ja antaa vahvaa tukea koko lapsen tukisuhteen ajan.

- säännöllinen yhteydenpito sekä 24 h puhelinpäivystystuki

- kasvatuskumppanuus arjen haastaviin tilanteisiin

Requirements Essential • Minimum 1 year's experience in a planning, scheduling, operations or resource allocation role requiring independent decision-making and organisational skills. • Excellent planning, analytical and problem-solving abilities. • Ability to prioritise competing operational demands within a fast-paced environment. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with Healthcare Assistants, healthcare professionals, clients and family members. • Excellent organisational skills and high attention to detail. • Ability to remain calm and make effective decisions under pressure. • Strong IT skills with confidence using computer systems, electronic scheduling software, Microsoft Office and other digital platforms. • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I august 2019 åpnet det sentrale serveringsstedet på torget i ny drakt. Pangea kitchen & Bar

Vi er alt annet en mainstream, vi lager det vi synes er godt. Her er det ingen regler på hvilke kulturer og kjøkken som krysser hverandre. Så lenge det smaker digg, er det lov

Pangea er et ujålete og raust restaurantkonsept, som oser av kvalitet med fokus på hva som blir levert på tallerken og i glasset til gjestene.

In August 2019, the central serving location on the square opened in a new guise. Pangea kitchen & Bar

We are anything but mainstream, we make what we think is good. Here there are no rules on which cultures and cuisines intersect. As long as it tastes good, it's legal

Pangea is an unpretentious and generous restaurant concept, which oozes quality with a focus on what is delivered on the plate and in the glass to the guests.

jobs.title: Tiimipäällikkö
jobs.description:
**Toimintamme kasvaessa etsimme nyt neljättä tiimipäällikköä Huolenpitotiimiin. Meillä pääset oppimaan jatkuvasti uutta asuntosijoittamisesta ja vuokrasuhteiden hallinnoinnista.**

Asuntopehtoori on täyden palvelun asuntovarallisuuden hoitaja, joka tarjoaa asiakkailleen vuokravälitystä, asuntovälitystä, vuokra-asuntojen Huolenpitopalvelua sekä isännöintiä. Olemme ketterä ja nykyaikainen toimija, joka tunnetaan loistavasta asiakaspalvelustaan sekä kilpailukykyisestä hinnoittelustaan. Toimimme 14 eri kaupungissa palvellen asiakkaita ympäri Suomen!

Meillä Asuntopehtoorin Huolenpitopalvelussa teet tiivistä yhteistyötä Huolenpitopalvelun muiden tiimipäällikön, sihteeriemme ja välittäjiemme sekä liiketoimintajohtajan kanssa. Tiimissämme on yhdessä tekemisen meininki ja hyvä yhteishenki!

Tiimipäällikön tehtävänä on varmistaa, että tiimin päivittäinen työ sujuu tehokkaasti, ja asiakkaamme saavat laadukasta ja asiantuntevaa palvelua. Tiimipäällikkönä vaikutat suoraan siihen, miten tiimi toimii, millaista palvelua asiakkaamme saavat ja miten pystymme vastaamaan kasvun tuomiin tarpeisiin. Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on kyky itsenäiseen työskentelyyn, kyky kantaa vastuuta omasta ja tiimin työskentelystä sekä halua kehittää toimintaa ja auttaa tiimiä onnistumaan yhdessä.

**Työnkuva:**

- Tiimin päivittäisen työn johtaminen ja resursointi huomioiden mm. lomat ja poissaolot

- Työntekijöiden tukeminen ja esihenkilötyö

- Uusien työntekijöiden rekrytointi ja perehdytys

- Raportointi ja palkkojen koostaminen

- Sihteereiden tukeminen erilaisissa vuokrasuhteisiin liittyvissä haastavissa tilanteissa

- Haastavien asiakastilanteiden ratkaiseminen

- Palvelun laadun seuranta ja kehittäminen

- Asiakastyytyväisyyden parantamiseen tähtäävien toimintatapojen kehittäminen

- Yhteistyö muiden tiimien ja sidosryhmien kanssa


**Odotamme rooliin valitulta henkilöltä:**

- Osaamista tiimin johtamisesta ja esihenkilötyöstä

- Kykyä kantaa vastuuta sekä omasta että tiimin tekemisestä ja toimia esimerkkinä muille

- Kykyä seurata, arvioida ja kehittää työn laatua sekä puuttua tarvittaessa havaittuihin puutteisiin

- Aiempaa kokemusta sijoitusasunnoista ja vuokrasuhteiden hallinnoinnista

- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

- Itsenäistä, järjestelmällistä ja vastuullista työotetta

- Rohkeutta tehdä päätöksiä, viedä asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin ja ottaa myös haastavia asioita rakentavasti puheeksi

- Rakentavaa ja ratkaisukeskeistä asennetta, kykyä toimia joustavasti muuttuvissa tilanteissa sekä valmiutta sitoutua yhteisiin tavoitteisiin ja viedä niitä eteenpäin myös haastavissa tilanteissa


Lisäksi arvostamme asunto-osakeyhtiölain ja huoneenvuokralain perusteiden osaamista sekä kokemusta kiinteistönvälitysalalta tai asuntosijoittamisesta. Aiempi kokemus vuokravälityksestä, vuokravalvonnasta, vuokrasuhteiden hoitamisesta, LKV/LVV-tutkinto tai muu työtehtävää tukeva koulutus katsotaan eduksi.

Palkkaus on kiinteä kuukausipalkka 3 000 - 3 300 €/kk aiemman kokemuksen mukaan.

Luottamus ja vastuullisuus ovat toimintamme perusta, minkä vuoksi tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä tarkistetaan luottotiedot.

**Työaika ja työskentelypaikka**

Työaika arkisin klo 8.00-16.00. Työ pitää sisällään satunnaisia viikonloppuvuoroja muutaman kerran vuodessa. Työskentelypaikka on Asuntopehtoorin toimisto. Saat kuitenkin itse valita, että millä toimistostamme tulisit työskentelemään, joten kerrothan hakemuksessa mikä toimistomme olisi sinulle mieluisin.

Perhe perheeseen sijoitus on avohuollon tukitoimi, jolla voidaan sijoittaa koko perhe perhehoitajan kotiin ja jonka aikana tuen tarvetta arvioidaan ja perhettä tuetaan kasvatustehtävässään.

**Etsimme lastensuojelun perhehoitajia**

Perhehoitajaksi ei vaadita sosiaalialan koulutusta, tärkeintä on sitkeys, lämpö ja kyky kohdata myös lapsen vaikeat tunteet turvallisesti. Perhehoitajana olet lapselle pysyvä ja luotettava aikuinen, joka tarjoaa arjen turvaa ja jatkuvuutta.

**Sinulta edellytämme:**

Kykyä toteuttaa terapeuttista vanhemmuutta, kykyä kohdata lapsi tunnetasolla, tuet hänen kuntoutumistaan ja luot turvallisen, oppimista edistävän kasvuympäristön. Yhteistyötaitosi ovat vahvat, sillä teet suunnitelmallista yhteistyötä lapsen vanhempien, läheisverkoston ja viranomaisten kanssa asiakassuunnitelman mukaisesti. Odotamme myös koko perheen sitoutumista: muiden perheenjäsenten tulee hyväksyä sijoitettu lapsi ja kyetä tarjoamaan hänelle tasavertainen asema perheessä koko sijoituksen ajan.

Perhehoitajana toimiminen on haastava tehtävä, joka vaatii vahvan tuen. Tarjoamme:

- Perhehoidon vastuutyöntekijän säännölliset kotikäynnit ja puhelinkeskustelut.

- Nopeat ja joustavat tukipalvelut.

- Tilapäistä lastenhoitoapua.

- Työnohjaus ja vertaisryhmätoiminta.

- Mentorointi.

- Erityisasiantuntijan konsultointikäynnit.

- Koulutukset.

- Virkistyspäiviä koko perheelle.

- 24/7 puhelinpäivystyksen.

- Kilpailukykyisen palkkion ja korvauksen.


Lastensuojelun perhehoitajana voi toimia yksin tai yhdessä puolison kanssa. Perhehoitajana toimiminen edellyttää ennakkovalmennuksen suorittamista. AVA perhepalvelut tarjoaa perhehoitajaksi ryhtyville maksuttoman PRIDE-ennakkovalmennuksen. Valmennuksen tavoitteena on antaa riittävästi tietoa sijaisvanhemmuudesta niin, että valmennukseen osallistuva voi tehdä tietoisen päätöksen ryhtymisestään tehtävään sekä taata jokaiselle sijaisperhettä tarvitsevalle lapselle mahdollisuus päästä hyvin valmentautuneeseen perheeseen ja saada yksilöllisiä tarpeita vastaava hoito ja huolenpito perheessä.

Seuraavat PRIDE -valmennus alkaa 7.11.2026.

jobs.title: Machinist, Bluefors Oy
jobs.description:
Bluefors Oy is a Finnish high-tech company based in Helsinki, working at the absolute frontier of quantum technology. They design and manufacture some of the world's most precise cryogenic measurement systems - the kind of equipment that pushes the boundaries of what science can do. When you work here, your machining skills directly support cutting-edge research used by leading institutions and companies around the world.

As a Machinist at Bluefors, you'll be working with a 5-axis DMG Mori milling machine, producing precision parts from materials like copper, aluminium, brass, stainless steel, and POM. The work is varied - small series, tight tolerances where it counts, and surface finishes that matter. You'll have real influence over your work, not just push a button and repeat.

YOUR TASKS

You'll be working as a Machinist in Bluefors' production team, operating a 5-axis DMG Mori milling machine to manufacture precision components for quantum technology systems.

- Setting up and operating 5-axis DMG Mori milling machines using Heidenhain controls
- Machining parts from copper, AISI 316 stainless steel, brass, aluminium, and POM
- Working with part sizes ranging from 5 to 360 mm in diameter
- Producing small series (typically under 10 pieces) with accuracy and consistency
- Maintaining tight tolerances and high surface quality standards where required
- Reading and interpreting technical drawings and machining programs
- Carrying out quality checks and ensuring finished parts meet specifications
- Contributing to a clean, organized, and safe workshop environment

REQUIREMENTS

- Solid experience setting up and operating CNC milling machines
- Hands-on experience with 5-axis machining
- Familiarity with Heidenhain controls
- Ability to read technical drawings and apply tolerances accurately
- Attention to surface quality and detail
- Good communication skills in Finnish or English

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Mastercam or other CAM software
- Background machining copper, brass, or other non-ferrous materials
- Experience in small-series precision manufacturing
- Prior work in a high-tech or engineering environment

Chosen applicants will be employed with Barona Teollisuus Oy with fixed-term contract until 31.12.2026, with possibility for extension.

This is full-time position from Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week with 2-shift rotation on a 3-week cycle: 2 weeks on a day shift (Monday to Friday) and 1 week on evening shift (Monday to Thursday from 14.00 to 00.00, Fridays off).

If this sounds like you and you're the machinist were looking for, submit your application today using the link provided. For more information, contact Ari Kumlander at Barona by email at
. Please note that, due to data privacy regulations, we cannot accept applications submitted via email.

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

jobs.title: Konemyyjä – rakennus- ja työmaakalusto (Helsinki)
jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme vakituista konemyyjää vahvistamaan Helsingin toimipisteen porukkaa.

Asiakkaamme on rakennus- ja työmaakaluston myyntiin erikoistunut yritys, joka palvelee rakennusalan ammattilaisia laadukkailla koneilla, laitteilla ja asiantuntevalla palvelulla. Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisen kaluston parissa ja auttamaan asiakkaita löytämään oikeat ratkaisut niin rakennus-, remontti- kuin maanrakennusprojekteihin.

Etsimme henkilöä, joka innostuu asiakaskohtaamisista, ymmärtää teknisiä tuotteita tai haluaa oppia niistä lisää ja nauttii tavoitteellisesta myyntityöstä. Tässä tehtävässä yhdistyvät asiantuntijamyynti, asiakassuhteiden rakentaminen ja käytännönläheinen tekeminen.

Työtehtäväsi -->

Rakennuskoneiden myyjänä vastaat asiakkaiden palvelemisesta ja myynnin edistämisestä. Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

- asiakkaiden tarpeiden kartoittaminen ja oikeiden ratkaisujen tarjoaminen

- rakennuskoneiden ja työmaakaluston myynti sekä tarjousten laatiminen

- uusien asiakkuuksien hankinta ja olemassa olevien asiakassuhteiden kehittäminen

- aktiivinen yhteydenpito rakennusalan ammattilaisiin

- tilausten käsittely ja myyntiprosessin hallinta

- yhteistyö varaston, huollon ja muun organisaation kanssa sujuvien toimitusten varmistamiseksi

- tuotteiden ja kaluston asiantunteva esittely asiakkaille


Myytävä kalusto on erittäin monipuolinen ja sisältää esimerkiksi pienkoneita, rakennustyökaluja, henkilönostimia, maanrakennuskoneita, työmaakalustoa sekä erilaisia erikoislaitteita.

Odotamme sinulta-->

Toivomme, että sinulla on:

- kokemusta myyntityöstä tai vahva halu kehittyä teknisen alan myyjäksi

- teknistä ymmärrystä tai kiinnostusta koneisiin ja laitteisiin

- asiakaslähtöinen ja tavoitteellinen työote

- hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaidot

- oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita

- halua oppia uutta ja kehittää omaa osaamistasi


Aiempi kokemus esimerkiksi rakennusalalta, konekaupasta, työmaakalustosta, huollosta, logistiikasta tai teknisestä asiakaspalvelusta katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle

- laadukkaat tuotteet ja tunnetut tuotemerkit myynnin tueksi

- kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään

- mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi teknisen kaupan ammattilaisena

- kannustavan työyhteisön ja pitkäaikaisen työmahdollisuuden


Työ sijaitsee Itä-Helsingissä.

Jos nautit asiakastyöstä, haluat rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja kiinnostut teknisistä tuotteista, tämä voi olla juuri sinun seuraava urasi.

jobs.title: AI Engineer Intern, GenAI Internal Automation (GAIA)
jobs.description:
About the team

At Equativ, we're on a mission to develop advertising technologies that empower our customers to reach their digital business goals. The impact of Generative AI on the industry is projected to be major, and Equativ has been undergoing a significant transformation to embed this technology at the core of our value proposition.

The GenAI team is a new, strategic unit (6–8 people) responsible for the design, development, and deployment of Equativ's entire GenAI stack. You will be joining a team of 3 developers and 2 product managers. It is split into two complementary pillars:

  • Core Platform — designing and building a reusable, industrialized Agentic Platform (MaaS, AaaS, Model/Agent as a Service) to accelerate agent development across the company.

  • Business Feature — the team you will be joining. We develop and deploy mission-critical AI agents that automate workflows for non-technical internal teams (operations, ad quality, marketplace, finance support, etc.). Our backlog targets people who today rely on manual processes and ad-hoc tooling, your work will give them autonomous, measurable, production-grade AI assistants.

This team is part of the R&D department (200+ engineers across Paris, Nantes, Limoges, Krakow, Berlin and North America), all working in an Agile environment.


What you will do

  • Create reusable components and libraries (Python + n8n) for the Business Feature Team, leveraging existing workflows and agents to accelerate future development.

  • Perform maintenance (TMA) on existing workflows and agents, focusing on resolving issues and improving performance.

  • Partner directly with non-technical stakeholders, sit with operations teams, understand their pain points, translate workflows into agentic solutions, and explain your design choices.

  • Collaborate with the team on Python development, contributing to the production codebase by applying software engineering principles (unit tests, CI/CD, Git, code review) and helping implement AIOps/AgentOps best practices.


About you

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or similar technical fields.

  • Experience with Python, and using Git for collaboration. You are comfortable working in group projects and collaborating within a team, with a strong desire to learn AIOps/MLOps best practices in a professional environment.

  • Proven experience building production-ready agent workflows with Google ADK (strongly preferred), Langchain, or LangGraph.

  • Practical experience with cloud platforms (Vertex AI, Kubernetes or equivalents) for deploying scalable GenAI services.

  • You can sit down with a non-technical stakeholder, draw out their workflow, and come back with a working agent.

  • Versatile, autonomous, and proactive, you love taking initiatives and driving your projects, with a strong desire to grow while being mentored by our solid team of developers and product managers.

  • Fluent technical English (written and verbal) mandatory.


Practical

  • Status: Internship

  • Location: Paris

  • Working language: English

👋 About us 

Equativ, a leading independent ad platform, brings scale and simplicity to digital advertising.
 
Following its recent merger with Sharethrough and the acquisition of Kamino Retail, advertisers, media owners, and technology partners rely on Equativ’s advanced SSP, curation, and retail media services and technology to achieve maximum business outcomes.
 
With a focus on privacy-first programmatic video, CTV, and data-driven solutions, Equativ enables clients to activate across the digital ecosystem while protecting consumer privacy.
 
The company’s global expertise is also backed by a team of over 750 employees across 19 countries.
 
As a proud recipient of the HappyIndex@Work label, Equativ is committed to providing a dynamic, flexible workplace where employees thrive, grow, and excel in both their professional and personal lives.
Come and lead the charge with us in building a transparent ecosystem based on quality!

jobs.description:
Nástup možný IHNED.

Toužíte po práci, která Vám umožní skloubit profesní život s rodinou a svými zájmy? Kde noci trávíte doma a ne v práci?
Od ledna 2026 spouštíme v Pelhřimově nové Centrum duševního zdraví (CDZ) - službu, která propojuje zdravotní a sociální péči a přináší do regionu moderní model podpory pro lidi s duševním onemocněním.

Koho hledáme?
- všeobecné sestry s řidičákem skupiny B, které chtějí pracovat v multidisciplinárním týmu a podílet se na rozvoji nové služby

Co nabízíme?
- jednosměnný provoz - pravidelný rytmus dne a více prostoru pro vlastní život,
- hlavní pracovní poměr na 1,0 úvazek, 5 týdnů dovolené
- čas na individuální přístup ke klientovi - možnost pracovat s lidmi tak, aby Vaše péče měla skutečný dopad,
- týmovou podporu - v práci nejste sami, vždy se můžete opřít o psychiatra, psychologa, sociální pracovníky i peer konzultanty,
- možnost podílet se na něčem novém - být u zrodu služby, která je v ČR stále unikátní, a uplatnit své zkušenosti a nápady,
- mzdu od 43.000,- Kč dle specializace

Co Vás čeká?
- poskytování zdravotní péče v ambulanci i v přirozeném prostředí klientů,
- spolupráce s odborníky napříč profesemi,
- supervize, odborné vzdělávání a podpora profesního růstu

Co získáte?
- motivační mzdu
- stabilní zázemí organizace FOKUS Vysočina, z.ú.
- možnost profesně růst a zároveň si udržet rovnováhu mezi prací a osobním životem

Jak se přihlásit?
Pošlete svůj životopis a motivační dopis na e-mail: petra.truhlarova@fokusvysocina.cz

Chcete se dozvědět víc? Zavolejte nám na tel.: 775 881 778 v čase od 8:00 do 14:00 h.

jobs.employer: SPRÁVA VEŘEJNÉHO STATKU MĚSTA PLZNĚ, příspěvková organizace
jobs.description:
SPRÁVA VEŘEJNÉHO STATKU MĚSTA PLZNĚ, příspěvková organizace vyhlašuje
VÝBĚROVÉ ŘÍZENÍ
na obsazení 1 místa
Technik Úseku městské zeleně
Pracovní úvazek: 40 hod./týdně, tj. úvazek 1,0

Místo výkonu práce: Plzeň

Pracovní poměr: na dobu určitou s pozdější možností na dobu neurčitou

Předpokládaný datum nástupu: dle dohody

Platová třída: 10
v rozmezí 27 030 - 38 990,- Kč + pohyblivá složka platu, která může činit 25-40%  ročních příjmů (osobní příplatek, odměny). Plat se řídí dle NV č. 341/2017 Sb. a záleží na dosažené praxi.

Rámcová pracovní náplň:

"    komplexní zajištění údržby a správy městské zeleně na svěřeném majetku (ve smyslu zadání, kontroly a přebírání prací)
"    zpracovávání běžné dokumentace ke správě majetku, provádění administrativně technické práce,
"    vyjádření k zásahům do zeleně v návaznosti na stavební zákon v platném znění
"    účast na jednáních s orgány MMP (Magistrátu města Plzně), ÚMO (Úřadu městského obvodu) a organizacemi v rozsahu svého pracovního zařazení
"    zajišťování agendy související se svěřeným majetkem
"    samostatně provádění průzkumu, monitoringu zdravotního stavu stromů, zajištění odborných posudků a navrhování arboristických zásahů tak, aby byla zajištěna bezpečnost a vitalita stromů,
"    zajištění odborných měření a posuzování stavu stromů a navržení jejich úpravy i celých porostních skupin.
"    vypracovává rozbory, metodiky provozních činností, vztahující se k zajištění stability dendrologického potenciálu města Plzně,
"    projednávat a schvalovat požadavky jiných subjektů na zásahy do dřevin,

Kvalifikační a odborné požadavky:

"    vzdělání - preferujeme VŠ obor zahradnictví, arboristika, krajinářská architektura, správa zeleně, zahradní a krajinářské realizace, lesnictví, zemědělství případně SŠ obdobného zaměření s praxí v oboru
"    řidičský průkaz skupiny B,
"    znalost práce na PC (MS office).

Nabízíme:
"    zajímavá, koncepční práce a perspektivní zaměstnání,
"    motivující osobní příplatek, mimořádné odměny a další zaměstnanecké výhody (příspěvek na penzijní připojištění, stravenkový paušál, 5 dní indispozičního volna, výhodnější paušály na volání, 5 týdnů dovolené).
Doklady potřebné pro přihlášení do výběrového řízení:
1.    strukturovaný životopis,
2.    podepsané prohlášení uchazeče v následujícím znění: Poskytnutím svých osobních údajů v rozsahu podkladů pro přihlášku do výběrového řízení dávám souhlas k jejich zpracování (jméno, příjmení, titul, datum narození, podpis).
Stačí tuto větu připojit na konec životopisu.
Písemné přihlášky do výběrového řízení posílejte personalistce Martině Voříškové na mail voriskovaM@plzen.eu.
Termín výběrového řízení - ústního pohovoru: - bude upřesněn (předpoklad 29.6. nebo 1.-2.7.2026). Ústní pohovor se uskuteční v budově Správy veřejného statku města Plzně, Klatovská tř. 10, 301 00 Plzeň,
Bližší informace na telefonu č. 720 890 896, Bc. Silvie Kuchtová, vedoucí Úseku městské zeleně.

*Bližší informace na našich stránkách: https://www.svsmp.cz/kariera/. Nástup po dohodě. Pracovní poměr na dobu určitou s možností změny na dobu neurčitou.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!

The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 

While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.

This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
  • Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
  • Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
  • Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
  • Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
  • Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
  • Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
  • Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
  • Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
  • Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
  • Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
  • Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
  • Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
  • Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Applications pour assurer l'interface technique principale entre les clients, les partenaires système et les équipes d'ingénierie Vsora. Ce rôle combine accompagnement client, support technique, intégration de plateformes et résolution de problèmes au niveau système, afin d'assurer le succès du déploiement des solutions IA basées sur l'accélérateur Vsora.

Vos responsabilités Servir de pont entre les clients et les équipes d'ingénierie Vsora, assurant une communication efficace et la priorisation des problèmes techniques. Traduire les exigences clients, les demandes de fonctionnalités et les défis de déploiement en retours actionnables pour les équipes Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de validation logicielle, runtime, compilateur, logiciel IA et matériel pour résoudre les problèmes et améliorer le produit Suivre et gérer les escalades clients jusqu'à leur résolution, en maintenant une communication claire avec l'ensemble des parties prenantes Accompagner les fabricants de serveurs, OEM, ODM et partenaires plateforme dans l'intégration des accélérateurs Vsora dans des systèmes de production. Résoudre les problèmes au niveau système impliquant le matériel, le firmware, les drivers, le réseau, le stockage, l'alimentation et la thermique Collaborer avec les équipes hardware pour diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes d'intégration plateforme et d'interopérabilité.

Description du profil Solide expérience en support technique, ingénierie terrain (FAE), solutions engineering, ingénierie client ou intégration système Expérience en infrastructure IA, serving d'inférence, déploiement ML ou plateformes datacenter Familiarité avec les frameworks IA et solutions de serving : PyTorch, ONNX, Hugging Face, vLLM, SGLang, Triton Inference Server ou technologies équivalentes Expérience avec les systèmes Linux, les technologies de containerisation, les systèmes distribués. Compréhension de l'architecture serveur, des accélérateurs PCIe et de l'infrastructure datacenter Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et débogage : hardware, firmware, drivers, systèmes d'exploitation et logiciels applicatifs Excellentes capacités de communication et de relation client, avec la capacité d'interagir efficacement avec des interlocuteurs techniques et non-techniques Expérience avec des OEM, ODM, hyperscalers, cloud providers ou clients enterprise est un fort atout.

jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Lieu : Vélizy-Villacoublay, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d'activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l'environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d'euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l'innovation tels que l'IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays.

Nos engagements, vos avantages***Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée***Un package de rémunération attractif***Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes***Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l'équilibre des collaborateurs***Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Rejoignez-nous sur le campus Vélizy qui héberge une grande diversité d'activités Thales, aéro, défense, civile A l'ouest de Paris, ce site offre un environnement de travail équipé des dernières innovations technologiques et propose des services permettant de concilier vie professionnelle et personnelle.

L'outil TCIS (Thales Component Information System) référence l'ensemble des composants (matériels, produits chimiques, outils logiciels) utilisés par le groupe Thales pour définir et développer ses produits.

Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un Software Solution Engineer expérimenté pour maintenir en condition opérationnelle cet outil et participer au développement de son écosystème.

Vos principales missions seront :

Effectuer le Support (redémarrage application / serveur de cette application dans le respect des directives, processus et pratiques standardisés de la discipline

Développer et livrer des packs correctifs de cette application

Contribuer de manière active à l'intégration de cette application dans son écosystème en développant des passerelles entre TCIS et les différents outils de son écosystème.

Collaborer avec les équipes de développement pour implémenter et exécuter des tests d'intégration

Participer et contribuer aux évènements de disciplines qui promeuvent l'amélioration continue.

Participer activement aux différentes cérémonies agiles

Votre profil :

Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée d'au moins 5 ans dans le développement d'application d'applications logiciel en tant que développeur Full stack et en particulier sur du maintien en condition opérationnelle.

Vous maitrisez le développement JAVA en particulier la version 1.6

Vous avez des connaissances solides en scripting Shell

Vous avez des connaissances solides en Oracle - SQL/PLSQL

Par ailleurs :

Vous avez des connaissances de l'OS linux (Red Hat )

Vous avez des connaissances sur un Cloud provider en particulier Azure

Vous vous intéressez aux technologies d'IA, en particulier l'IA générative

Vous avez une forte appétence pour le Software craftmanship et ses principes

Vous êtes doté(e) de fort esprit d'analyse, vous avez l'esprit d'équipe et êtes autonome.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

jobs.title: Policy Administration Officer - CDD 12 months (m/f)
jobs.description:
Policy Administration Officer - CDD 12 months

Partner & Client Services - Findel, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg

About Utmost International

Utmost International is a leading provider of insurance-based wealth solutions operating across the UK, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. Its solutions are largely based on unit-linked insurance policies, serving the needs of affluent, high net worth (HNW), and ultra-high net worth (UHNW) individuals.

About Utmost Luxembourg S.A.

Sitting at the crossroads of private banking, asset management, and insurance, we operate in a well-established and fast-growing division of the financial services industry. Our dynamic international team of 450+ experienced wealth structuring specialists, subject-matter and technical experts consists of 50 different nationalities, speaking over 30 languages.

We are a diverse and inclusive organisation driven by a values-based culture that promotes excellence, ambition, and innovation. We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Your role – Are you ready for a challenge?

As Policy Administration Officer, you will support the end-to-end management of client payment requests and ensure a high-quality service to clients, partners, and internal teams. You will play a key role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency in day-to-day operational activities. Your attention to detail and client-centric approach will help maintain our high standards of service and compliance.

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

• Manage client money-out requests from receipt to payment,
(acknowledgement, documentation collection, system input, etc.),
• Conduct due diligence reviews in line with corporate standard to ensure AML/KYC reviews and updates where required,
• Comply with procedures, controls, industry rules and regulations,
• Monitor ongoing transactions until completion and payment,
• Respond to client and partner queries via email and other channels swiftly and accurately to help achieve customer satisfaction as well as service standards,
• Prepare, scan, send confirmation letters and other necessary communication,
• Perform servicing and maintenance tasks on policies,
• Liaise with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate processing,
• Assist colleagues with daily tasks and contribute to continuous process improvement,
• Meet Service Level Agreements and deadlines,
• Uphold quality standards.

Your profile – Have you got what it takes to become our Policy Administration Officer?

• University Degree in Economics, Finance, Business Management or any other relevant field and/or relevant experience in Client Services/ Policy Administration in the insurance sector,
• Previous experience in life insurance, banking, financial services, or operations is an asset,
• Fluency in English. Any other European language is an asset,
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy,
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills,
• Knowledge of AML / KYC requirements preferred,
• Good organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks,
• Team-player with a proactive and flexible mindset,
• Proficient in Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook).

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, colour, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Given the sensitive nature of our business, industry sector and the role as described, the selected candidate is required to provide a criminal record (Bulletin n°3 for Luxembourgish residents). This excerpt will be kept by Utmost Luxembourg S.A. in compliance with article 8-5 (2) of the law of 23 July 2016 and for no longer than one month from the conclusion of the employment contract; otherwise, it will be destroyed without any undue delay should the candidate not be hired.

Utmost Luxembourg S.A. is aware of its obligations under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and is committed to processing your data securely and transparently.

Our Recruitment Privacy Notice is in line with GDPR and provides more information with regards to the types of data that we collect and hold on you as a job applicant, including for the performance of Background Checks.  It also sets out how we use that information, how long we keep it for and other relevant information about your data. jobs.title: Chef de Rang (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Fiche de poste

Responsable d'un rang, c'est-à-dire d'un groupe de tables, le chef de rang doit veiller au bon déroulement du service sur l'ensemble de ces tables.

En cas d'absence du maître d'hôtel prise de commande le chef de rang fait le service à table et débarrassé aidé par des commis.

Lors de la mise en place des tables, il vérifie que rien ne manque; au moment du service, il doit parfaitement bien connaître la carte et les plats pour être en mesure de répondre aux questions des clients, connaître, maîtriser toutes les techniques de présentation et de découpage, voire de flambage.

À la fin du repas, il s'assure de la satisfaction des clients, effectue l'addition et encaisse leur règlement.

Activités principales

• Assurer un excellent service
• Relations avec la clientèle
• Mise en place
• Accueil et accompagnement du client
• Prise de commande et service
• Encadrer le travail des commis

Coordination et contrôle

• effectuer la mise en place des tables avant chaque service,
• vérifier la propreté et l'intégrité de la vaisselle et des couverts,
• mettre en place les consoles de service,
• accueillir et accompagner le client jusqu'à sa table,
• présenter la carte et la carte des vins (en cas d'absence du sommelier)
• prendre la commande et la transmettre à la cuisine,
• connaître parfaitement les plats à la carte ainsi que les éventuels plats du jour,
• expliquer aux clients la composition des plats au moment du service,
• répondre aux questions des clients,
• maîtriser les différentes techniques de découpage et de présentation,
• adapter le service à table en fonction du travail des cuisiniers,
• vérifier le bon déroulement du service,
• encadrer le travail des commis de salle et des serveurs,
• s'enquérir de la satisfaction du client au cours et à la fin du repas,
• éditer l'addition,
• réaliser l'encaissement,
• débarrasser les tables.

Compétences principales

• Analyser rapidement le besoin du client et le conseiller dans ses choix
• Gérer les réclamations et les remarques négatives
• Adopter les gestes et postures permettant de travailler en toute sécurité
• Placer le client au centre de son activité et de sa mission
• Connaissance d'une à plusieurs langues étrangères

Savoir Etre

• Accueillir les clients avec une excellente maîtrise des gestes, de l'expression du visage et du langage
• Adapter son comportement, sa présentation générale à l'image et à la culture de l'établissement
• Assurer la cohésion de l'équipe
• Faire reconnaître et accepter son autorité
• Installer dès la réservation un climat de convivialité en appliquant les codes de l'établissement
• Relever les dysfonctionnements de service et en parler hors présence client

Autres avantages:  Parking, Repas.

We are looking for a Lead Buyer (m/f/d) for our Procurement team

You will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and purchasing activities across your assigned procurement categories while working closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver value through strategic procurement initiatives.

In this role, you will contribute to the development of purchasing strategies, supplier optimization initiatives and cost-saving opportunities. jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Finance Business Partner (Business Services) based in Luxembourg (hybrid). You will partner with Business Services leadership to drive lean accounting, process optimization and AI-driven reporting, lead budgeting and forecasting cycles, and deliver actionable financial insights that improve performance. The role suits a senior, pragmatic finance professional (10+ years) with SAP and BI experience, a strong process orientation, and a proven ability to deliver under pressure.

As Senior Finance Business Partner (Business Services) you will be the finance lead embedded with Business Services, acting as a change agent to drive lean accounting, process optimization and data-driven decision making. You will tightly partner with COO (Head of Business Services) and the business services leaders to translate operational needs into actionable financial insights, streamline processes through automation and AI-enabled tools, and support performance improvement across cost, quality and delivery. This replacement role requires a senior, hands-on professional who thrives under pressure, prioritizes effectively, and contributes as a collaborative team player.

What you will be working on

• Act as the trusted finance partner to CFO, Head of Finance, COO and Business Services leadership: deliver financial insight, challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
• Act as a sparring partner to the Director of FP&A contributing to robust discussions on financial performance, forecasting assumptions, business plans, controlling model and strategic priorities.
• Lead process improvement and lean accounting initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce waste and strengthen internal controls.
• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analysis that support operational decisions — move towards near real-time, KPI-driven dashboards.
• Drive automation and AI adoption across finance processes (reporting, forecasting, reconciliations, controls), identifying opportunities for AI.
• Support monthly close activities and ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial data.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting and budgetary control processes for Business Services; provide scenario analysis and actionable recommendations.
• Translate business change needs into finance requirements and support implementation of new tools, systems or processes (working closely with Digital Accelerator team  and Finance peers).
• Deliver ad hoc financial analysis and sponsor small-to-medium projects that enhance financial performance or operating model.
• Promote financial and business awareness across the Business function and within Finance through coaching and clear communication.

What we look for

• Strong accounting and controlling background with a minimum of 10 years' relevant experience.
• Advanced Excel; experience with SAP finance modules and Reporting tools.
• Hands-on familiarity with automation/AI tools or demonstrable appetite and experience driving such initiatives.
• Solid budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling skills.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; other languages an asset.
• Proven track record in a finance business partnering role supporting shared services, central functions or similar.
• Demonstrable experience running process improvement projects and delivering automation/AI-driven efficiencies.
• Comfortable operating independently, handling ambiguous situations and escalating appropriately.
• Behavioral skills and competencies: growth mindset, change agent, process-oriented, detail focused, pressure management, team work, decision quality and uphold KPMG firm standars.
• Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CPA, CFA or equivalent) and experience in professional services or the Big Four environment as an asset.

jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0

• Zone Industrielle P.E.D, BP 38, Rodange, Luxembourg, Luxembourg Employees work in a hybrid mode
• Full-time
• Compensation: EUR 116,340 - EUR 186,144 - yearly

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

Employment Type: Permanent

Join our team as an AIFM Risk & Valuation Manager, where you'll play a key role in managing risk and valuations for alternative investment funds like private equity, real estate, and infrastructure. You'll work with advanced risk models, prepare reports for senior stakeholders, and support clients in setting up funds. This is a great opportunity to apply your analytical skills, grow your expertise, and make an impact in a dynamic, international environment.

As a vital team member and in return for your expertise, inclusive approach and commitment, we'll provide a favourable salary and the chance to join a passionate and welcoming team. Data & Outils Quantitatifs

• SAS.

• Esprit entrepreneurial et orientation résultats.

jobs.description: A funcao compreende o cumprimento de todas as tarefas inerentes ao posto de trabalho assegurando a correta execucao das operacoes de montagem e desmontagem de tendas e estruturas associadas Inclui a descarga e carga de material nos processos de montagem e desmontagem bem como a organizacao e distribuicao do material no local de instalacao E igualmente da responsabilidade do colaborador proceder a fixacao da tenda realizar a montagem do estrado sempre que necessario e efetuar o levantamento da estrutura metalica Integra ainda a preparacao e decoracao da tenda incluindo a colocacao de forros alcatifas mesas cadeiras e demais equipamentos garantindo a correta instalacao da cobertura da estrutura e o respetivo fecho assegurando condicoes de seguranca e qualidade na execucao dos trabalhos

jobs.title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA RAZREDNE NASTAVE NA TALIJANSKOM JEZIKU U PRODUŽENOM BORAVKU
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10-ispr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 7. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta učitelja/učiteljice razredne nastave na talijanskom jeziku u produženom boravku na neodređeno i puno radno vrijeme – 2 izvršitelja/izvršiteljice, uz uvjet probnog rada prema odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za službenike i namještenike u javnim službama TRAŽENI UVJETI: 1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), sukladno Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20) i temeljem Odluke o organizaciji i provedbi produženog boravka i cjelodnevnog odgojno-obrazovnog rada u osnovnim školama Grada Rijeke („Službene novine Grada Rijeke“ broj 4. – godina XII): - završen sveučilišni diplomski studij - potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom 2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku,
  • presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 10. rujna 2026. godine. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 7 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il posto di lavoro insegnante di classe al doposcuola in lingua italiana – orario completo, a tempo indeterminato – 2 persone, con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), in conformità al Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20) e secondo la Decisione sull'organizzazione e sullo svolgimento del doposcuola e della scuola a tempo pieno nelle scuole elementari della Città di Fiume (Gazzetta ufficiale della Città di Fiume n. 4 – anno XII): - laurea - padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.

Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 10. rujna 2026. godine. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 7 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il posto di lavoro di 1 insegnante di cultura fisico-sanitaria in lingua italiana a tempo indeterminato - orario incompleto (20 ore settimanali) con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20): - laurea - padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.
