jobs.title: Seasonal Worker Wanted – Pumpkin Season 2026
jobs.description:
About Thorsbjerggaard

Thorsbjerggaard is a Danish farm specializing in the cultivation of edible pumpkins. Our products are supplied to many major Danish supermarkets and specialty stores. We also grow peas, squash, and watermelons.

All work is carried out on the farm, including cultivation, harvesting, washing, and packing.

A valid forklift certificate is an advantage and will be preferred.

The certificate must be valid for use in Europe.

Working Period

As soon as possible – end of March 2027

Working Hours

During warm periods, work usually starts at 5:00 a.m. and continues until around 12:00 noon. During busy periods, additional work in the afternoon may be required.

Working hours may vary depending on the weather and workload. Part-time work may occur. You will have at least one day off per week.

Language Requirements

You must be able to speak and understand English.

Wages

Monthly salary

Registered with the Danish tax authorities (SKAT)

Salary paid directly into your bank account, with a pay slip

Requirements

  • You must be at least 18 years old.

  • EU citizenship (a valid passport or national ID card is required).

  • Good physical condition, motivation, and a positive attitude.

  • Farm or harvesting experience is an advantage but not required.

  • A clean criminal record certificate from your home country.

We Expect You To

  • Be reliable and arrive on time.

  • Be flexible and willing to help wherever needed.

  • Work well as part of a team with people from different cultures.

  • Be able to communicate in English.

Accommodation

We have a campsite located on the farm, where you can rent a space in a caravan. Each caravan can accommodate up to four people.

Beds with mattresses are provided, but you must bring your own sleeping bag and bed linen.

The campsite offers access to toilets, showers, laundry facilities, shared cooking facilities (you prepare your own meals), and internet access.

The accommodation fee is all-inclusive.

The cost of accommodation in a caravan is DKK 70 per person per day. A refundable deposit of DKK 1,500 is required and will be returned if everything is left in the same condition as when you arrived.

Holiday Allowance

Holiday allowance will be transferred to FerieKonto and paid according to Danish holiday regulations.

Hygiene Rules

All hygiene regulations relating to the handling and harvesting of food products must be strictly followed. You will receive detailed instructions before starting work.

Failure to follow the hygiene rules may result in immediate dismissal without further warning.

What to Bring

  • Please remember to bring:

  • Sleeping bag

  • Warm clothing

  • Practical work clothes

  • Boots and waterproof clothing

  • Even in good weather, the plants can be very wet in the morning.

Important Documents

You must bring:

  • A valid national ID card (and passport, if possible)

  • A valid IBAN bank account in your own name

  • Documentation proving that you have health insurance in your home country

  • Tax Information 2026

  • You must bring documentation showing that you have a permanent address in your home country.

  • If you worked for us last year and have had other jobs since then, please bring documentation from your most recent employer.

  • If you are married, documentation of your marital status is required.

  • Please bring copies of all original documents, as well as English translations.

How to Apply

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@thorsbjerggaard.dk

If you do not hear from us within two weeks, please assume that your application was unsuccessful and that we are unable to offer you a position for 2026.

jobs.title: Production Planning & Method Engineer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Description:

For our department Production Planning & Method within LuxairAirlines, we are looking for a (an):

Production Planning & Method Engineer (m/f/x)

Main duties:

• Ensure that the internal documentation utilized in Technical Service is adapted and does not deviate from the applicable procedures and regulations
• Review, update and create maintenance tasks issued from the maintenance programs on a regular bases
• Create step sheets for un-/scheduled maintenance in order to achieve the efficient use of given resources and collect feedback aiming for best internal practices
• Participate to regular information exchange meeting with Engineering to be introduce new maintenance program tasks (SB's and AD's) in House.
• Assists on daily hand-over meetings with Maintenance Control and Production to provide a complete work package including priorities assigned to the different work.
• Participate to daily morning meeting and collect defect from line (MEL, PARTS, TOOLS...)
• Checks if documents are complete and usable.
• Checks availability of materials, tools, and ground support equipment and adjust short term planning.
• Requests Engineering to receive additional information when necessary.
• Requests Logistics to prepare necessary parts needed.
• Assign the jobs to be performed to the different shift/teams.
• Gives clear instructions to the Crew Leaders about priorities and deadlines to be set.
• Coordinates workload status and Hangar situations.
• Creates step sheets for unscheduled maintenance such as engine change, propeller change, hard landing, exceedances… aimed at achieving the efficient use of the resources and best internal practices.
• Provide assistance to Engineering and Maintenance Control Center when required.
• Assist in training of production staff on new instructions and processes.
• Recommend methods or equipment intended to improve the Maintenance Process.
• Issue and maintain hangar and shop layout to show the equipment location.
• Perform corrective actions on every non-conform documents (WO, SB, Task cards).

Required profile:

Minimum required criteria:

• Be holder of a licence EASA B1.1 or B2
• Be at least Senior A/C Technician or equivalent
• Have a knowledge of technical operations and regulations applicable to LG Technics
• Accept Duty Travel
• Be familiar with standard office applications
• Have a very good knowledge of IT tools being used in production
• Be well organized
• Show excellent communication skills in English as well as skills in French or German (spoken and written)
• Maintain the strict confidentiality of the data

Desired or to be acquired criteria:

• Refer to the training table
• Be able to take initiative and to be creative
• Be autonomous and well organized
• Demonstrate the ability to communicate at all levels, both inside and outside the company
• Show the ability for clear expression in writing
• Be capable of working independently as well as in a team
• Show administrator skills in the tools used in LG Technics
• Be competent in reading and understanding the manuals issued by the Type Certificate Holder

jobs.title: Head of ICT and Security Risk Management Department (m/f) – CDI
jobs.description:
Title:  Head of ICT and Security Risk Management Department – CDI

Department:  ICT AND SECURITY RISK DEPARTMENT

Description:

The Risk Management Department is responsible for the risk control function of the Bank, encompassing both Financial Risk and Operational Risk matters.
The Risk Management Department monitors existing and emerging risks, assess them and report them to the Senior Management of the Bank. It supports the business in managing their risks, providing guidance to promote risk awareness continuously.

We are seeking an experienced Head of ICT & Security Risk Management on a permanent role to lead our digital operational resilience strategy and ensure full compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and relevant regulatory requirements.

Your main tasks will be to:

• Be responsible for establishing and maintaining and governing a comprehensive ICT risk management framework
• Protect the Bank against cyber threats, operational disruptions, and third-party risks while enabling business growth and innovation.

You will be part of the Facility Management Department, which covers all activities related to buildings, from the design and project phases to their operation. More specifically, you will join the Operations division which includes the maintenance and operation of the technical installations, managed by a team of four people.

Your role:

Expected services:

Continuously ensuring proper functioning of facilities, good condition of workplaces and user satisfaction. All areas inside campuses are included, particularly laboratories where the infrastructures are linked to sensitive activities with high technological and regulatory requirements. The work environment includes the following: energy production and distribution, HVAC, fluid and gas distribution, sanitary installations, electrical installations. As a maintenance officer in charge of those installations, you ensure their availability, compliance with health and safety regulations and efficient energy use while always being user comfort oriented.
Preventive maintenance of the technical installations covered by this position is outsourced to external providers. For troubleshooting and corrective maintenance on these same installations, the University performs the work both internally and externally depending on their complexity. Given that the University outsources the maintenance of its technical installations, the maintenance levels expected for this position are 1 and 2 (according to French standard NF X60-000 - 2016).

Responsibilities:

• Regular inspections of installations, use of the internal service request processing platform and the CMMS software
• Use of facilities monitoring software, data interpretation
• Support and follow-up of interventions by external service providers, ensuring their execution according to the planned schedule and scope of intervention, e.g., maintenance on the main technical installations: HVAC, electricity, carpentry, periodical inspections, various scale work
• Contribute to solving non-compliance observations made by regulation bodies
• Verification of intervention reports and delivery slips
• Carry out inventory monitoring and ensure proper level of stocks
• Requesting price quotes from external service providers, issuing purchase orders
• Regular reporting to management, provide proposals and recommendations for improvements

Scope of activities:

The work will be performed at one or more of the University's sites. The usual working hours are from 7am to 4pm, Monday to Friday. However, these hours may be adjusted to ensure sufficient team coverage between 7am to 6pm. Depending on the needs, work may also be required between 6am and 10pm or outside of these hours, including, where applicable, Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays. jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

jobs.title: BPM & Automation Engineer (all genders), Lausanne (Industrietechnologe/-technologin - Datentechnik)
jobs.description: We bring together AI expertise, engineering excellence and in-depth industry knowledge - driven by people who want to make a difference together. This leads to future-proof solutions that genuinely make a difference in our customers' everyday lives. We achieve this through people who take responsibility, recognise opportunities and turn technological possibilities into tangible results. To this end, we create an environment characterised by mutual support: opportunities for professional development, open communities where knowledge is readily shared, peer groups and training programmes tailored to your needs. Trust, appreciation and successes celebrated together shape the way we work together and make personal development an integral part of our culture. WHAT YOU CAN MOVE Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for automation and optimization. Model business processes using BPMN 2.0 and, where relevant, DMN and CMMN. Design, configure and develop workflows on Flowable, Camunda or similar BPM platforms. Implement process logic, forms, business rules, service tasks and integrations. Integrate BPM solutions with existing applications and IT landscapes using REST APIs and other web services. Work with relational databases and SQL to support process-related data requirements. Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, subject-matter experts, architects and development teams. Translate business requirements into robust, maintainable and scalable technical solutions. Write readable, testable and maintainable code, following clean-code principles. Contribute to testing, deployment, documentation and the ongoing support of automation solutions. Participate in Agile delivery teams and contribute to continuous improvement. Stay up to date with developments in BPM, workflow automation, hyperautomation and related technologies. HOW YOU SUCCEED Good practical knowledge of BPMN 2.0; experience with DMN or CMMN is an advantage. Experience with process analysis, workflow modeling and the implementation of automated business processes. Solid understanding of RESTful web services and experience working with JSON and/or XML. Practical experience with SQL and relational databases. Experience with Git or another version-control system. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. A degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional training and experience. Full professional proficiency in French and English An agile mindset, strong analytical skills and a structured way of working. Good communication and collaboration skills, with confidence when interacting with both technical and business stakeholders. Customer-oriented, proactive and motivated to learn and develop in a growing Business Automation team. Nice to have 2 years of professional experience in BPM, workflow automation, software engineering, business analysis or a comparable field. Experience developing with Java and Spring Boot. Experience with Flowable, Camunda, Appian, Appway, IBM Business Automation Workflow, UiPath or similar platforms. Familiarity with JavaScript and modern web technologies. Experience with Docker and CI/CD practices. Knowledge of Agile methods such as Scrum, Kanban or SAFe. Interest in hyperautomation, AI-supported process automation or agentic automation. Relevant certifications in Flowable, Camunda or another BPM platform.  OPPORTUNITY GIVER - WHAT MAKES ADESSO SPECIAL Our promise: You will feel at home with us! Collegial, collaborative and on an equal footing - we live exchange, team spirit and respectful interaction. We value diversity and different perspectives just as much as you as a person. This and much more stands for our very special sense of togetherness. There's even a word for it: adessi.  Learn and grow with us: we support your continuous development with over 400 training courses and our digital learning platform. Experience real team spirit: joint events (e.g. sport weekend and the annual eduCamp training trip), welcome days and company runs strengthen our team spirit and allow you to be part of the team from the very beginning. Commitment that is rewarded: Your commitment pays off - with bonuses for recommendations, lectures, thesis supervision and attractive benefits via our corporate benefits portal. Our culture and the way we work together are characterized by mutual appreciation, recognition and support. This unites us - even when working from home. Part-time work is possible by arrangement (80-100%). We have once again been voted one of the best employers in Switzerland! Our extensive training program and a transparent career level model for everyone ensure that your development with us never stands still. Because growing together and creating opportunities is programmed into our DNA. CONTACT You will like it here with us! jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent)Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

Nice to have

Bonus Points

- Experience with

jobs.title: SAIMNIECĪBAS PĀRZINIS
jobs.description:
SIA Nordic Equine aicina komandā SAIMNIECĪBAS PĀRZINI

Uzņēmums ir mūsdienīga zirgu saimniecība un staļļu komplekss, kas attīstās un paplašina savu darbību, tāpēc meklējam atbildīgu un tehniski zinošu Saimniecības pārzini, kurš nodrošinās teritorijas un tehnisko sistēmu ikdienas pārvaldību un uzturēšanu.



Galvenie darba pienākumi:
- apsaimniekot uzņēmuma teritoriju un staļļa telpas;
- nodrošināt siltumapgādes un citu tehnisko mezglu ikdienas uzraudzību;
- veikt iekšējo elektrotīklu, apkures, ūdensapgādes, kanalizācijas un signalizācijas sistēmu ikdienas apsekošanu;
- veikt nelielus remonta darbus; plānot un kontrolēt tekošos un kapitālos remontdarbus;
- nodrošināt kvalitatīvu un savlaicīgu remontdarbu izpildi;
- sadarboties ar kolēģiem, ārējiem pakalpojumu sniedzējiem un tehniskajiem speciālistiem.

Prasības kandidātam:
- praktiska pieredze saimniecības vai tehniskās uzturēšanas darbos;
- izpratne par inženiertehniskajām sistēmām (elektrība, apkure, ūdensapgāde u.c.);
- atbildības sajūta un spēja patstāvīgi organizēt darbu;
- tehniska domāšana un problēmu risināšanas prasmes;
-  B kategorijas autovadītāja apliecība.

- Darbs piemērots cilvēkam ar praktisku pieeju darbam, kurš spēj patstāvīgi pieņemt lēmumus un redzēt saimniecību kopumā.

Mēs piedāvājam:
- stabilu darbu augošā uzņēmumā;
- dinamisku darba vidi zirgu saimniecībā;
- konkurētspējīgu atalgojumu, kas tiek noteikts atbilstoši kandidāta pieredzei, zināšanām un kompetencēm. 
- iespēju realizēt savas idejas teritorijas un infrastruktūras uzlabošanā.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer (smelting)
jobs.description:
On behalf of our customer, we are now looking for a Commissioning Engineer with previous work experience related to smelting plants. Headquartered in Espoo, Finland, our customer is providing sustainable technology, equipment, and services for the aggregates, minerals processing, and metals refining industries This position offers a vantage point in the company's deliveries within metals refining and opportunity for you to travel the world. You will take part in the construction, installation and start-up of a new scrap copper smelting plant in Gujarat, India. This is a long-term international assignment, expected to last at least one year, with the possibility of periodic trips home during the assignment. Accommodation and local transportation will, in most cases, be arranged by the customer.


Your responsibilities will include:

- Supervise and coordinate installation and commissioning activities.

- Work closely with the customer, employees, subcontractors and other stakeholders.

- Monitor progress, quality and site activities.

- Support problem-solving during installation and start-up.

- Ensure that work is carried out safely and according to project requirements.

- Coordinate activities between different disciplines when required.

- Report progress and identify potential issues to the project management team.

- Participate in commissioning, testing and start-up activities.

- Act as a practical link between the project team and the site.

What we expect from you:

The technical requirements are relatively broad. The most important qualification is practical experience from a smelting or metallurgical plant environment.

Your background may be in e.g.:

- Mechanical installation and maintenance

- Electrical systems and installation

- Automation and instrumentation

- Production operations

- Maintenance

- Site supervision or commissioning

You do not necessarily need to have a specific engineering background. Relevant hands-on experience in a smelting environment and the ability to take responsibility on site are the key requirements.

- Previous experience in a smelting / metallurgical plant environment is essential.

- Experience in at least one of the following areas: mechanical, electrical, automation, production or maintenance.

- Practical, hands-on approach and ability to work independently.

- Good communication and coordination skills.

- Experience working with customers, employees and subcontractors is an advantage.

- Good command of spoken and written English.

- Willingness to work on an international assignment in India for an extended period.

- Ability to adapt to a multicultural and international working environment.

- An international, English-speaking candidate is preferred, as the role involves close cooperation with an international project organization and customer.


We offer you:

- a great opportunity and vantage point to participating in the ongoing delivery of world-leading technology supplier.

- an opportunity to leave your own mark as member of the site commissioning team while adding a strong reference in your competence portfolio.

- an exciting role contributing to latest smelting technology and sustainability.

- a competitive and encouraging salary closely mirroring your performance.

- opportunity to travel and experience the world in additon to working.

- an opportunity to meet and work with people globally.

The job will start as soon as the right candidate have been selected. Duration is a fixed 12 months. The assignment is also suitable for freelance entrepreneurs part of our supplier network.

Interested? Please submit your application and CV ASAP as we are interviewing candidates as they come in!


ECHO Engineering

Echo Engineering Oy (www.echoengineering.fi) was established in 2019 to respond to the fluctuating demand for assignment-based technical professionals in the technology industry. For our parent company, Kaiku HR, this direction is a natural step towards offering a more comprehensive skill palette for the clients. To chosen clients we not only offer local technical consulting services, but also flexible remote design capacity out of India or bring technical experts to Finland for long-term assignments. Combining our capabilities, we can offer services that correspond to the high Finnish quality standards in a competitive price range. Our key personnel have over 20 years of experience in the field: Mats Lindholms expertise lies in selling services of local hour based freelance engineers, recruiting, and acting as an agent. Anil Talwani has a strong portfolio of selling, organizing, and executing remote design services between Finland and India.

Our parent company Kaiku HR (www.kaikuhr.fi) is a company specialized in recruitment and staffing, connecting the right people with the right jobs. A motivated and enthusiastic employee is key to ensuring the satisfaction of our client companies. Operations are based on a people-focused approach, mutual respect, a straightforward, no-nonsense way of working, and a strong commitment to keeping our promises. In 2025, group revenue was approximately €21.4 million. Over the years, we have successfully recruited thousands of professionals both in Finland and internationally. jobs.title: Site Engineers (Multiple Disciplines), Granlund
jobs.description:
**Are you ready to take an active role in site supervision across demanding international projects? We are now looking for Site Engineers across several technical disciplines to join Granlunds growing Site Services team.**

_Granlund is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our more than 1,600 professionals serve across 30 locations throughout Finland._

**Would you be one of our new Site Engineers?**

As a Site Engineer, you will be responsible for site supervision within your own technical discipline, whether your expertise lies in Civil, Structural, Architectural, Mechanical (HVAC), Electrical, ICT, Security, Automation, or Moisture Management. As the client's technical representative on site, you will play a key role in ensuring that technically demanding projects are executed according to approved plans, technical requirements, contractual obligations, and agreed quality standards.

In your daily work, you will monitor project progress, review installations, materials, and work phases, and ensure that execution aligns with approved plans and technical requirements. You will interpret technical drawings and project documentation, document your observations in digital systems, and help ensure that any quality issues or deviations are addressed appropriately. As a key link between the site and the wider project organization, you will provide accurate and up-to-date information on project progress and site activities.

The positions are full-time and permanent, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The work is strongly site-based, with projects located throughout Finland. The most suitable project location will be discussed during the recruitment process. The role requires regular presence at project sites and readiness to travel.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for professionals who enjoy working close to construction and industrial projects and want to take responsibility for quality and technical execution on site. You have experience in site supervision, quality control, or technical project environments, along with a relevant engineering degree and the ability to interpret technical drawings, plans, and project documentation.

Your background may, for example, be in Civil, Structural or Architectural Engineering, Mechanical (HVAC), Electrical Engineering, ICT, Security, Automation or Moisture Management. Regardless of your discipline, you have a few years of experience working on construction or industrial projects and are comfortable operating in a site-based environment.

Experience with Dalux or Autodesk Construction Cloud is considered an advantage. Fluent English are required, while Finnish language skills are considered an advantage. You will also need a valid driving licence and readiness to work regularly at project sites.

You are proactive, quality-conscious, and eager to develop your expertise. You take responsibility for your work, communicate effectively with different stakeholders, and are not afraid to raise concerns when quality, safety, or project requirements are at risk.

**Why join us?**

At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av fast telefoni till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

jobs.title: Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner to shape St1's CRM approach and deliver the Salesforce-based solutions that support our sales, customer service, and business operations. This role sits where business needs meet technical delivery: you make sure what we build is scalable, secure, and actually adopted by the people who use it.

A big part of the role is partnering with business teams who are actively developing their digital ways of working. You act as a trusted advisor, drawing on experience from multiple Salesforce implementations to guide teams, introduce best practices, and drive real process change and adoption, not just deliver features.

You work closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and administrators, translating requirements into a prioritized backlog and actionable solutions. This is a hands-on role: it combines business analysis with real configuration work in Salesforce, so you are as comfortable writing a user story as you are building in the platform.

How youll help drive the change

Joining St1, youll be part of running and developing a profitable business that invests in long-term energy solutions. Together we achieve the extraordinary through everyday work. As a Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner, youll play a key role in

Product Strategy & Vision

Define and communicate the roadmap for Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud capabilities.

Align platform initiatives with business objectives and customer experience goals.

Continuously evaluate new Salesforce features and innovations for business value.

Backlog & Requirements Management

Own and maintain the Sales & Service product backlog.

Gather, analyze, and prioritize business and technical requirements.

Translate business needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and keep backlog items well-defined and ready for development.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical guidance on Salesforce architecture, integrations, and configurations.

Partner with architects and developers to design scalable, secure solutions, and review designs against best practices and enterprise standards.

Configure Salesforce Sales and Service Cloud hands-on where needed.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Act as the primary liaison between business users, Business Technology, and external vendor teams.

Design and facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and process improvements that help business teams build confidence and capability.

Manage expectations and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies.

Partner with business leads to drive user adoption: coaching teams through change, addressing resistance, and building long-term ownership of new ways of working.

Share insights and best practices from prior implementations to help the business make informed decisions and avoid common pitfalls.

Platform Governance & Quality

Ensure compliance with security, data, and governance standards.

Promote best practices for development, documentation, and deployment.

What you bring to the team

Were looking for a colleague with the drive to challenge, collaborate and grow. To thrive in this role, you likely have:

5+ years of experience working with Salesforce platforms, including 3+ years in a Product Owner, Business Systems Analyst, or Technical Lead role.

Proven hands-on experience configuring Salesforce Sales and Service Cloud.

Strong understanding of CRM, sales operations, and customer service processes.

Demonstrated experience driving organizational change and process adoption in environments with varying levels of digital maturity.

Track record of delivering Salesforce implementations across multiple organizations, with the ability to bring cross-industry best practices to new contexts.

A bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Knowledge of Finnish or Swedish as a native speaker, and fluent written and spoken knowledge of English. Other Nordic languages are a plus.

Nice to have: Salesforce certifications (e.g. Administrator, Platform Developer, Sales/Service Cloud Consultant), experience with Einstein or Agentforce, and experience in large-scale, highly integrated environments.

Who are we looking for

We are looking for your passion, skills and drive. We're looking for those who recognize the St1 Spirit in themselves: Curious, Commercial, Committed and Caring. We value people who are curious, commercial, committed and caring, and who thrive in collaborative, fast-changing environments.

Why Join St1?

- Shape St1s CRM vision and create tangible impact across sales and customer service.
- Blend business insight with hands-on design and delivery.
- Influence how teams adopt modern digital ways of working.
- Develop into Salesforce architecture, AI-powered CRM, or product leadership.
- Helsinki or Stockholm base, with excellent social benefits.
- Work in a high-performing Nordic tech organisation built on trust and responsibility.

How we support your journey

At St1, your safety and wellbeing come first. We offer an open and inclusive workplace where youre respected and trusted to take initiative. In a hands-on, informal culture - and a business that never stands still - theres room to explore ideas and take on new challenges. We support your journey through learning and opportunities to grow across teams and countries.

Youll have real ownership of St1's CRM platform and how it's used, working with a wide range of teams; backed by competitive pay, a bonus scheme and genuine opportunities to grow your career.

If youd like to explore more about our culture, visit our career site.

What to expect after you apply

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive and equitable recruitment process.

Interested? Send us your CV and cover letter via the Barona Career site ASAP. For more information, please reach out to Sr Consultant Arja Martikainen arja.martikainen@barona.fi.

jobs.title: People Analytics & Rewards Specialist
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
As Impact Fund Denmark continues to grow and professionalise, we want more of our people and organisational decisions to be grounded in evidence, data and a clear understanding of what drives behaviour and performance.

That is why we are creating a new role at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent.

You might already work in HR and be looking to build deeper analytical expertise. Or you may come from organisational psychology, economics, analytics or a related field and want to apply your skills in a People & Culture setting.

Either way, what matters most is that you are curious about how organisations work, comfortable working with data, and able to turn analysis into useful insights and practical recommendations and that you take pride in contributing and getting things to impact.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Your role is to help us understand our organisation better — and use that understanding to make better decisions.

Your work will span analytics, reward and talent. You will:

  • Analyse employee, performance, engagement, talent and compensation data

  • Turn data and research into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for People & Culture and management

  • Support compensation benchmarking and our annual salary and compensation processes

  • Contribute to the implementation of the EU Pay Transparency requirements, including the related analysis and reporting

  • Develop dashboards, recurring People reporting and metrics that help us focus on what matters

  • Analyse engagement survey results and help turn them into meaningful organisational actions

  • Support talent, succession and performance processes with analysis and insight

  • Bring relevant research from organisational psychology and behavioural science into the way we design and evaluate People initiatives

  • Challenge assumptions and help us understand whether our interventions are having the intended effect

  • Prepare clear presentations and decision material for colleagues and leadership

  • Contribute to selected organisational development and talent projects

YOUR FIRST YEAR

By the end of your first year, we would expect to see progress in five areas:

  • Data: our People reporting and analytics are clearer, more consistent and more useful

  • Reward: compensation processes are supported by reliable analysis and relevant market data

  • Listening: employee survey data is translated into meaningful insights rather than simply reported

  • Evidence: important People initiatives increasingly have a clear evidence base, purpose and intended outcome

  • Decision support: People & Culture and leadership receive concise, relevant analysis that helps them make better decisions

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This is what we need to see:

  • A relevant academic background, for example in psychology, organisational psychology, economics, business, HR, statistics or another analytical discipline

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills

  • A few years of relevant professional experience. We care more about the quality and relevance of your experience than an exact number of years

  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data

  • The ability to move from data or research to a clear conclusion and a practical recommendation

  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding why People practices work — rather than simply following established practice

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Professional fluency in English

These would be advantages, but they are not requirements:

  • Previous HR experience

  • Experience with Compensation & Benefits or Reward

  • Experience with People Analytics, employee surveys or HR reporting

  • Knowledge of statistics or research methodology

  • Experience with Power BI or similar visualisation tools

  • Experience applying organisational psychology or behavioural science in an organisational setting

  • Emotional intelligence, active listening and the ability to stay neutral under pressure

  • Courage to address uncomfortable issues, strong mediation and conflict-resolution capability

  • Professional fluency in Danish

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

This is an individual-contributor role within People & Culture.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with colleagues responsible for People Partnering, Operations and Recruitment.

Your role is to bring analytical depth and an evidence-based perspective to the areas where it can improve our decisions — particularly Reward, Talent, engagement and organisational development.

The scope is intentionally broad enough for you to grow and develop, but the professional core is clear: using data and evidence to improve people and organisational decisions.

WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to:

  • Help build a new capability at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent

  • Work closely with the Head of People & Culture and colleagues across the function

  • Apply data, research and behavioural science to real organisational questions

  • Build broad experience across compensation, talent, engagement and organisational development

  • Work in an organisation where the People agenda connects to a wider purpose: our colleagues support investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries

PRACTICAL DETAILS

  • Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

  • Hybrid: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home. We aim for first 6 months of employment to be in office for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

  • Application deadline: 23 September 2026

Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

jobs.title: Technical Sales Support Engineer to EYKON, Denmark or Mälardalen, Sweden
jobs.description:
EYKON operates as an independent utility infrastructure technology company built on more than 130 years of utility expertise. Headquartered in Switzerland, with a network of expert local teams, the company serves customers in more than 75 markets and supports over 100 million connected endpoints across the region.

Combining proven metering technology, deep utility expertise and real-world operational insight from one of the largest installed bases in EMEA, EYKON connects what utilities measure with how they operate. This helps customers gain greater visibility, make better decisions, maintain greater control and unlock more value from the infrastructure they already operate.

Do you want to play a key role in the green energy transition while working in the intersection of technology, customer support and commercial development?

EYKON is looking for a Technical Sales Support Engineer to support customers and sales activities across Scandinavia. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating stakeholders and solving a wide variety of customer and business challenges in an international environment.

In this role, you will become a central part of the Scandinavian organisation. Acting as the link between customers, sales teams, product management and technical specialists, you will help ensure that customers receive the right support while contributing to the continued growth of the business across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

The Role

As Technical Sales Support Engineer, you will support Scandinavian customers and the Nordic Sales organisation across EYKON's portfolio of hardware, software and service solutions. The role combines customer support, pre-sales, order management and stakeholder coordination in a truly international environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Supporting customers across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
    Coordinating customer-related activities and acting as the customer's internal ambassador.
    Working in close cooperations with order management team
     Following up on logistics, deliveries and customer commitments.
    Providing technical and commercial support to the sales organisation
    Supporting tenders, RFQs and commercial projects.
    Participating in pre-sales initiatives and customer-facing activities.
    Conducting customer, market and competitor analysis.
    Coordinating activities between customers and internal specialists.
    Supporting customer training, product documentation and knowledge transfer together with Training team och Product Management.

This is a highly collaborative role where your ability to build relationships and navigate different stakeholder groups will be just as important as your technical understanding. You will work closely with experienced specialists while gradually developing extensive knowledge of EYKON's products, solutions and customers.

The preferred location is Sorø, Denmark, but strong candidates located in Sweden, particularly in the Örebro/Mälardalen region, will also be considered. Travel within Scandinavia is included in the role.

Is this you?

To be successful in this role, you have experience from a customer-facing B2B environment involving technical sales, customer support, sales support, application support, pre-sales or similar technical-commercial responsibilities. You are comfortable working with technical products, systems or solutions and enjoy building strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders. Experience coordinating activities across multiple functions and stakeholders is important, as is the ability to support quotations, tenders and customer-related projects. You understand how hardware, software and services interact within a broader solution environment and are able to translate technical topics into practical customer value. Professional proficiency in English together with Swedish and/or Danish language skills is required in the role, as the position involves daily collaboration with colleagues and customers across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

Experience from the energy sector, utilities, smart metering, infrastructure, automation or related technical industries is considered an advantage, but we welcome candidates from a broad range of technical and technical-commercial environments. The most important factor is your ability to learn, build relationships and create value for customers.

In this recruitment, your personal qualities will be of great importance. We are looking for a proactive, structured and customer-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and driving activities forward. You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable operating in the intersection between commercial and technical discussions. As a person, you enjoy creating structure, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring that things get done. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by building relationships, solving problems and supporting both customers and colleagues.

Do you want to know more?

If you have further questions don´t hesitate to contact senior recruitment consultant Stina Koskijev at +46735588921, or stina.koskijev@levelrecruitment.se. Please note, no applications are allowed on email.

Please highlight your key skills and industry experience.

We will interview ongoingly so please register your application as soon as possible.

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av fasta elavtal till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

jobs.title: Löneansvarig till Deichmanns huvudkontor i Köpenhamn
jobs.description:
Deichmann Sko söker en löneansvarig för de svenska lönerna till vårt huvudkontor i centrala Köpenhamn.

Om jobbet

Vill du ta ett helhetsansvar för löneprocessen i Deichmann Sko Sverige? Som Löneansvarig ansvarar du självständigt för hela den svenska lönehanteringen och är företagets specialist inom svensk lön. Du säkerställer att våra medarbetare får rätt lön i rätt tid och är ett viktigt stöd för våra butikschefer och medarbetare i lönerelaterade frågor.

Tjänsten är placerad på Deichmanns nordiska huvudkontor i centrala Köpenhamn, som ansvarar för Deichmanns verksamhet i Danmark och Sverige. Du blir en del av vårt svenska HR-team bestående av en HR Manager och en HR-koordinator och arbetar i nära samarbete med HR kring personaladministration, kollektivavtal och löneprocesser. Samtidigt bidrar du aktivt till att utveckla och effektivisera våra arbetssätt och system.

Som ensam ansvarig för den svenska löneprocessen har du en nyckelroll i verksamheten och rapporterar till vår Finance, IT & Admin Director.

Så får du en bra start hos oss

För att ge dig en bra start i rollen erbjuder vi en överlämningsperiod på två månader. Under denna tid arbetar du tillsammans med vår nuvarande Löneansvarig och får en gedigen introduktion till våra system, rutiner och arbetssätt innan du tar över det fulla ansvaret för den svenska löneprocessen.

Eftersom vår nuvarande Löneansvarig går i pension den 30 april 2027 sker tillträde till tjänsten den 1 mars 2027.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Självständig månatlig lönekörning till för närvarande +250 medarbetare i våra 40 svenska butiker.
    Daglig kontroll, validering och korrigering av löne- och personaluppgifter i relevanta system.
    Dagligt samarbete med HR-avdelningen och support till butikschefer i löpande löneadministration.
    Avstämning, redovisning av skatt AGI, semester, pension, arbetsgivarintyg m.m.
    Kontroll av automatisk bokföring av lönjournaler och diverse löneavstämningar.
    Underhåll och utveckling av lönesystemet (SAP) i samarbete med vårt huvudkontor i Tyskland.
    Bevakning och implementering av lagändringar som påverkar löneområdet.
    Ad hoc uppgifter och optimering av processer i lönearbetet.

Dina kvalifikationer

    Relevant utbildning inom lön eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet för svenska löner, gärna inom detaljhandeln.
    Tidigare erfarenhet av att självständigt ansvara för hela löneprocessen och genomföra lönekörningar från A till Ö för större personalgrupper.
    Kunskap inom kollektivavtal, arbetsrätt och skatt.
    God systemvana och analytisk förmåga.
    Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel och erfarenhet av att ta fram rapporter och analyser.
    Flytande kunskap i svenska, i tal och skrift.

Dina egenskaper

Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad, flexibel och trygg i din yrkesroll. Du är en problemlösare som ser möjligheter framför begränsningar och arbetar noggrant med stor känsla för detaljer. Samtidigt har du lätt för att överblicka, strukturera och prioritera dina arbetsuppgifter, även under perioder med högt tempo och fasta deadlines.

Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för ditt eget arbetsområde, samtidigt som du är kommunikativ, samarbetsorienterad och uppskattar ett nära samarbete med kollegor inom HR. Du bidrar aktivt till ett gott samarbetsklimat och har lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer.

Vi erbjuder

    Ett härligt samarbete med 35 trevliga och kompetenta danska och svenska kollegor på huvudkontoret.
    En arbetsplats i hjärtat av Köpenhamn, mitt emot centralstationen i trevliga och ljusa lokaler.
    Eget kontor tillsammans med HR, med goda möjligheter till både fokus och samarbete.
    Fast anställning.
    37 timmars arbetsvecka (heltid).
    Lön efter kvalifikationer.
    Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och inflytande på det egna arbetsområdet.
    Tjänstepension, personalmatsal, personalrabatter och personalförening.
    Möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån upp till 2 dagar i veckan.

Intresserad?

Känner du igen dig i beskrivningen och tycker att rollen låter intressant? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig. Skicka in din ansökan redan idag via länken nedan.

Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag om vi hittar rätt person. Tillsättning för tjänsten är den 1 mars 2027.

Har du övriga frågor gällande tjänsten så kontakta Finance, IT & Admin. Director Mikkel Linck på telefonnummer +45 33 34 38 22.

Vi tar endast emot elektroniska ansökningar via länk nedan.

_____________________________________________________________________



DEICHMANN-koncernen är marknadsledande i Europa och grundades i Essen 1913 av Heinrich Deichmann. Det är idag en familjedriven verksamhet med tredje generationen vid rodret. Verksamheten har genom åren haft en kontinuerlig tillväxt och är nu representerad i 30 länder med mer än 4.000 butiker över hela världen.

Deichmann är en modern verksamhet som med visionen ”Verksamheten ska tjäna människan” lägger stor vikt vid medarbetarnas trivsel, fokus på bra arbetsvillkor för såväl våra medarbetare som samarbetspartners, och inte minst på att ge kunderna trendiga kvalitetsskor till bra priser. Detta uppnås genom direkta globala inköp, teamwork och en människoorienterad verksamhetskultur.

Sedan 2003 är Deichmann Sko representerat i Danmark och sedan 2007 även i Sverige. Deichmann Sko fortsätter att expandera i Sverige och Danmark de närmaste åren. jobs.title: Team Leader Nurse Team
jobs.description:
Lead a Team of Registered Nurses Providing Medical Assistance Worldwide

Are you an inspiring leader who wants to make a difference every day?

At Viking Travel Care, we help travellers who become ill or injured while abroad. From our offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola, Spain, we provide travel and medical assistance services 24/7, 365 days a year to customers and travellers worldwide.

We are now looking for a Team Leader for our Medical Assistance Coordinator (Nurse) team.

Our Nurses are experienced Registered Nurses from the Nordic countries. They assess medical reports, coordinate treatment, communicate with healthcare providers around the world, handle own medical cases, and support travellers during some of life's most challenging moments. They also serve as an important medical resource for colleagues across the Travel Care operation.

As Team Leader, you will have day-to-day personnel responsibility for a team of highly skilled nurses, supporting their development and helping ensure that the Medical Assistance team works in a structured, professional, and reliable way.

You will work closely with Viking Travel Care's Medical Management and Operations Management teams, as well as fellow Team Leaders, to support the continued development of our medical assistance services. In this role, you will act as an important link between the Medical Assistance team and management, helping translate strategic priorities into daily operations, quality improvements, and employee development.

This is a unique opportunity to combine healthcare expertise with people leadership in an international and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

    Personnel responsibility for a team of Medical Assistance Coordinators (nurses)
    

    Conduct performance reviews, development conversations, and regular follow-up meetings
    

    Drive employee engagement, professional development, and competence building within the team
    

    Support recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members
    

    Ensure delivery of agreed service levels, KPIs, and quality standards
    

    Monitor workloads, staffing, and operational priorities
    

    Support daily operations and assist with complex cases when needed
    

    Handle administrative responsibilities such as scheduling, absence follow-up, and workforce planning
    

    Promote high clinical and documentation standards
    

    Ensure compliance with SOPs, routines, and quality requirements
    

    Support the implementation of new processes, routines, and quality initiatives within the Medical Assistance team
    

    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects across Travel Care

Qualifications Required

    Experience from healthcare, medical assistance, travel assistance, insurance, customer service, operations, or another relevant field.
    

    Fluent in one of the Nordic languages and English
    

    Strong communication and interpersonal skills
    

    Comfortable working in a dynamic and international environment
    

    Strong IT skills and ability to quickly learn new systems
    

    Clean criminal record

Preferred

    Relevant experience in people leadership, team coordination, employee development, or similar responsibilities.
    

    Registered Nurse holding a valid nursing licence recognised within the EU, with a minimum of three years of clinical nursing experience
    

    Experience from travel assistance, insurance medicine, emergency care, intensive care, ambulance services, acute care, or similar fields

What can we offer the right candidate?

    Competitive salary and employment conditions
    

    Permanent employment contract under Spanish labour law
    

    Employer-provided laptop and mobile phone
    

    Comprehensive onboarding and training programme
    

    A supportive and collaborative work environment with highly skilled colleagues
    

    Social activities and team events
    

    Modern offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola
    

    The opportunity to work in an international organisation helping travellers worldwide

Are you the one we're looking for?

The right person for this position is a positive and approachable leader who enjoys helping others succeed. You thrive in a dynamic environment, balancing operational priorities with employee development. You are organised, solution-oriented, and focused on creating clear and reliable ways of working for your team. You enjoy working closely with others while also taking ownership and acting independently when needed.

Most importantly, you believe that great customer care starts with strong teamwork, professional judgement, and clear, friendly communication.

About Viking

Viking Assistance Group is a leading roadside and travel assistance company in the Nordics. Viking Travel Care is the group’s travel and medical assistance division, providing assistance services 24 hours a day, 365 days a year to travellers and employees abroad. Across our services, we aim to make assistance easy to access, reliable in delivery, and friendly in every interaction.

Workplace

The position will be based at Viking Travel Care in Torrevieja or Fuengirola, Spain.

Working Hours

The role follows the Team Leader rotation and includes day, evening, and occasional weekend shifts, with flexibility needed to support a 24/7 operation when required.

Start Date

As soon as possible.

Deadline

Please apply before September 30th

jobs.title: Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS HGCAL
jobs.description:
What you'll do
As Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in the development, integration, testing and commissioning of the power systems for one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived.

Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the procurement and testing of power supplies for HGCAL detector modules, including low-voltage, high-current supplies for the readout electronics and medium-voltage supplies of up to 800 V for sensor biasing.

You will also contribute to the integration of power systems with the detector's safety, control and monitoring systems, as well as the testing and implementation of power components such as DC-DC converters, voltage regulation and cabling.

A key aspect of the role will be to assess the impact of the power system on HGCAL performance and to develop and implement strategies to minimise noise effects such as interference, coupling and ripple.

This role offers the opportunity to combine strong electrical engineering and detector-physics skills with hands-on involvement in the construction, testing and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Follow the procurement of the power supplies (Low Voltage and Bias Voltage, totalling several MCHF), including carrying out acceptance and stress tests on the delivered units.
Support the commissioning of these power systems during the mass assembly and testing phases of HGCAL.
Work with physicists and engineers to evaluate the performance of HGCAL in relation to its power systems and to develop and implement mitigation strategies where possible and necessary, first on the surface and subsequently when HGCAL is installed in CMS, 100 metres underground.
Work with the HGCAL and central CMS Technical Coordination teams to oversee the installation and testing of the power systems underground in the "Service" and "Experimental" caverns. This will include overseeing cable installation, in-situ connectorisation where needed, testing and commissioning, and the integration of the power system into the HGCAL and CMS safety and monitoring systems.

Your profile
Strong track record in testing, operating and debugging power systems for complex devices, such as particle detectors used in high-energy physics experiments.
Experience with silicon- and/or scintillator-based particle detectors would be an advantage.
Experience with large-scale procurement of electronic systems, such as power supplies.
Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Construction, test and installation of power electronic components and systems.
Specification and follow-up of technical aspects of a contract.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Assimilates large quantities of information, identifies key issues and formulates conclusions clearly and concisely.
Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
View less skills

jobs.title: rdinator for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
jobs.description:
What you'll do
As Field Coordinator for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in coordinating and overseeing the assembly, integration, testing and commissioning of one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived. Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will help coordinate the mass assembly and testing of HGCAL detector elements ("cassettes") on the surface, their integration into the complete 250-tonne detector, and the subsequent system-level testing.

You will also contribute to the installation and commissioning of HGCAL approximately 100 metres underground within CMS, including the integration and testing of essential services such as CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and optical fibres. This role offers the opportunity to combine strong technical coordination skills with hands-on involvement in the construction and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Oversee the operation and maintenance of the HGCAL assembly and testing facilities at CERN, which include large ISO 7 cleanrooms and a large assembly hall. These areas are equipped with high-power electrical and cooling infrastructure that must be operated continuously and safely. You will be responsible for planning and organising the execution of all interventions in these facilities.
Provide technical support to physicists, engineers and technicians using these facilities. This will include liaising with the HGCAL Technical Coordinators and Safety Officer, as well as with the central CMS Technical Coordination team and CERN service groups (e.g. HVAC, electrical infrastructure, etc.).
Plan and supervise all activities related to the large-scale detector integration, including cassette insertion (Hadronic section of HGCAL - CE-H) and stacking (Electromagnetic section - CE-E), the mechanical and electrical connection between CE-E and CE-H, installation and testing of the HGCAL thermal screen (to maintain the exterior at a warm temperature while the interior is cold), and cold testing of the complete detector.
Work with the HGCAL team to plan and execute tests of "sectors" of HGCAL on the surface, and similarly when HGCAL is installed inside CMS.
Work with the HGCAL Engineering Team to ensure the safe transport of large and delicate HGCAL structures around the site, as well as the overall lowering of HGCAL into the experimental cavern.
Oversee logistics for HGCAL-related items, including detector modules, cassettes, ancillary equipment and mechanical components.

Your profile
Strong track record in planning and coordinating facilities for the assembly and testing of complex devices, such as particle detectors.
Demonstrated experience in the assembly and testing of particle detectors, particularly those based on silicon sensors, would be an advantage.
Familiarity with project planning tools such as Merlin and MS Project.
Proven ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multidisciplinary teams of engineers, scientists and technicians.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Operation and maintenance of electromechanical equipment and systems.
Operation and support of experimental facilities.
Organisation, planning and control.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
Coordinates activities and focuses team on goals and objectives; monitors progress of team towards agreed goals and takes corrective action when needed.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Anticipates obstacles; assesses alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.
Objectively assesses and monitors own work; regularly reports on progress and advises of any changes in schedule or priorities.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
