jobs.title: Technical Education Specialist
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Notion’s product surface expands, we need a builder-teacher who can turn new capabilities into technically accurate education that helps customers confidently build with Notion. In this role, you’ll explore Notion’s newest capabilities, teach by showing, and ship as the product evolves. You’ll be the technical face of Notion Academy: leading workshops, recording walkthroughs, and building implementation guides.

 

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Expand Notion’s technical education library. Author technically rigorous Academy content, implementation guides, and Help Center resources that make our most complex capabilities easier to understand and adopt.

 - Become a trusted voice for Notion Academy. Teach customers through video, live webinars, and workshops, demonstrating real workflows and solving problems in real time.

 - Build with Notion’s newest capabilities. Get hands-on with new product features, use customer insights to identify high-value use cases, and determine top priority workflows for education to focus on.

 - Reimagine learning with AI. Experiment with adaptive, contextual learning experiences that respond to what customers are trying to build and where they need help.

 - Prove and scale the impact of technical education. Use product adoption signals to measure impact and improve what we teach, then build reusable standards to help the team deliver effective technical learning faster.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Builder mindset: You learn new product features by getting hands-on, experimenting, and building until you understand.

 - Comfort navigating technical content: you don’t need to write code, but you can read a technical architecture doc, identify what’s outdated, and work with engineers to fix it.

 - Customer-facing credibility: You’re comfortable teaching, building, and troubleshooting in front of customers.

 - AI experimentation: You actively use AI to build, learn, and teach technical proficiency.

 - Product expertise: You can quickly understand a new feature, identify where it creates meaningful customer value, and turn that into practical use cases.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Notion product expertise

 - Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, developer relations, or technical enablement



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $135,000 - $180,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Identity & Authorization
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Product Platform builds and owns the shared foundations the rest of Replit is built on, spanning the full stack so every other team can ship features safely and quickly.

Identity & Authorization defines how people, agents, sandboxes, and services prove who they are and what they can do. These systems protect critical product and service interactions across Replit's web product, Agent, enterprise controls, and internal services.

Our work is high-leverage and horizontal: when identity and policy are clear, reliable, and easy to adopt, every other team can move faster without rebuilding security controls.

We are a small, collaborative team that values curiosity and clear thinking over pedigree, and we work in the open by bringing each other the problem rather than just the request. We care more about how you reason and build than the route you took to get here.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the identity and authorization systems that protect critical interactions on Replit, including Agent acting on behalf of a user or holding their own identity.

The work is guided by a few simple questions:

 - Can every protected request prove which workload made it, which principal it represents, and who is acting on that principal's behalf?

 - Can product teams express policy once and trust the same decision across web, mobile, Agent, and internal services?

 - Can enterprise administrators control who can access each workspace, app, connector, and Agent capability without navigating a permission maze as well as having a legible ledger of decisions?

 - Can Agent act for a user across long-running and durable work without receiving broad or long-lived credentials?

 - Are identity and authorization fast, reliable, highly available, and observable enough for the product flows that depend on them?




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and operate central authorization interfaces with typed principals, actions, resources, decisions, explainable deny reasons, privilege attenuation, delegations, and obligations

 - Evolve enterprise roles, groups, app access, entitlements, and workspace policy so common cases stay simple and advanced cases remain possible

 - Build and operate Replit's Security Token Service and workload identity using OAuth 2.0 token exchange, JWT/OIDC, SPIFFE/SPIRE, and mTLS

 - Threat-model delegation, confused-deputy risks, and cross-tenant movement, then make secure, fail-closed behavior the default

 - Lead compatible migrations with shadow evaluation, feature gates, telemetry, and rollback plans, and own the SLOs, incidents, and operational health of the systems you ship

 - Partner with Agent, Connectors, Enterprise, Security, and Infrastructure teams to turn product requirements into shared platform primitives

 - Research and develop new innovative approaches to Authx in the Agentic world




AREAS YOU MIGHT WORK IN

 - Authorization policy: evolve Replit's central policy decision point and migrate fragmented authorization checks to its typed contract.

 - Agent delegation: extend the current delegation foundation so the user is the subject and Agent is the authenticated actor, with continuous validation and dynamic permission envelopes as work runs.

 - Enterprise access control: evolve roles, groups, workspace policy, and app-level grants for both simple collaboration and complex organizations.

 - Agent and service identity and reliability: operate the token and workload-identity systems that protect service-to-service traffic.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - Experience shipping and operating security-sensitive backend or distributed systems in production, including reliability, performance, incidents, and observability

 - Depth in authentication, authorization, or identity systems, such as OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, Identity Federation, RBAC, ReBAC, PBAC, Zanzibar, Macaroons, Biscuits, Cedar, or policy engines. You do not need prior experience with every item

 - Strong understanding of multi-tenant security, least privilege, delegation, privilege attenuation, auditability, and threat modeling

 - Experience migrating security-sensitive systems without breaking callers. Approaches can include typed contracts, shadow evaluation, and staged enforcement

 - Fluent in at least one production backend stack. Our systems use TypeScript, Go, Rust, Postgres, gRPC/Protobuf, Kubernetes, Envoy, and Restate

 - Able to make and communicate tradeoffs across security, reliability, latency, product experience, delivery speed, and long-term maintainability

jobs.title: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor
jobs.description:
About the position

Ferrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.

You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.

Your main responsibilities
  • Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.
  • Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.
  • Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.
  • Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.
  • Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.
  • Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.
  • Perform service, inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, modifications and format changeovers on existing systems.
  • Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.
  • Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance
  • Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.
  • Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.
  • Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.

Your professional background
  • You have a relevant technical qualification, for example as an industrial mechanic, marine engineer, metal fabricator, automation technician or similar. Extensive relevant industry experience may compensate for a different educational background.
  • You have several years of hands-on experience with the installation, servicing and commissioning of machinery or complete lines for the beverage, brewery, food or packaging industry.
  • You have in-depth knowledge of filling lines and preferably experience with fillers, cappers, can seamers, conveyors, mixers/carbonators, pasteurisation, CIP and utility equipment.
  • Experience from a manufacturer or service organisation such as Krones, KHS, Sidel, GEA or another supplier of process and filling lines would be a clear advantage.
  • You are able to read and work from mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, pneumatic diagrams, manuals and technical documentation.
  • You have strong mechanical expertise and can perform precise alignment, installation, adjustment and systematic troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, variable frequency drives, sensors and Siemens PLC/HMI systems is an advantage, but this is not a dedicated PLC programming role.
  • You can communicate professionally in written and spoken English. Danish or another European language would be an advantage.
  • You hold a valid driving licence and a valid EU/EEA passport, and are able to travel and work throughout Denmark and Europe without significant restrictions.

Personal qualities
  • You take ownership of your assignments and maintain an overview, even when schedules are tight or several disciplines are working simultaneously.
  • You are hands-on, solution-oriented and comfortable working independently away from the office.
  • You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.
  • You work in a structured manner and follow up on agreements, open items, safety, quality and documentation.
  • You are flexible regarding travel, working hours and changing priorities and understand that start-ups and production-critical service assignments may require additional effort.

We offer
  • A permanent position with significant influence on the successful delivery of international customer projects.
  • A varied working day involving new installations, commissioning, service and technical problem-solving.
  • The opportunity to work with complete solutions - from process systems and utilities to the finished filling line.
  • Close cooperation with project managers, engineers, automation specialists, suppliers and customers' technical organisations.
  • An informal company with short decision-making paths, a high level of responsibility and a strong focus on quality and professional integrity.
  • Salary and employment terms based on qualifications, together with relevant travel conditions and work equipment.


Practical information

Work location: Ferrum's base in Fredericia, combined with assignments at customer sites in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe.
Travel: Extensive and varying according to the project portfolio. Overnight travel and assignments lasting several weeks may occur.
Employment: Permanent position.

Application
Please send your application and CV, including a brief description of your experience with filling lines, installation, service and commissioning. Please also state which machine types and suppliers you have previously worked with and the level of travel you are accustomed to.

jobs.title: Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor in Defense-related Technologies for Unmanned Aerial Systems Engineering for Defense
jobs.description:
SDU Drone Center at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), University of Southern Denmark in Odense invites applications for positions in defense-related technologies for Drones (Unmanned Aerial Systems, UAS) at the levels of Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor. The positions are available from January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

What we offer
The successful candidate(s) will join the SDU Drone Center, located at SDU Campus and at HCA Airport, where we operate state-of-the-art indoor and outdoor drone laboratories. You will become part of an interdisciplinary and agile research environment with strong ties to the internationally recognized robotics ecosystem in Odense.

 

What We expect
We expect candidates to have documented expertise in systems engineering for unmanned aerial systems with demonstrated real-world applications. The successful candidate will conduct research in aerial robotics, focusing on the design and implementation of drones operating in dynamic and complex outdoor environments. Relevant research areas include, but are not limited to, autonomous systems, swarming, navigation in GNSS-denied environments, communication and coordination, airspace situational awareness and management, safety and security, and counter-drone technologies.

Experience in defense-related research and/or applications is considered an advantage.

 

Commensurate with the seniority of the position applied for, the candidates must have:

  • Strong research and publication record;

  • Experience with defense, industrial, public sector and/or emergency services collaboration (this is a requirement for Full Professor);

  • Proven track record of attracting research funding (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor);

  • Experience with teaching and education development (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor).

The successful candidate(s) are expected to play a proactive role in contributing to and expanding the Center’s research portfolio. This includes active participation in ongoing projects as well as the development, leadership, and coordination of new externally funded research initiatives. The candidate(s) are further expected to secure competitive national and international research funding, establish strategic collaborations with academic, industrial, and defense stakeholders, and strengthen the Center’s position in civil and defense-related drone technologies.

The candidate(s) will contribute to teaching and supervision within the Master of Science education in Drones and Autonomous Systems, which is part of the Robotics MSc programme at the University of Southern Denmark.

Research environment
SDU Drone Center conducts research in drone technologies and future drone applications within areas such as defense, infrastructure inspection, healthcare logistics, precision agriculture, nature conservation, and environmental monitoring. We are an interdisciplinary team of researchers with specializations within robotics, computer vision, software, embedded systems, and the design and construction of drone systems. Together we create drone solutions for a flourishing European society. Learn more about the center at https://www.sdu.dk/uasFor further information please contact Head of SDU Drone Center, Professor Ulrik Pagh Schultz, ups@mmmi.sdu.dk,  phone: +45 6550 3570.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration (mandatory for full professor and associate professor applicants).

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience (for assistant professor applicants).

  • Research plan.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and appointment as an associate professor and full professor is permanent. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an associate professor and full professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position as an associate professor or a full professor. A completed lecturer training programme or equivalent pedagogical/didactical competence development is a prerequisite. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, associate professor or full professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

La mission couvre l'ensemble du cycle Meta Ads, de l'audit et la définition de la stratégie jusqu'à la création, au lancement et à l'optimisation continue des campagnes sur Facebook et Instagram, avec une approche résolument orientée performance, conversions et rentabilité. Vos responsabilités Stratégie & Audit Meta Ads Auditer les comptes publicitaires existants et identifier rapidement les opportunités d'amélioration. Définir les stratégies d'acquisition en fonction des objectifs, du marché et du budget de chaque client. Structurer les comptes et campagnes afin de maximiser leur efficacité. Définir les audiences, objectifs de campagne et parcours de conversion adaptés. Création & Gestion des Campagnes Créer, paramétrer et gérer des campagnes Facebook Ads et Instagram Ads via Meta Ads Manager. Piloter des campagnes de génération de leads, trafic, conversions, ventes et retargeting. Construire et optimiser les audiences : ciblage, Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences et retargeting. Structurer les campagnes, ensembles de publicités et annonces. Définir les angles publicitaires et recommandations créatives adaptés aux différentes audiences. Tester différents formats, messages, visuels, vidéos et appels à l'action. Budget & Optimisation Piloter les budgets et stratégies d'enchères. Identifier les campagnes, audiences, placements et créations les plus performants. Mettre en place des A/B tests et expérimentations afin d'améliorer continuellement les résultats. Analyser la fréquence, le coût d'acquisition et la fatigue créative. Ajuster les investissements en fonction des performances et des objectifs de rentabilité. Tracking & Analytics Mettre en place, vérifier et optimiser le Meta Pixel. Maîtriser les problématiques liées à la Conversions API (CAPI) et au tracking server-side. Utiliser Google Analytics 4 et Google Tag Manager pour compléter l'analyse des performances. Vérifier la qualité et la fiabilité du tracking des événements et conversions. Comprendre les problématiques d'attribution entre Meta et les autres canaux d'acquisition. Performance & ROI Suivre les principaux KPI : CPM, CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, taux de conversion et ROAS. Analyser les performances et transformer les données en actions concrètes. Identifier les audiences, campagnes et créations générant les meilleurs résultats. Concevoir des reportings clairs orientés performance, conversions et ROI. Fournir des recommandations concrètes et priorisées pour chaque client. Assurer une veille régulier/ière sur les évolutions de Meta Ads et les nouvelles fonctionnalités de la plateforme. Profil recherché Expérience : expérience solide et démontrable dans la gestion et l'optimisation de campagnes Meta Ads, idéalement sur plusieurs secteurs d'activité. Meta Ads : excellente maîtrise de Meta Ads Manager et de la gestion de campagnes Facebook et Instagram. Acquisition : bonne compréhension des stratégies de génération de leads, conversion et retargeting. Tracking : bonne maîtrise du Meta Pixel, des événements de conversion et bonne compréhension de la Conversions API. Analytics : bonne connaissance de Google Analytics 4 et Google Tag Manager. Créatives : capacité à analyser les performances des créations et à formuler des recommandations sur les angles, messages, formats et contenus à tester. Performance : approche fortement orientée ROI et rentabilité, au-delà des simples métriques de visibilité ou d'engagement. Analyse : capacité à interpréter les données et à transformer rapidement les résultats en actions d'optimisation concrètes. Organisation : excellente capacité à gérer plusieurs comptes et projets simultanément et à travailler de manier/ière autonome. Qualités : autonomie, rigueur, proactivité et capacité à formuler des recommandations. Références : la capacité à présenter des cas concrets de campagnes gérées, budgets pilotés et résultats obtenus sera particulier/ièrement appréciée. jobs.title: Social Media Manager Freelance -  % Télétravail (H/F)
jobs.description: À propos de la mission Nous recherchons un(e) Freelance Social Media Manager expérimenté(e) pour développer et piloter la présence de nos clients, principalement des TPE et PME, sur les réseaux sociaux. La mission couvre l'ensemble du cycle Social Media : de la définition de la stratégie éditoriale à la création et publication des contenus, en passant par l'animation des communautés et l'analyse des performances. Nous recherchons un profil capable de travailler de manier/ière autonome sur plusieurs clients et d'adapter la stratégie, le ton et les contenus aux objectifs de chaque entreprise. Vos responsabilités Stratégie Social Media Définir des stratégies Social Media adaptées aux objectifs, à la cible et au positionnement de chaque client. Identifier les plateformes les plus pertinentes : LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, etc. Définir les lignes éditoriales, piliers de contenu, formats et fréquences de publication. Construire et gérer les calendriers éditoriaux. Réaliser une veille régulier/ière sur les tendances, formats et évolutions des différentes plateformes. Création & Rédaction de Contenu Concevoir les sujets et angles éditoriaux adaptés à chaque marque. Rédiger les publications en respectant le ton et l'identité de chaque client. Créer des contenus engageants adaptés aux spécificités de chaque plateforme. Rédiger des accroches, captions et appels à l'action efficaces. Adapter et décliner les contenus entre les différentes plateformes. Utiliser les outils d'IA de manier/ière pertinente pour accélérer la recherche, l'idéation et la production de contenu. Création & Coordination Visuelle Définir les besoins en visuels, vidéos, carrousels, infographies et autres formats. Être capable de produire des contenus visuels simples à l'aide d'outils tels que Canva. Préparer des briefs clairs pour les graphistes, vidéastes ou motion designers lorsque des créations plus avancées sont nécessaires. Garantir la cohérence entre les contenus publiés et l'identité visuelle de chaque marque. Publication & Community Management Planifier et publier les contenus sur les différentes plateformes. Assurer la cohérence et la régularité des publications. Suivre les commentaires, messages et interactions. Animer les communautés et favoriser l'engagement. Identifier les opportunités permettant de développer organiquement les audiences. Performance & Reporting Suivre les principaux KPI : portée, impressions, engagement, croissance de l'audience, clics, trafic et conversions. Analyser les performances des publications et identifier les formats et sujets les plus efficaces. Adapter les stratégies éditoriales en fonction des résultats. Produire des reportings clairs accompagnés de recommandations concrètes. Piloter la stratégie avec une approche orientée visibilité, engagement et génération d'opportunités commerciales. Profil recherché Expérience : expérience solide et démontrable en Social Media Management, idéalement acquise en agence ou avec la gestion simultanée de plusieurs clients. Réseaux sociaux : excellente maîtrise de LinkedIn, Instagram et Facebook. La connaissance de TikTok est un plus. Content & Copywriting : excellente capacité rédactionnelle et capacité à adapter le ton, les messages et les formats selon les marques et leurs audiences. Création : bonne maîtrise de Canva ou d'outils similaires pour la production de contenus simples et capacité à travailler avec des créatifs sur des productions plus avancées. Stratégie : capacité à construire une véritable stratégie éditoriale au-delà de la simple publication de contenus. Analytics : capacité à analyser les performances Social Media et à transformer les résultats en recommandations concrètes. IA : bonne maîtrise des outils d'IA appliqués à la recherche, l'idéation et la création de contenu. TPE/PME : bonne compréhension des enjeux et contraintes des petites et moyennes entreprises. Organisation : excellente capacité à gérer plusieurs clients et calendriers éditoriaux simultanément. Qualités : autonomie, créativité, rigueur, proactivité et capacité à proposer régulier/ièrement de nouvelles idées. Portfolio : la capacité à présenter des comptes gérés, exemples de contenus réalisés et résultats obtenus sera particulier/ièrement appréciée. jobs.title: Engineering Manager TLM Platform
jobs.description:
The Problem

36 million businesses in America need insuranceâit's not optional. 77% are underinsured. 40% have no coverage at all. The distribution system failed them: too slow, too opaque, too confusing.

Over 90% of commercial insurance is still human-led. We're building the inverse: 90%+ AI-led, pushing toward the higher 90s. Not by patching legacy workflowsâby building AI that makes humans more effective, improves the customer experience, and eliminates friction at every step.

We're adding ~1,000 customers per month. We've grown 100x since last year. We're looking to do even more this yearâand that's why we're hiring.

You'll build the team and the systems the rest of engineering depends on. When they compound, everyone gets faster.

The Thesis

Harper runs 200+ services across Railway and AWS. We orchestrate N parallel agentic workloads. Our AI systems make thousands of decisions a day, and every decision needs to be traceable, evaluated, and cheaper to run tomorrow than it is today. The infrastructure underneath all of that is the difference between a company that scales and one that stalls.

Great platform engineering here isn't invisibleâit's the reason product ships fast. When observability catches a silent failure before a customer does. When a pooling layer makes connection exhaustion a non-issue. When developer velocity doubles because someone built the tool nobody knew they needed. That leverage compounds across every other engineer on the team.

The Role

This role is open both to an experienced EM and to someone on the path to becoming an EM who doesn't yet have significant management experienceâwe're happy to bring that person on and support the transition.

This is a team that still needs to be built. We have 2 people in it today, and we believe this area needs significant investment at Harper. The role owns three things: infrastructure (cloud, third-party vendors, and everything surrounding it), developer productivity (making sure we're genuinely an AI-first shop, with the right AI tooling and harnesses in place for every other engineering team to be successful), and SRE and production support (production discipline is top of mind as we head into a high-growth, high-scale phaseâwe need someone who has run an SRE function before). Each of these three areas can grow into a larger team of its own over time.

The team is 2 people today, growing to five to six over the next three months. Because the team is small, whoever takes this roleâEM or TLMâwill need to be hands-on at the start, working directly with the team and doing the work themselves.

What You'll Do

  • Own infrastructure â cloud, third-party vendors, and everything surrounding it

  • Build developer productivity â the AI tooling and harnesses that make every other engineering team genuinely AI-first

  • Own SRE and production support â bring production discipline as we head into a high-growth, high-scale phase

  • Build out the team â grow from 2 people to five to six over the next three months

  • Stay hands-on â with a team this small, work directly alongside your engineers and do the work yourself, not just direct it

  • Grow each function over time â infrastructure, developer productivity, and SRE/production support can each become a larger team of its own

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • Have at least 2 years as a line manager directly managing teams of six to ten peopleâor clear readiness to grow into that role

  • You've been a line manager for at least two years, directly managing teams of six to ten peopleâor you're on a clear path there and want to grow into it

  • You have hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and strong database troubleshooting skills

  • You've seen real scaleâon the order of at least a million requests per minute

  • You can troubleshoot across databases, networking, compute, Docker, Kubernetes, and other aspects of infrastructure

  • You care as much about developer productivity and AI tooling as you do about raw infrastructure

  • You know on-call practices, SLAs, SLOs, and SRE practices generally

  • You want to stay hands-on and grow into a fuller managerial role over time

  • You move fast, with the same appetite as the rest of Harper

Nice to Have

  • Your own network to draw on for hiringâotherwise, comfort working closely with recruiters

  • Experience building developer productivity tooling and AI harnesses for other engineering teams

  • Experience building a team from a very small base

  • Prior startup experienceâespecially at a company scaling through hypergrowth

Compensation & Logistics

  • Salary: $225,000â$275,000

  • Location: San Francisco, in-office. Based in SF or willing to relocate.

  • Schedule: MondayâFriday, in-office five days a week.

  • Benefits: Uber commuter benefits; breakfast, lunch, and dinner provided; snacks, drinks, and coffee daily; free gym membership; health, dental, and vision insurance.

The Process

  1. Hiring Manager screen - 30 min video chat.

  2. Technical screen â 60 min remote: project deep dive + system design

  3. Super Day on-site â meet the team, sit in on the operation, do real work alongside us.

jobs.description:
â¡ This one's going to move fast. We're expecting a lot of interest, so we're running this as a focused hiring sprint. Applications and assessments close September 20, with interviews happening over the two weeks after that.Â

Hi there, I'm Olive Turon, Head of People & Culture at TestGorilla. I'm excited to share more about the Senior People & Talent Operations Partner role and our team.

About TestGorilla

At TestGorilla, we're on a mission to place 1 billion people in their dream jobs. To democratize opportunity, we're building the world's leading skills-based talent discovery platform - one that replaces reliance on resumes with scientific validation of what people can truly do.

Founded as a 100% remote company in 2020, our global team is united by high standards, a lot of heart, and a relentless drive to conquer new technological frontiers. We're all AI-fluent builders who care deeply about replacing bias with fairness.

After empowering thousands of companies to hire smarter and faster, we're now unlocking the next phase of our scale-up journey - where you'll play an instrumental role in creating a world where skills matter most!

About the role

As our Senior People & Talent Operations Partner, you'll own People Ops as a product: the systems, compliance, and self-serve workflows that let most of People & Culture run itself day to day, plus the tooling behind how we hire. You'll join a lean, two-person team, working directly with me, with proper and lasting ownership from day one.Â 

Payroll, compliance, and HR systems across every (35, currently!) country we operate in are foundational elements of this role. Just as critically, you'll build and own the AI/automation and self-serve layer that keeps our People function lean, bringing a product mindset to everything you touch.Â  Letâs face it: weâre a scale-up, so youâll also need to be happy wearing other People hats when the moment requires.

We're looking for someone autonomous, opinionated and candid, who'll tell me when I've got it wrong. You'll be dealing with real people and real problems, so you'll need to stay empathic but boundaried, structured and organized even when the pace picks up.

Iâm biased, but I think itâs a dream job: this is an HR role in an HRTech company changing the world of work for the better, weâll have immense amounts of fun, thereâs plenty of uncharted territory for you to make your own, and Iâm committed to helping you to do the best work of your life.

A quick check: if you've never built objectively clever automations (not just used one someone else built), this probably isn't the role for you. Automation is just that central to the job.

Responsibilities

In this role, your responsibilities will include:

  • Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.

  • Designing, building and maintaining a smart, automated and AI-enabled people journey - from pre-boarding to off-boarding - that frees up capacity for bespoke, white-glove treatment where it matters

  • Being the technical owner and orchestrator of our HR tech stack: evaluating and enhancing it, ensuring these tools are not siloed but unified and integrated.

  • Owning the non-Finance side of payroll, invoicing, contract administration, and compliance end to end, across every country we operate in.

  • Owning data privacy and recordkeeping, and the day-to-day relationship with our EOR vendor.

  • Owning configuration and troubleshooting of our hiring tooling, so hiring managers can run their own searches independently.

  • Owning the documentation that makes self-serve actually work in practice, ensuring that itâs structured in a way that is easily accessible to both humans and P&C AI agents.Â 

  • Working with me to maintain a clean line between what's self-serve and what needs a person. We do not aspire to automate our entire People journey here.Â 

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.

  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Has built and owned sophisticated automations (Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and the like) as a core part of an integrated HR tech stack, not just used AI tools day to day. Arguably the most important thing on this list.

  • Has managed payroll, compliance, or HR operations across multiple countries, ideally through an Employer of Record or a mix of EOR and direct entities.

  • Has deep, hands-on HRIS experience. HiBob experience is a big plus, and so is experience assessing or migrating HR systems.

  • Brings a product mindset: builds for the people who use them (employees and managers), listens to their feedback, and iterates rather than building in isolation.

  • Thrives in a high-autonomy, async-first, remote-only environment, and has worked in these kinds of teams and working cultures before.

  • Marries operational rigor with genuine empathy and a real interest in people. You'll be dealing directly with team members, sometimes on sensitive matters.

  • Is opinionated and candid, with excellent feedback and stakeholder management skills.

Most people in this role will have acquired these skills over five years of relevant experience. That being said, we care far more about what you've owned, your impact and how you've progressed, than the exact number of years.

We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone, even if your experience doesn't exactly match the description. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement - let's buck that trend!

Bonus skills

While these skills aren't a requirement, we'd be very interested to hear from you if you have any of the following:

  • Experience with an ATS or hiring platform such as Ashby, Greenhouse, or Lever.

  • Experience with an EOR provider such as Remote, Deel, or Oyster.

  • HRIS implementation or migration project experience.

  • Experience supporting a team through organizational change.

What's in it for you?

Please note: In this role, you'll be hired as an Individual Contractor.

  • Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world.

  • Competitive compensation: â¬56,520 - â¬70,650 base pay + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs). This role doesn't carry a bonus component.

  • Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life.
    *Check out the countries we currently hire from here.

  • Remote work budget: â¬1,000 available each year, or up to â¬2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop!

  • Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities.

  • Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches.

  • Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being.

Interested?

At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true skills and experience match.

When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment â it's your invitation to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data.

Given the hiring sprint timeline above, we'd love to see your application land before September 20.

Concerned about test anxiety or need help with the assessment? We've got you covered. Please check out our candidate support page for any questions. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application.

jobs.title: PINTOR À PISTOLA DE SUPERFÍCIES
jobs.description:
A Requintasfalto Lda pretende admitir um profissional de pintura automóvel para reforço da sua equipa.

Procura-se candidato com experiência profissional na área da pintura automóvel e capacidade para executar de forma autónoma as diferentes etapas do processo de preparação e pintura de viaturas.

As principais funções incluem preparação de superfícies para pintura, lixagem, aplicação de betumes e primários, preparação e afinação de tintas, aplicação de tinta e verniz, pintura em cabine, polimento, acabamentos finais e correção de imperfeições.

Pretende-se um profissional responsável, assíduo, pontual, cuidadoso e com atenção ao detalhe, com capacidade de trabalho em equipa e autonomia na execução das tarefas.

Valoriza-se experiência comprovada na função, bons conhecimentos técnicos de pintura automóvel e disponibilidade para entrada imediata ou a curto prazo.

jobs.title: KUĆNI MAJSTOR/KUĆNA MAJSTORICA
jobs.description:
Obavlja jednostavnije poslove održavanja i popravke: instalacije, elektroinstalacije, 
vodovodne instalacije, grijanje i druge poslove u hotelu. 
 
Izvršava sve radove na preventivnom i tekućem održavanju postrojenja. 
Vodi evidenciju o primljenom i utrošenom materijalu. 
Dužan je voditi knjigu izvršenih radova s unošenjem podataka o vremenu i vrsti posla 
koji je izvršen, te popis vrsta i količina utrošenog materijala ili rezervnih dijelova. 
Sudjeluje u godišnjem remontu strojeva i instalacija. 
 
Odgovoran je za primjenu mjera zaštite na radu, zaštite od požara na objektima, 
instalacijama, strojevima i uređajima, te za zaštitu okoliša hotela. 
Svakodnevno kontrolira Knjigu kvarova i vodi računa o njihovom promptnom 
uklanjanju. 
Predlaže voditelju poboljšanje sustava održavanja i ukazuje na stanje zaliha 
materijala ili rezervnih dijelova. 
Savjesno se odnosi prema opremi i sredstvima rada. 
Vodi tehničku dokumentaciju i potrebne evidencije. 
Sudjeluje u nabavci potrošnog materijala i rezervnih dijelova. 
Održava čistoću i urednost radnog prostora i strojeva. 
Kontrolira i primjenjuje mjere i sredstva zaštite na radu. 
Obavlja i ostale poslove po nalogu rukovoditelja.         
 
poželjno radno iskustvo na istim ili sličnim poslovima 
rad na neodređeno sa probnim rokom

jobs.title: SPECIJALIST/SPECIJALISTICA  ODRŽAVANJA STROJEVA I ELEKTRO OPREME
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLA:

ONO ŠTO NA OVOM RADNOM MJESTU OČEKUJEMO OD VAS:

  • održavanje strojeva i elektro opreme
  • nadzor rada transformatorskih stanica i manevriranje EE postrojenjem
  • izrada i popravak elektro i komunikacijskih instalacija
  • održavanje instalacije vanjske rasvjete
  • obavljanje intervencije i preventivno održavanje strojeva, instalacija i opreme u proizvodnom pogonu
  • obavljanje remonta strojeva u okviru procijenjenih tehničkih sposobnosti
  • otklanjanje kvarova u automatiziranim procesima
  • otkrivanje neispunjenih uvjeta PLC-a, simulacija ulaza i provjera ispravnosti, ispitivanje analogno/digitalnih izlaza
  • održavanje higijene strojeva, alata i radnih površina
  • poštivanje organizacije rada u odjelu
  • obavještavanje odgovorne osobe o svim uočenim nesukladnostima i događajima koji mogu imati negativan utjecaj na kvalitetu, sigurnost hrane, okoliš i energiju
  • korištenje korisničke dokumentacije prilikom održavanja strojeva i opreme kako bi svi radovi bili obavljeni prema uputama proizvođača, te propisima i pravilima struke
  • evidentiranje aktivnosti u aplikaciju i ispunjavanje dokumentacije prema interno propisanim procedurama

ŠTO NUDIMO I ŠTO MOŽETE OČEKIVATI OD NAS:

  • mentora pri uvođenju u posao
  • dodatna usavršavanja prema zahtjevima radnog mjesta
  • mogućnost napredovanja
  • nagrade za radne rezultate
  • prigodne nagrade (uskrsnica, regres, božićnica, dar za djecu)
  • naknadu za troškove prijevoza
  • osiguran topli obrok
  • osiguranu radnu odjeću i obuću
  • liječnički i sanitarni pregled na trošak poslodavca
  • plaćene dopuste za životna događanja kao što su sklapanje braka, rođenje djeteta, preseljenje i sl.
  • timski rad u ugodnom i dinamičnom radnom okruženju
  • rad u uspješnoj kompaniji, prepoznatljivog brenda i snažne tržišne pozicije
  • društveno odgovorno okruženje

    VI STE KANDIDAT ZA NAS AKO IMATE:

  • SSS (poželjan smjer: elektromehaničar / elektrotehničar / tehničar za električne strojeve s primijenjenim računalstvom / mehatroničar)
  • radno iskustvo na istim ili sličnim poslovima (poželjno, ali nije uvjet)
  • osnovno znanje engleskog jezika
  • osnovno znanje rada na računalu (MS Office)
  • proaktivnost
  • sposobnost rada u timu
  • želju za učenjem i usavršavanjem
  • tveno odgovorno okruženje

jobs.title: SPREMAČ/SPREMAČICA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE Belvedere iz Rijeke, Kozala 41, raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjene sljedećih radnih mjesta 5) 1 spremač/ica - 40 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena, na neodređeno radno vrijeme TRAŽENI UVJETI:
  • Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnom školstvu (NN 6/19);
  • Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.).
Za radna mjesta potrebno je poznavanje talijanskog jezika na razini materinjeg jezika (osim radnog mjesta br.5). Za radna mjesta mjesta provesti će se psihologijsko testiranje, poznavanje talijanskog jezika te intervju. Povrh navedenih provjera vršiti će se i vrednovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija od strane Povjerenstva za vrednovanje kandidata sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE Belvedere u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Uz potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti životopis, diplomu, dokaz o državljanstvu, elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a i uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi istražni ili kazneni postupak ne stariji od šest (6) mjeseci. Kandidati koji su stekli inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužni su također dostaviti: rješenje određenog visokog učilišta o priznavanju potpune istovrijednosti u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju istovrijednosti stranih školskih svjedodžbi i diploma ili rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje o stručnom priznavanju inozemne visokoškolske kvalifikacije u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija, rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Kandidati koji ističu posjedovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija dokumentaciji prilažu i dokaze za iste i to: uvjerenje ili certifikat, ili potvrda, ili svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava, ili osobna izjava kandidata ovjerena od javnog bilježnika. Sva dokumentacija dostavlja se u neovjerenoj preslici, odabrani kandidat prije zaključenja ugovora o radu dužan je dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumenata. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi za natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priložiti sve dokaze o priznatom statusu. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Poveznica Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf i https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Pozivi za pojedine faze natječajnog postupka s mjestom i vremenom održavanja te rezultati istih, kao i obavijest o odabiru kandidata biti će objavljeni na stranicama Škole na poveznici: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu selekcijskog postupka, smatrati će se da je povukao prijavu. Kandidat prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka. Prijave je potrebno dostaviti na adresu: Osnovna škola-Scuola elementare Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Rijeka. Rok za podnošenje prijave je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja. Natječaj se objavljuje na mrežnim stranicama škole i HZZ-a dana 08.09.2026.godine. Nepotpune, nepotpisane i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull'educazione e l’istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione la OŠ-SE Belvedere di Fiume, via Kozala 41, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per i seguenti posti di lavoro 5) 1 bidella - 40 ore settimanali di lavoro, a tempo indeterminato CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE:
  1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e dal Regolamento sulla qualifica e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19 e 74/20);
  2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.).
Per tutti i posti di lavoro in questione è necessario conoscere la lingua italiana a livello di madre lingua (escluso il numero 5) e possono accedere persone di ambedue i sessi. Per i posti di lavoro in questione saranno effettuati test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana e colloqui. Oltre ai suddetti controlli saranno valutate delle qualifiche aggiuntive dalla Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni rispettando le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE Belvedere con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate da dati biografici (CV), da certificato di studio richiesto del Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare, da certificato di cittadinanza, da estratto elettronico o certificato sui dati iscritti nelle evidenze matricolari dell’Ufficio di pensionamento croato e da attestato comprovante l’assenza di condanne penali la cui data di rilascio non deve risultare superiore ai sei (6) mesi. I candidati i quali hanno conseguito una qualifica estera devono inoltre presentare: il decreto d’un ente di educazione superiore con il quale si riconosce una completa equipollenza del titolo di studio secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dell’equipollenza dei titoli di studio esteri o il decreto dell’Agenzia per la scienza ed educazione superiore di riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero ai fini lavorativi secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri e nei sensi della Legge sule professioni regolamentate e sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri ai fini lavorativi, il decreto del Ministero della scienze ed educazione sul riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero per i fini di lavoro nelle professioni regolamentate. I candidati i quali dichiarano di possedere delle qualifiche aggiuntive, conoscenze ed educazioni devono presentare dei documenti probatori delle stesse, ovvero: attestati o certificati, conferme, pagelle, documenti pubblici equivalenti o una dichiarazione privata certificata da parte di un notaio pubblico. Tutta la documentazione deve essere presentata sotto forma di fotocopia semplice, mentre il candidato scelto deve presentare i documenti originali prima della firma del contrato di lavoro. I candidati i quali hanno diritto di precedenza secondo regolamenti speciali, devono dichiarare questo diritto e fornire prove che confermino il loro diritto e stato. I suddetti candidati avranno la precedenza di fronte agli altri candidati che hanno le stesse condizioni e qualifiche, ma non usufruiscono di codesto diritto. Il link del Ministero degli veterani: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf e https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Gli inviti per ogni fase della selezione, con il tempo e il posto dove si terranno, come anche i risultati di esse e anche i risultati finali saranno pubblicati sulle pagine web della scuola sul sito: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Se un candidato non si presenta a una delle fasi di selezione verrà considerato come se avesse ritirato la propria domanda. Secondo il GDPR i candidati con la presentazione della domanda acconsentono alla scuola di conservare e trattare i loro dati personali contenuti nella loro documentazione ai fini di codesto bando di concorso. Le domande devono pervenire al seguente indirizzo: OŠ-SE Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Fiume, entro 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso. Il presente Bando sarà pubblicato sulle pagine web della Scuola e dell’Ufficio di collocamento Croato il giorno 8 settembre 2026. Le domande incomplete, non firmate e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito, non saranno prese in considerazione

Uz potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti životopis, diplomu, dokaz o državljanstvu, elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a i uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi istražni ili kazneni postupak ne stariji od šest (6) mjeseci. Kandidati koji ističu posjedovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija dokumentaciji prilažu i dokaze za iste i to: uvjerenje ili certifikat, ili potvrda, ili svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava, ili osobna izjava kandidata ovjerena od javnog bilježnika. Sva dokumentacija dostavlja se u neovjerenoj preslici, odabrani kandidat prije zaključenja ugovora o radu dužan je dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumenata. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi za natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priložiti sve dokaze o priznatom statusu. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107.   1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnom školstvu (NN 6/19);
  2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.).
Za radna mjesta potrebno je poznavanje talijanskog jezika na razini materinjeg jezika (osim radnog mjesta br.5). Uz potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti životopis, diplomu, dokaz o državljanstvu, elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a i uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi istražni ili kazneni postupak ne stariji od šest (6) mjeseci. Kandidati koji su stekli inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužni su također dostaviti: rješenje određenog visokog učilišta o priznavanju potpune istovrijednosti u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju istovrijednosti stranih školskih svjedodžbi i diploma ili rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje o stručnom priznavanju inozemne visokoškolske kvalifikacije u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija, rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Kandidati koji ističu posjedovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija dokumentaciji prilažu i dokaze za iste i to: uvjerenje ili certifikat, ili potvrda, ili svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava, ili osobna izjava kandidata ovjerena od javnog bilježnika. Sva dokumentacija dostavlja se u neovjerenoj preslici, odabrani kandidat prije zaključenja ugovora o radu dužan je dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumenata. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi za natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priložiti sve dokaze o priznatom statusu. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. jobs.description:
Sabiedrība ar ierobežotu atbildību „Avimar”reģistrācijas numurs:  40203499514

AICINA DARBĀ KUĢUBŪVES ATSLĒDZNIEKUS (profesiju kods 7214 02)


Uzņēmuma darbības joma ir kuģu un peldošo iekārtu būve, kuģu un laivu remonts un apkope, kā arī metāla konstrukciju un to sastāvdaļu ražošana.

Pienākumi:

  • Veikt metāla konstrukciju remontu un izgatavošanu.
  • Veikt dažādu iekārtu un to mezglu montāžu, demontāžu, kā arī atjaunošanu.
  • Veikt aizzīmēšanas, ciršanas, griešanas, vīlēšanas, urbšanas, izrīvēšanas, pielāgošanas, kniedēšanas, liekšanas, presēšanas, slīpēšanas, taisnošanas, valcēšanas, lepēšanas un mērīšanas darbus.
  • Lasīt un izprast tehniskos rasējumus.
  • Ievērot darba aizsardzības un vides aizsardzības prasības.
  • Lietot un sekot līdzi atbilstošajai tehniskajai dokumentācijai.

Prasības:

  • Darba pieredze atbilstošā profesijā vismaz 3 gadi.
  • Bez kaitīgiem ieradumiem.
  • Izpratne par rasējumiem, iekārtām un tehnoloģisko dokumentāciju.
  • Prasme lietot un darbināt pacelšanas iekārtas (ja nepieciešams).
  • Izpratne par dažāda veida kuģu uzbūvi.
  • Prasme strādāt ar gāzes griešanas iekārtām un slīpmašīnām.
  • Spēja strādāt patstāvīgi un komandā.
  • Atbildīga attieksme pret darbu.

jobs.title: Pediküürija
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Klassikalise ja spa pediküüri teostamine.

Omalt poolt pakume: MIKS ASUDA TÖÖLE JUST MARIELL ILUSTUUDIOSSE?
💣Sest pakume Sulle.. 👑Imeilusat töökeskkonda - Ilustuudio Mariell ruumid on värskelt valminud ning sisustatud täiesti uue inventariga. Tallinnas on kümneid ja kümneid töökodasid (Sa tead ju küll neid büroohoone kümnendal korrusel keerates vasakule ja paremale ja korruse lõpus asuvaid "ilusalonge"), milleks Sulle see? Tule asu tööle esinduslikku i-l-u-s-a-l-o-n-g-i! 💭Know-how'd - Oled ilumaailmas alles algaja? Või tundub ettevõtjaks registreerimine sulle kui tuumateadus? Meie aitame Sind nõu ja jõuga, et saaksid edukaks ilutegijaks ning meie koostöö saaks olema pikaajaline ning mõlemale kasulik. 💌Turundus - me hoolime sellest, et Sul hakkaks hästi minema. Me ei anna Sulle ainult töökoha vaid aitame Sul ka kliente leida. 🕛24/7 ligipääsu ruumidele - Sa ei sõltu administraatorist ega kellegist teisest. Tahad tulla hommikul kell 07:00 tööle? Tule! Soovid lõpetada oma päeva kell 23:00 õhtul - tee seda! 📖Toimiv süsteem, kogemus - Ilustuudio Mariell on salongide kett mis on toimetanud juba üle 8 aasta erinevates linnades! 💉Tervisesõbralikkus - meie ruumid vastavad terviseameti nõuetele, et just Sina oleksid hoitud. Veedad suure osa oma päevast tööl, tee seda parimal võimalikul viisil! 🎌Super hea asukoht - Pärnu maantee 23 on ülimalt läbikäidav tänav, püüame kliente ka tänavalt! 💃Meeskond - ettevõtlus ei ole pelgalt raha teenimine. See on ühised üritused - jõulud, sünnipäevad, naistepäevad. See on kliendipäevad, heategevuspäevad, family mealid ja ka roosad esmaspäevad, kui me seda soovime! Salongi lahendus - Ilustuudio Mariell Tallinnas on jagatud kolmeks poolkorruseks, ehk et igal iluteenindajate grupil on enda privaatsus, föönid ei sega kosmeetiku tööd ega ripsmeid ei pea paigaldama varbad küünetehniku silme ees 😉

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist, Europe
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through all communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

Requirements

 - Currently based in Europe.

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

jobs.title: Lead Game Designer
jobs.description:
CCP Games is seeking a Lead Game Designer to help our EVE Online design team grow, align, and deliver impactful gameplay and system as we build EVE into its third decade.

This is primarily a leadership role. While design judgment is essential, your greatest impact will come from mentorship, communication, and enabling designers to do their best work within complex, long-running live systems.

What You'll Do:
Lead, mentor, and support senior designers, with a focus on growth, feedback, and long-term career development
Improve team effectiveness by strengthening communication, collaboration, and clarity across disciplines
Partner with the Game Design Director to evolve and uphold EVE Online’s design process
Guide feature teams through exploration and development, encouraging a solution-oriented mindset while preserving momentum
Foster a culture of empowerment, experimentation, and learning within a live service environment
Identify and address team health issues early, helping teams navigate alignment challenges
Act as a trusted design leader for stakeholders, aligning goals and constraints into shared understanding

What We're Looking For:
6+ years of game design experience, including 2+ years in a people-focused leadership role
Proven ability to mentor and grow experienced designers
Extensive experience with gameplay systems and live game design, with the ability to give high-quality feedback
Clear, empathetic communicator with excellent stakeholder management skills
Experience shipping features in live service, MMO, sandbox, or similarly complex products
A leadership mindset focused on enabling others and team outcomes, not individual ownership
Bonus Experience: Familiarity with EVE Online, sandbox games, or player-driven economies

What We Can Offer You:
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation
Double work station setup and flexible work environment
An active fun division that hosts regular events
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan
Annual sports grant
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package
Home internet
A conditional monthly transportation grant
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price
Relocation Package

Please submit your application in English.
